instructions.3: Heap onto a plate and serve hot.

osool-814.title: Pasta with Tomato and Spiced Mince (Stovetop or Baked)

instructions.1: Make the asag with the ghee, onion and minced meat.
instructions.2: Add the tomatoes and cook until done, then add some water and bring to a boil.
instructions.3: Add the asag to the boiled pasta and mix gently.
instructions.4: Spoon onto a plate and serve hot.
instructions.5: Baked: put half the pasta in a greased tray or ovenproof dish with the asag in the middle, then the rest of the pasta; heat 1 tablespoon ghee until very hot, drizzle over the top and bake in a hot oven until browned.

osool-815-i3.name: Pasta with spiced mince or French-style pasta

instructions.1: Grease an oblong cake tin or a medium round tray with ghee.
instructions.2: Line the bottom and sides of the tin with phyllo (keeping a few sheets for the top), sprinkling melted ghee between the layers.
instructions.3: Put the pasta into the prepared tin, cover the top with phyllo the same way and sprinkle the top with ghee.
instructions.4: Bake in a hot oven until the phyllo is golden.
instructions.5: Let it cool slightly, then turn out onto a plate and serve.

osool-816.title: Baked Pasta in an Egg and Breadcrumb Crust

osool-816-i1.name: Pasta with spiced mince and tomato

instructions.1: Grease the tray well with warm ghee.
instructions.2: Sprinkle with the breadcrumbs to coat the bottom and sides evenly.
instructions.3: Lightly beat 2 eggs and pour them into the tray over the breadcrumbs to coat them.
instructions.4: Beat the other 2 eggs and mix them into the pasta, adding the grated cheese if using.
instructions.5: Put the pasta mixture into the prepared tray and bake in a hot oven until browned on top.
instructions.6: Let the tray cool somewhat, then turn out onto a plate and serve.

osool-817-i1.name: Cut pasta, orzo (lisan asfour) or small shells

instructions.1: Fry the pasta in very hot ghee until golden.
instructions.2: Bring the stock or water to a boil, add it to the browned pasta, season with salt and cook until done.
instructions.3: Add more stock or water if needed; the amount varies with the type of pasta.

osool-818.title: Toad in the Hole (Sausages Baked in Batter)

osool-818-i2.name: For the simple English batter: flour

instructions.1: For the batter: mix the salt with the flour and sift; make a well in the center and add the egg, then two-thirds of the milk, stirring constantly until thick and free of lumps; beat well for 5 to 10 minutes and leave for at least half an hour in a well-ventilated place; then add the rest of the milk, beat and season.
instructions.2: Prick the sausages with a fork and put them in a greased tray in the oven for 10 minutes, or sauté them.
instructions.3: Cut the sausages in half or into medium pieces.
instructions.4: Grease the tray or ovenproof dish well with ghee, arrange the sausages in it and pour the batter over them.
instructions.5: Bake in a hot oven for 20 minutes.
instructions.6: Serve hot, cut into suitable pieces on a plate, or whole in the baking dish.
instructions.7: Steak in batter: replace the sausages with very thinly sliced steak seasoned with salt and pepper, and make it like the sausages in batter.

osool-701.title: Zucchini Dolma (Stuffed with Rice, Cooked in Oil)
osool-701.culturalNotes: Dolma is a meatless stuffed vegetable dish cooked in oil; it is good served cold.

osool-701-i2.name: For the dolma filling: finely chopped onions

osool-701-i5.name: For the dolma filling: chopped parsley

osool-701-i6.name: For the dolma filling: chopped mint or a little dried mint

instructions.1: For the dolma filling: fry the onions lightly in the oil, then add the washed rice and stir over low heat; add the strained tomatoes and stir until the rice absorbs the juice, then add the mint and parsley and stir for two minutes; season with salt, pepper and allspice and leave to cool.
instructions.2: Wash, scrape and hollow out the zucchini, season the insides with salt and fill with the mixture, leaving about an inch unfilled.
instructions.3: Slice the celery, carrots and onion into rounds, leave the garlic whole and mix everything together.
instructions.4: Put some of the sliced vegetables in the bottom of the pot, then arrange a layer of zucchini and another of vegetables, and so on.
instructions.5: Add some water to the strained tomatoes, season the mixture and pour it over the zucchini, then add the oil.
instructions.6: Cover the pot and cook over low heat until done, adding a little salted water when needed; add the cardamom a few minutes before it is done.
instructions.7: Spoon onto a plate, garnish with the whole cooked carrot rounds and serve hot or cold.

osool-702-i2.name: Dolma filling (onion, rice, oil, parsley, mint and tomatoes)

osool-702-i5.name: Two carrots, a piece of celery and an onion (sliced into rounds)

instructions.1: Peel the eggplants lightly, then cut off the cap with a small piece of the top and hollow them out to remove all the seeds.
instructions.2: Leave in salted water for half an hour, then drain.
instructions.3: Fill with the dolma mixture, leaving the top part unfilled.
instructions.4: Arrange the vegetable rounds in the bottom of the pot and the eggplants on top; pour over the strained tomatoes, salted water and oil.
instructions.5: Cover the pot and cook over low heat until done, adding a little water whenever needed.
instructions.6: Arrange neatly on a plate, garnish with parsley and serve hot or cold.
instructions.7: White eggplant dolma: made with the same ingredients and method.

osool-703-i2.name: For the raw filling: minced meat

osool-703-i4.name: For the raw filling: large onion, chopped

osool-703-i5.name: For the raw filling: chopped parsley and mint

osool-703-i6.name: For the raw filling: chopped tomatoes

instructions.1: For the raw filling: rub the onion with salt and pepper; pick over, wash and drain the rice; mix all the ingredients and season with salt, pepper and allspice.
instructions.2: Wash and hollow out the cucumbers (do not scrape them) and salt the insides.
instructions.3: Fill with the mixture and arrange in a pot.
instructions.4: Pour over the strained tomatoes mixed with a little salted water, and add the ghee.
instructions.5: Cover the pot and cook over low heat until done, adding a little water whenever needed.
instructions.6: Spoon onto a plate with the sauce around it, and garnish with parsley if you like.
instructions.7: Snake cucumber stuffed with freekeh: made as above using freekeh instead of rice, and without the tomatoes.
instructions.8: Stuffed cucumbers: made like the snake cucumbers with the raw filling.

osool-704-i2.name: Raw filling (minced meat, rice, onion, parsley and tomatoes) or ¼ kg asag with tomatoes

instructions.1: Peel and hollow out the onions and soak in salted water for half an hour.
instructions.2: Drain and season the insides with a little salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Fill with the chosen filling; the raw filling is best.
instructions.4: Arrange in a pot and pour over the ghee and the tomatoes mixed with a little salted water.
instructions.5: Set over low heat, cover the pot and cook until done.
instructions.6: Spoon onto a plate, pour the sauce around and garnish with parsley.

osool-705-i2.name: Asag with tomatoes or raw filling
osool-705-i2.standardAmount: ½ kg asag or half a batch of filling

instructions.1: Cut the white part of the leeks into pieces about 8 cm long.
instructions.2: Hollow them out, stuff them and finish like stuffed onions: arrange in a pot, pour over the ghee and the tomatoes with a little salted water, and cook covered over low heat until done.
instructions.3: Second method: cut the white parts into 6 cm lengths and boil briefly in salted water; slit lengthwise down one side and carefully separate the layers; put a little filling on each layer and roll it up like a finger; arrange in a small pot, pour over the tomatoes mixed with a little salted water, cook, then turn out into a deep dish and serve hot.

instructions.1: Separate the lettuce leaves, wash well and carefully remove the thick rib from the center of each leaf.
instructions.2: Bring some salted water to a boil, add a batch of lettuce leaves for two minutes, then lift into a colander; repeat until all the leaves are done.
instructions.3: Stuff as fingers, as with cabbage, or as triangles, with the smooth side outward.
instructions.4: Arrange in a pot and put on the heat; after five minutes add a little salted liquid, the lemon juice if using, and the ghee or oil.
instructions.5: Cook over low heat until done.
instructions.6: Serve hot, or cold if using dolma filling, with a yogurt salad.
instructions.7: Stuffed chard leaves: choose wide leaves, prepare them like lettuce leaves, dip in salted boiling water and lift out quickly; stuff exactly like lettuce leaves, using only the raw filling and more lemon juice.
instructions.8: Stuffed spinach leaves: choose wide leaves and prepare exactly like chard leaves; stuff like lettuce leaves and leave out the lemon.

instructions.1: Choose the large, leafy kind; remove the thick stems, dip in salted boiling water and lift out.
instructions.2: Spread out on the table or your hand, arrange the fronds and press them flat by hand.
instructions.3: Put a little of the raw filling or asag on it and roll the dill tightly into fingers.
instructions.4: Arrange in a pot, put the ghee on top and set on the heat for five minutes.
instructions.5: Add a little salted water, cover with paper greased with ghee and then with the pot lid.
instructions.6: Cook over low heat until done, adding a little salted water whenever needed.

osool-708-i2.name: Dolma filling (onion, rice, oil, parsley, mint and tomatoes)

instructions.1: Wash the grape leaves repeatedly in cold water, then spread them out and stack them in piles.
instructions.2: Blanch each pile in boiling water with a little salt, then lift out carefully into a colander.
instructions.3: Cut the stem off each leaf and lay it flat with the smooth side outward; put a little dolma filling on it and roll it up like a finger.
instructions.4: Line the bottom of the pot with a layer of grape leaves, arrange the stuffed leaves neatly on top and put the oil over them.
instructions.5: Put the pot on the heat for 3 minutes, then add a little salted water; cook until nearly done, then add the lemon juice.
instructions.6: Arrange neatly on a plate or turn out of the pot, and serve cold with a yogurt salad.

osool-709.title: Levantine Stuffed Grape Leaves with Lamb Trotters

instructions.1: Prepare the grape leaves by washing them and blanching them in batches in salted boiling water.
instructions.2: Chop the onion and rub with salt and pepper, then add the washed rice, ghee and meat and mix everything well; season with salt, pepper and a little lemon juice and roll the leaves around it like fingers.
instructions.3: Take the trotter meat off the bone as far as possible.
instructions.4: Put a layer of trotter meat in the bottom of the pot, then arrange half the stuffed leaves on top.
instructions.5: Add another layer of trotter meat and cover with the rest of the stuffed leaves.
instructions.6: Set the pot over low heat, then pour a little trotter broth over.
instructions.7: Cook until nearly done, then add the lemon juice.
instructions.8: Serve the stuffed leaves with the trotter meat, hot.

osool-710.title: Stuffed Tomatoes (with Meat or Dolma Filling)

osool-710-i2.name: Raw filling (minced meat, rice, onion and parsley) or dolma filling

osool-710-i3.name: Ghee or oil for greasing the paper

instructions.1: Wash and dry the tomatoes and hollow them out, keeping the lid intact and attached.
instructions.2: Season each with a little salt and pepper, turn upside down and leave for ten minutes.
instructions.3: Strain the scooped-out pulp and use it in the filling.
instructions.4: Fill the tomatoes halfway and replace the lids, then wrap each in paper greased with ghee or oil depending on the filling.
instructions.5: Arrange in a pot, add some salted water and cook over low heat until done.
instructions.6: Take off the heat and let cool slightly, then carefully remove the paper, arrange on a plate and garnish with parsley.
instructions.7: Serve hot if stuffed with the raw meat filling, and cold if stuffed with dolma filling.

osool-711.title: Baked Tomatoes Stuffed with Spiced Mince

instructions.1: Prepare, hollow out, season and drain the tomatoes as before.
instructions.2: Fill with the asag and brush with ghee.
instructions.3: Arrange in a tray greased with ghee and bake in a moderate oven for 10 to 15 minutes.
instructions.4: Arrange on a plate, garnish with parsley and serve hot.
instructions.5: Tomatoes stuffed with spiced mince and rice: mix ⅛ kg asag with 3 tablespoons boiled rice, 1 tablespoon chopped parsley and a little ghee and season; fill the tomatoes, brush with ghee, arrange in a greased tray and bake in a moderate oven for 10 minutes.

osool-712-i1.name: Mixed vegetables for stuffing (black and white eggplants, peppers, tomatoes, zucchini and lettuce, grape or cabbage leaves)

osool-712-i2.name: Dolma filling (onion, rice, oil, parsley, mint and tomatoes)

osool-712-i3.name: Vegetables sliced into rounds (carrots, onions and celery)

instructions.1: Prepare each vegetable according to its kind: hollow out the eggplants, zucchini and peppers, blanch the leaves briefly in salted water, then stuff them with the filling.
instructions.2: Layer them alternately with the sliced vegetables, covering each layer with a sheet of glazed paper brushed with oil.
instructions.3: Stuff the tomatoes, wrap each one in greased paper and place them on top.
instructions.4: Add the oil and a little salted water.
instructions.5: Cover the pot and cook over low heat until done.
instructions.6: Leave to cool, then arrange neatly and attractively on a platter and garnish with parsley.

osool-501.title: Boiled Green Beans, Served Several Ways
osool-501.culturalNotes: To keep green vegetables green, boil them quickly in salted boiling water in an uncovered pot and lift them out as soon as they are done.

osool-501-i4.name: A pinch of baking soda (optional, to keep the color)

osool-501-i5.name: For serving with oil and lemon: olive oil

osool-501-i6.name: For serving with oil and lemon: lemon juice

instructions.1: Wash the beans well and remove the side strings by hand or with a knife, then slice lengthwise into thin strips or cut diagonally into oblong pieces.
instructions.2: Bring the water to a boil and add the salt and baking soda, then drop the beans into the boiling water and cook uncovered until tender (15 to 30 minutes), skimming off any scum.
instructions.3: Drain as soon as they are done.
instructions.4: With oil and lemon: let them cool; whisk the oil with the lemon, salt and pepper, dress the beans with it and serve.
instructions.5: In stock: sauté half-boiled beans in 1 tablespoon butter or ghee, then add 2 cups chicken or meat stock, an onion and a piece of celery; cover and cook over low heat until tender, then remove the onion and celery.
instructions.6: In white sauce: add half-boiled beans to 2 cups light white sauce and cook over low heat until tender; season, spoon into a deep dish and garnish with chopped parsley.
instructions.7: Green black-eyed pea pods: prepare them in all these ways with the same quantities, except that the pods are cut in half crosswise rather than sliced lengthwise.

osool-502.title: Layered Green Bean and Meat Stew (without Onion Base)

instructions.1: Prepare the beans and the meat.
instructions.2: Put all the ingredients in a pot raw, in alternating layers of beans, meat, tomato rounds and onion, sprinkling a suitable amount of seasoning between the layers.
instructions.3: Add the liquid, cover the pot and cook over low heat or in a moderate oven until tender (one to one and a half hours).
instructions.4: Layered green black-eyed pea stew: made the same way.

osool-503-i4.name: For the onion base: meat cut into small cubes

osool-503-i5.name: For the onion base: chopped onion

osool-503-i7.name: For the onion base: strained tomatoes

instructions.1: For the onion base: chop the onion finely and fry in the ghee until golden, then add the meat and stir until browned; add the strained tomatoes and seasoning and stir until the tomatoes are cooked and the ghee separates.
instructions.2: Put the meat and onion base in the bottom of a small pot (daqiya) and arrange the carrot rounds around it.
instructions.3: Sauté the beans in a little ghee, or half-boil them, or leave them raw, and add the chopped garlic.
instructions.4: Put the beans on top of the meat in the pot and press down lightly to level them.
instructions.5: Add the liquid (water or stock) with the salt and pepper dissolved in it.
instructions.6: Cook over low heat with the pot covered until done.
instructions.7: Turn out onto a plate when ready to serve.
instructions.8: Black-eyed pea pod mold: made the same way.

osool-504-i4.name: Fresh mint leaves or a small onion

instructions.1: Shell the peas and wash them well.
instructions.2: Boil in water with the salt and the mint or onion or both, leaving the pot uncovered and skimming off any scum.
instructions.3: Cook until tender, then drain.
instructions.4: Sautéed: put the well-drained peas in a pan with the butter and reheat over low heat without letting them go mushy; season with salt and pepper and serve hot.
instructions.5: In stock: drain half-boiled peas and cook them with 1 tablespoon butter or ghee, an onion and 1–1½ cups stock over low heat until tender; remove the onion and serve hot.
instructions.6: With carrots: add the hot boiled peas to hot sautéed carrots with the butter and toss everything lightly off the heat.
instructions.7: With oil and lemon: dress the cold boiled peas with the oil and lemon mixture, as for green beans.

instructions.1: Press the boiled peas through a sieve and add the butter, salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Heat gently, stirring constantly, until the purée absorbs the butter and thickens.
instructions.3: Serve hot.
instructions.4: Second method: add the butter to the sieved peas and heat gently while stirring, then add the milk gradually, stirring constantly until the mixture thickens; season.
instructions.5: Pea timbales: melt the butter and let it cool, then add the egg yolks, season and beat well; add to the sieved peas and stir, then divide among small molds greased with ghee; set the molds in a tray of water reaching halfway up their sides, cover with greased paper and bake in a moderate oven for 20 minutes; lift out, let them cool slightly, then turn out and serve.

osool-506-i6.name: For garnish: parsley, lemon slices and diced boiled meat (optional)

instructions.1: Prepare the artichokes by removing the outer leaves, peeling them and cleaning the fuzzy choke from the center; keep them in water with lemon, then boil in boiling water with salt and lemon juice until tender and drain.
instructions.2: Place the boiled artichokes in an ovenproof dish or tray greased with ghee.
instructions.3: Cover with the white sauce and sprinkle the top with fine breadcrumbs.
instructions.4: Cut the butter into very small pieces and dot them over the top.
instructions.5: Bake in a moderate oven until the top browns and serve hot.
instructions.6: Without an oven: arrange the boiled artichokes on a plate, pour the white sauce over them, garnish with parsley, lemon and meat, or any of these, and serve hot.

osool-507.title: Artichokes with Lamb in White Sauce

osool-507-i6.name: Meat cooking broth with milk
osool-507-i6.standardAmount: 2 cups broth and 1 cup milk (or 3 cups broth)

instructions.1: Cut the meat into slices and boil in a liter of water until nearly tender.
instructions.2: Make the white sauce with the ghee, flour, meat broth and milk (or broth alone) and season well with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Add the cut-up boiled artichokes, the cut-up boiled carrots and the meat, and cook over low heat until everything is tender.
instructions.4: Adjust the seasoning, add the lemon, take off the heat and serve hot.
instructions.5: With yogurt: make the white sauce with 3 cups meat broth, add the boiled artichokes and cook until tender; whisk a large bowl of well-set yogurt, strain it and add it to the artichokes, bring to one boil, season, add the lemon juice and serve hot.

osool-508.title: Stewed Artichokes and Artichokes in Tomato Sauce

instructions.1: Make the onion base: chop the onion finely and fry in the ghee until golden, then add the meat and stir until browned, then the strained tomatoes and seasoning, stirring until the tomatoes are cooked and the ghee separates.
instructions.2: Add the liquid and bring to a boil, then add the half-boiled artichokes.
instructions.3: Cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.4: Artichokes in tomato sauce: half-boil 8 to 10 artichokes; make the sauce by frying a chopped onion in ghee, adding strained tomatoes until cooked, then a cup of stock; add ¼–½ kg diced meat and cook until nearly tender, then add the artichokes, cover and cook until done.
instructions.5: In tomato sauce, second method: fry the artichokes after half-boiling them, or fry them raw; lift them out, make the sauce with the remaining ghee and finish cooking as above.

instructions.1: Prepare the artichokes and cut each into 2 to 4 pieces depending on size.
instructions.2: Half-boil them, then fry lightly in the ghee and lift out.
instructions.3: Add the tomatoes to the remaining ghee and cook until done, then add the asag.
instructions.4: Arrange the artichokes neatly in a small pot, with the asag and tomatoes between the layers.
instructions.5: Pour the liquid over, cover the pot and cook over low heat until done, or bake in a moderate oven.
instructions.6: Turn out onto a fairly deep plate and serve.

osool-510-i2.name: French batter (flour, oil, warm water and whisked egg white)

instructions.1: Clean the artichokes and leave them briefly in water with lemon; cut each into quarters or halves depending on size, or leave whole.
instructions.2: Boil until two-thirds cooked as usual.
instructions.3: Coat the pieces in the French batter and deep-fry in plenty of ghee.
instructions.4: Sprinkle with a little salt and pepper, garnish with parsley and serve hot.

osool-511-i4.name: For the onion base: meat, cut up

osool-511-i5.name: For the onion base: chopped onion

osool-511-i7.name: For the onion base: strained tomatoes

instructions.1: Remove the green outer leaves, separate the remaining leaves and wash them carefully.
instructions.2: Bring the water to a boil with 1 teaspoon each of salt and cumin per liter, drop in the leaves and cook until tender; lift them out carefully into a colander.
instructions.3: Stewed cabbage: cut the cabbage into medium pieces and half-boil them; make the onion base (onion fried in ghee with the meat, then the tomatoes), add the liquid and the boiled cabbage, cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.4: Boiled cabbage is used on its own for stuffing, or cooked with tomatoes or with vinegar.

osool-512.title: Layered Cabbage Mold with Spiced Mince and Pine Nuts

osool-512-i2.name: Asag with pine nuts and tomatoes

instructions.1: Separate the cabbage leaves carefully so they stay whole and half-boil them; lift out and leave to drain, and pick out the white inner leaves for the mold.
instructions.2: Lay one whole leaf so it covers the bottom and sides of the pot.
instructions.3: Add a layer of asag, then another layer of leaves, and so on until everything is used (about 8 leaves).
instructions.4: Fold the edges of the leaves over to cover the top of the mold.
instructions.5: Add the seasoned liquid, cover the pot and cook over low heat or in a moderate oven until done.
instructions.6: Turn out onto a plate and serve hot.

osool-513.title: Whole Stuffed Cabbage with Spiced Mince

osool-513-i5.name: Onion and carrot, sliced into rounds

instructions.1: Remove the green outer leaves and half-boil the cabbage whole.
instructions.2: Carefully remove the middle leaves from the top end using a sharp knife.
instructions.3: Fill the hollow with the asag and tie the cabbage in cheesecloth to keep its shape.
instructions.4: Peel the onion and carrot, slice into rounds and place them in the bottom of the pot, with the cabbage on top.
instructions.5: Add the water to the strained tomatoes, season with salt and pepper and pour into the pot.
instructions.6: Cover the pot and cook over low heat or in a moderate oven until done.
instructions.7: Carefully untie the cheesecloth, place the cabbage on a plate and strain the sauce around it.

osool-514.title: Buttered Brussels Sprouts
osool-514.culturalNotes: Brussels sprouts are a kind of cabbage about the size of a large lemon.

instructions.1: Remove any wilted or dry outer leaves.
instructions.2: Wash and soak in salted water for a quarter of an hour to remove anything clinging to them, then rinse well.
instructions.3: Boil in salted boiling water until tender (10 to 20 minutes), then drain.
instructions.4: Add a piece of butter while hot and serve at once.
instructions.5: In white sauce: cover the boiled sprouts with white sauce and serve hot.

osool-515-i2.name: Salt
osool-515-i2.standardAmount: ½ teaspoon per liter of water

osool-515-i3.name: Cumin
osool-515-i3.standardAmount: ½ teaspoon per liter of water

osool-515-i4.name: French dressing (oil and vinegar or lemon, salt and pepper)

instructions.1: Bring the water to a boil with the salt and cumin, and put in the cauliflower flower-side down so the scum does not collect on it.
instructions.2: Leave the pot uncovered until tender (15 to 30 minutes), then drain.
instructions.3: Cut up, dress with the French dressing, arrange neatly on the plate and garnish with chopped parsley.

osool-516-i3.name: Onion base with minced meat (or asag with tomatoes)

instructions.1: Cut the cauliflower into medium pieces, pat dry, half-fry in the ghee and lift out.
instructions.2: Make the onion base with minced meat in the remaining ghee.
instructions.3: Layer the cauliflower and minced meat alternately in a pot, mold or tagine, starting with meat; season the liquid with salt and pepper and pour it over.
instructions.4: Cover and cook over low heat or in a moderate oven until done.
instructions.5: Serve ladled into a deep dish, turned out of the mold, or in the tagine wrapped with a paper frill.
instructions.6: Stewed cauliflower: make the onion base, add the half-boiled cauliflower cut into medium pieces, cover and cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.7: Cauliflower moussaka with egg: made as above, except that the boiled cauliflower is dipped in 2 beaten eggs and fried before use.

osool-517-i8.name: Vinegar-garlic sauce or tomato sauce, for serving

instructions.1: Break the eggs, beat them lightly and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Cut the boiled cauliflower into even pieces and pat dry.
instructions.3: Dust the pieces lightly with flour, then dip them in the egg.
instructions.4: Fry in a little ghee and lift onto paper to absorb the ghee.
instructions.5: Arrange the pieces neatly on a plate and garnish with parsley, or serve with a vinegar-garlic sauce.
instructions.6: Simple fried cauliflower: fry the dried boiled cauliflower uncoated in very hot ghee or oil, lift onto paper and serve with vinegar-garlic sauce.
instructions.7: In egg and breadcrumbs: after dipping the pieces in egg, coat them in fine white breadcrumbs and deep- or shallow-fry in ghee.
instructions.8: In batter: dust two-thirds-boiled cauliflower pieces lightly with seasoned flour, dip in French batter and deep-fry in plenty of ghee; serve hot with tomato sauce.

osool-518-i4.name: French dressing (oil, vinegar, salt and pepper) or butter

instructions.1: Wash, peel and slice the zucchini, or leave them whole if small.
instructions.2: Boil in the salted boiling water over fairly low heat until tender, then drain.
instructions.3: With oil and lemon: arrange the drained zucchini on a plate, pour some French dressing over and leave for at least a quarter of an hour; garnish with parsley.
instructions.4: Sautéed: put the drained boiled zucchini in a pan with 1 tablespoon butter and reheat, shaking the pan so they do not break up; place on a warm plate and garnish with parsley.
instructions.5: In stock: sauté in butter, then cook in a little meat or chicken stock with an onion, using less liquid.

instructions.1: Peel and cut up the zucchini and sauté in 1 tablespoon butter for 10 minutes, making sure the pieces hold together and do not change color.
instructions.2: Add a very little water or stock, cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.3: Lift the pieces out carefully into an ovenproof dish or tray and cover with the white sauce (the liquid left from cooking the zucchini can be added to the milk for the sauce); sprinkle with the cheese if using.
instructions.4: Sprinkle the top with the breadcrumbs, and dot with the remaining ½ tablespoon butter cut into very small pieces.
instructions.5: Bake in a low oven until the top browns.

instructions.1: Peel the zucchini and cut into rounds or medium pieces; cut up the meat, and slice the onion and tomatoes into rounds.
instructions.2: Put the zucchini, meat, tomato and onion rounds and celery raw into a pot in alternating layers, sprinkling seasoning between the layers.
instructions.3: Add a small amount of liquid (less than usual, since zucchini are watery) and cover the pot.
instructions.4: Cook over low heat or in a moderate oven until the meat and zucchini are tender.
instructions.5: Stewed with an onion base: chop the onion and fry in the ghee, then add the meat, then the strained tomatoes until cooked; add the liquid and the zucchini, cover and cook until tender, adding a few chickpeas if you like.
instructions.6: Zucchini moussaka: peel the zucchini, slice and salt them, then fry lightly in ghee; make the onion base with minced meat, then layer the zucchini and meat alternately in a pot or tagine, pour over the seasoned liquid and cook over low heat or in a moderate oven until done.

osool-521.title: Syrian-Style Stuffed Zucchini in Yogurt Sauce

instructions.1: Wash the zucchini and hollow them out without peeling, then rinse with salted water.
instructions.2: Stuff with the asag and sauté in half the ghee.
instructions.3: Arrange in the pot, add a little water and cook over low heat, adding a little water from time to time, until tender.
instructions.4: Put the yogurt in a bowl and whisk well; mix the flour well with a little water and add it to the whisked yogurt; beat the egg white lightly and add it to the yogurt; thin the mixture with a little water, then strain through a wire strainer.
instructions.5: Heat the yogurt gently, stirring well, for 5 minutes.
instructions.6: Pour it into the pot with the zucchini and heat gently for 5 to 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Chop the garlic finely and fry it in the remaining ghee, then add it to the zucchini, cover the pot and take it off the heat.
instructions.8: Ladle the zucchini onto a plate, pour the sauce over and serve hot.

osool-522-i6.name: Vinegar-garlic sauce or yogurt salad, for serving

instructions.1: Cut the zucchini into medium-thick slices and soak in salted water.
instructions.2: Pat dry, and coat lightly in flour if you like.
instructions.3: Fry in very hot oil.
instructions.4: Arrange on a plate, garnish with parsley and serve with the vinegar-garlic sauce or yogurt sauce.

osool-523.title: Carrots: Boiled, Sautéed or in White Sauce

instructions.1: Wash the carrots and leave whole, or wash, scrape and cut into rounds, sticks or cubes as needed.
instructions.2: Boil in salted water with the pot covered for 20 to 30 minutes; drain, and peel any unpeeled carrots while hot.
instructions.3: Sautéed: put half-boiled carrots in a pan with a cup of water, salt, pepper and the butter and cook over low heat until tender; serve as is, or drain off the liquid and garnish with parsley.
instructions.4: In white sauce: boil the cut carrots, drain and arrange on the plate; cover with the white sauce, garnish with parsley and serve hot.

instructions.1: Prepare the eggplant and cut it into thick rounds or fairly long pieces, and season with salt.
instructions.2: Without an onion base: put the eggplant, meat and tomato and onion rounds raw into a pot in alternating layers with the liquid and seasoning, and cook over low heat or in the oven until tender.
instructions.3: With an onion base: chop the onion and fry in the ghee until golden, then add the meat until browned, then the strained tomatoes and seasoning until the ghee separates; add the liquid and eggplant, cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender.

osool-525-i6.name: Parsley and tomato rounds, for garnish

instructions.1: Cut the eggplant into fairly thin round slices.
instructions.2: Season with salt and weigh down to press out the liquid, then pat very dry.
instructions.3: Coat lightly in flour, then in egg and breadcrumbs, and fry.
instructions.4: Arrange neatly on a plate and garnish with parsley and tomato rounds.

osool-526.title: Baked Baladi Eggplant Stuffed with Spiced Mince

instructions.1: Peel the eggplants, or leave them unpeeled, or peel them in alternating strips, keeping the stem on in every case.
instructions.2: Slit them along the side, scoop out a little of the flesh and leave them in salted water for a quarter of an hour.
instructions.3: Lift out, pat dry, fry in the ghee and lift out, then stuff with the asag mixed with the pine nuts and parsley.
instructions.4: Arrange side by side in a tray greased with ghee.
instructions.5: Add the water to the tomato juice, season with salt and pepper and pour over the eggplants.
instructions.6: Cover with paper greased with ghee and bake in a moderate oven until done.

osool-527.title: Eggplant Bake with White Sauce and Spiced Mince

instructions.1: Prepare the eggplant as before, season it and drain off its liquid, then sauté in ghee and lift out.
instructions.2: Make the white sauce and let it cool somewhat, then add the lightly beaten eggs and stir together.
instructions.3: Layer the eggplant, sauce and asag with pine nuts alternately, making sure the last layer is sauce.
instructions.4: Sprinkle the top with the breadcrumbs, cut the butter into very small pieces and dot them evenly over the top.
instructions.5: Bake in a moderate oven until the top browns.

osool-528.title: Roasted Eggplant with Oil, Lemon and Garlic
osool-528.culturalNotes: Roasted eggplant is also used in tahini dip and baba ghanoush.

osool-528-i4.name: French dressing (oil and vinegar or lemon, salt and pepper)

instructions.1: Wash and dry the eggplants, leave them whole and place in a tray.
instructions.2: Roast in a moderate oven until tender.
instructions.3: Peel the roasted eggplants and cut them neatly into long strips.
instructions.4: Crush the garlic finely with some salt and add the chili; season the eggplant with this mixture and arrange on the plate.
instructions.5: Pour the French dressing over and garnish with chopped parsley.

instructions.1: Peel the small potatoes and boil them, or boil them in their skins and then peel.
instructions.2: Heat the butter and toss the potatoes in it; season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with the chopped parsley.
instructions.3: Second method: peel the potatoes and cut into 1 × 1 cm cubes; boil in salted water until nearly done and drain, then sauté in the butter and sprinkle with parsley, salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Third method: cut cold boiled potatoes into even rounds; heat a little ghee until very hot and add the rounds; when the undersides are browned, turn them to brown the other side, then lift onto paper to absorb the ghee and serve hot.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and onions and cut into fairly thick rounds; rub the onions with salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Cut the meat into even pieces.
instructions.3: Put the meat, onions and potatoes in a pot in alternating layers.
instructions.4: Pour in the liquid seasoned with salt and pepper and cover the pot.
instructions.5: Cook over low heat until tender, one to one and a half hours.
instructions.6: Serve with the meat in the center and the potatoes around it, hot.
instructions.7: Potato tagine: put the same ingredients in a tagine in alternating layers, finishing with potatoes on top; cover and bake in a moderate oven until done (one to one and a half hours), then uncover so the top browns; wrap the tagine with a paper frill and serve hot.

osool-531.title: Baked Potatoes with Poultry or Meat

osool-531-i3.name: A bird (goose, chicken or small duck) or leg meat

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes, cut into fairly thick rounds and keep in salted water until needed.
instructions.2: Peel the onions, slice into thin rings and rub well with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Strain half the tomatoes; peel the other half and slice into rounds.
instructions.4: Wash the bird or meat and leave whole or cut into fairly large pieces; season with salt and pepper and push half garlic cloves into it if using.
instructions.5: Layer the potatoes and onions alternately in a baking tray or tagine with the meat in the middle and the tomato rounds on top.
instructions.6: Pour over the strained tomatoes and the liquid and put the ghee on top.
instructions.7: Cover and bake in a moderate oven, removing the cover an hour before it is done so the top browns.
instructions.8: Serve hot.

instructions.1: Wash and peel the potatoes, cut each into 4 to 8 pieces depending on size, and put in cold salted water.
instructions.2: Pat the potatoes dry and fry them lightly, or leave them unfried.
instructions.3: Make the onion base: fry the onion in the ghee until golden, then add the meat and stir until browned, then the tomatoes and seasoning until the ghee separates; add the liquid and cook over low heat until the meat is half done.
instructions.4: Add the potatoes, cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender.

instructions.1: Wash the small potatoes and boil until nearly done, then peel while hot.
instructions.2: Heat a little ghee until very hot and fry the potatoes in it.
instructions.3: Lift out, drain of ghee, sprinkle with salt and pepper and serve hot.
instructions.4: Cuts for deep-frying: very thin slices (chips), matchsticks (straws), quarters like orange segments, or a continuous spiral ribbon; soak in cold salted water, then dry and fry in two stages: first in hot ghee until cooked but not browned, then again in hotter ghee until crisp and golden.

instructions.1: Melt the ghee over the heat, add the mashed potatoes and stir well; take off the heat and let cool, then add the egg yolks, salt and pepper and beat well.
instructions.2: Spread the mixture on a plate greased with ghee and leave until cold.
instructions.3: Cut into 8 to 10 pieces and shape like cutlets, inserting a piece of macaroni into the pointed end of each to represent the rib bone.
instructions.4: Coat twice in egg and breadcrumbs, then deep-fry.
instructions.5: Arrange neatly on a plate and serve hot with tomato sauce.

osool-535-i1.name: Small potatoes (for roasting) or large ones (for baking)

osool-535-i4.name: Grated rumi cheese and a little milk or cream (for stuffing)

instructions.1: Roast potatoes: choose small potatoes, wash, peel and put them in cold salted water; either leave raw or parboil them.
instructions.2: Dry well and place in a tray with a little ghee; roast in a fairly hot oven, opening it from time to time to baste the potatoes with the ghee in the tray.
instructions.3: Cook until tender (about an hour if raw, half an hour if parboiled).
instructions.4: Serve with roast meat and poultry.
instructions.5: Baked potatoes: choose large potatoes, wash well and prick lightly with a fork; bake in a hot oven until tender (half an hour to an hour and a half) and serve hot in their skins on a folded napkin with butter.
instructions.6: Cheese-stuffed potatoes: halve the baked potatoes and scoop out the insides with a teaspoon; mash the scooped potato and season with salt, pepper, grated rumi cheese and a little milk or cream; refill the shells, sprinkle the tops with cheese, dot with butter and bake in a hot oven until browned.

osool-536-i1.name: Potatoes, boiled and very finely mashed

instructions.1: Mash the potatoes very thoroughly.
instructions.2: Melt the butter, add the potatoes and stir well over low heat until the mixture comes together.
instructions.3: Take off the heat and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Beat the egg yolks well with a little salt and pepper, then add to the potatoes and stir thoroughly so the yolks are completely blended in.
instructions.5: Put the mixture into a piping bag fitted with a star tip; brush a tray with warm ghee and dust with a little fine rice flour.
instructions.6: Pipe the potato into medium rosettes, and set half a pistachio in the center of each if you like.
instructions.7: Brush the rosettes with lightly beaten egg and bake in a moderate oven for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.8: Serve at once, on their own or with meat dishes.

osool-537.title: Mashed Potato Bake with Spiced Mince

instructions.1: Make a potato purée with the egg yolks, ghee, salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Grease the tray with ghee and coat it well with a layer of fine breadcrumbs.
instructions.3: Spread half the potato in the tray in a completely even layer.
instructions.4: Spread the asag over this layer and press it down lightly by hand.
instructions.5: Cover the asag with the rest of the potato and smooth the top well.
instructions.6: Brush the top with egg and bake in a moderate oven until golden.
instructions.7: Turn out and serve whole if the tray is small and round, or cut into pieces, arrange on the plate and garnish with parsley.

instructions.1: Wash the spinach several times in cold water, pick off the leaves and boil them in a little salted boiling water with a pinch of baking soda until tender; drain well and chop on a board with a knife.
instructions.2: Put it in a greased ovenproof dish.
instructions.3: Make a white sauce with the butter, flour and milk, add the rumi cheese and season.
instructions.4: Pour the sauce over the top, sprinkle with breadcrumbs and dot with the remaining butter cut into small pieces.
instructions.5: Bake in a hot oven until the top browns and serve hot.
instructions.6: Spinach in stock: wash 1 kg spinach and chop coarsely; put in a pot with 1–1½ cups poultry stock, a whole onion, 1 tablespoon butter, salt and pepper and cook until tender.

instructions.1: Boil the spinach, drain it well and mince it in the machine or press through a sieve.
instructions.2: Add 2 tablespoons butter and stir over low heat.
instructions.3: Add the cheese, keeping back 1 tablespoon for the top.
instructions.4: Season with salt and pepper, put into a greased ovenproof dish and sprinkle the top with the grated cheese.
instructions.5: Dot the top with the remaining ½ tablespoon butter cut into very small pieces.
instructions.6: Bake in a hot oven until the top browns.
instructions.7: Spinach with cheese sauce: layer the drained boiled spinach and 1½ cups cheese sauce alternately in a greased dish, finishing with sauce, keeping back half the spinach to decorate the top; sprinkle with cheese, then breadcrumbs, dot with butter and bake in a hot oven until browned; garnish with mounds of boiled spinach and lemon slices.

instructions.1: Prepare and boil the spinach as usual.
instructions.2: Drain and chop finely with a knife or press through a sieve.
instructions.3: Make a thick white sauce with the flour, ghee and ½ cup milk.
instructions.4: Add the sauce to the spinach and boil for 3 minutes.
instructions.5: Season well and add a little milk until it has a medium consistency.
instructions.6: Spoon onto a plate and garnish with the fried bread triangles.

osool-541.title: Stewed Spinach with Dill and Rice

instructions.1: Wash the spinach and dill well, chop coarsely and wash again.
instructions.2: Make the onion base (onion fried in ghee with the meat, then the tomatoes), adding the chickpeas if using.
instructions.3: Add the spinach and dill before adding any liquid and cook over low heat, stirring from time to time.
instructions.4: Add some liquid whenever needed and simmer until nearly done.
instructions.5: Add the washed rice, if using, and cook until tender.
instructions.6: Add the garlic either with the onion base after browning, or raw with the spinach.
instructions.7: With taqliya: fry 1 tablespoon ghee with ½ head chopped garlic and 1 teaspoon ground coriander and add it to the spinach after taking it off the heat.

osool-542.title: Stewed Spinach in an Egg Case

instructions.1: Make the stewed spinach using minced meat.
instructions.2: Beat the eggs lightly and add the salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee until very hot in a small pot or mold, coat the sides completely with it, then pour off the excess.
instructions.4: Pour the eggs into the pot and swirl them evenly to coat the bottom and sides.
instructions.5: Drain the spinach of some of its liquid and put it inside the pot.
instructions.6: Set the pot over very low heat or in the oven for 5 to 10 minutes, moving it from time to time so the egg layer browns.
instructions.7: Let it settle briefly, then turn out onto a plate and serve hot.
instructions.8: Spinach mold: wash the spinach, remove just the roots and leave whole; sauté in ghee and lift out; make asag with tomatoes; layer the asag and spinach in a small pot, add water or stock and cook over low heat until done, then turn out onto a plate.
instructions.9: Spinach-stem mold: made like the spinach mold using spinach stems, cut 5 to 6 cm from the root end, cleaned, washed well and soaked in cold salted water for 15 minutes.

instructions.1: Beat the eggs, add the salt, pepper and the rest of the ingredients and mix everything well.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee until very hot; pour in a coffee-cup measure of the mixture, and when the underside browns, turn it to brown the other side.
instructions.3: Repeat until the mixture is used up.
instructions.4: Arrange on a plate, garnish with parsley and serve hot with tomato sauce.
instructions.5: Spinach timbales: press 1 kg boiled spinach through a sieve and add 1 tablespoon butter, 2 whole eggs, 3 beaten yolks, salt and pepper; pour into small greased molds, cover with greased paper and steam for 40 minutes, or bake in a tray of water in the oven for 25 to 30 minutes, then turn out.
instructions.6: Large spinach mold: make the same fritter mixture; heat 1 tablespoon ghee until very hot in a mold or small pot and quickly coat the sides; pour in the mixture and bake in a moderate oven for half an hour, then let it settle briefly and turn out.

osool-544-i1.name: Spinach purée (boiled and chopped, in white sauce)

osool-544-i3.name: Boiling water with a little vinegar and salt (for poaching)

instructions.1: Make the spinach purée and put it in a greased ovenproof dish.
instructions.2: Poach the eggs one at a time: break each egg into a cup and slide it into gently simmering water with a little vinegar and salt until the white sets and the yolk stays soft, then lift out with a slotted spoon.
instructions.3: Place the eggs carefully on top of the spinach and sprinkle with a little salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Reheat the dish in a low oven for 5 minutes and serve at once.

instructions.1: Pick the mallow leaves and the chard, wash repeatedly and boil in a little water.
instructions.2: Wash the meat, cut into medium pieces and boil with the onion; shortly before it is done, add the washed rice and cook until tender.
instructions.3: Drain the mallow and chop the dill and fresh coriander, if using; add them to the broth, season with salt and pepper and boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Take off the heat; make the taqliya with the garlic, ghee and coriander and add it to the mallow.

instructions.1: Pick the mallow leaves, wash well and dry, then fry in the ghee and lift out.
instructions.2: Fry the onion in the remaining ghee, then add the meat and stir; cover with the broth or water and chickpeas and bring to a boil.
instructions.3: Add the mallow and cook until tender.
instructions.4: Take off the heat; make the taqliya with the coriander, garlic and ghee and add it to the mallow.

osool-547-i9.name: Lemon juice and oil for the beans

instructions.1: Make the sprouted fava bean soup: peel and wash the beans; fry the mastic in the oil, add water and bring to a boil, then add the beans and onion and cook until tender, skimming off the scum.
instructions.2: Prepare the molokhia: wash, pick off the leaves and dry them, then chop finely or mince with a mezzaluna.
instructions.3: Drain the beans, leave them whole and serve them as a salad with some oil and lemon; use the broth to make the molokhia.
instructions.4: Add the molokhia to the boiling broth and stir well until it separates; let it come to the boil twice, uncovered.
instructions.5: Crush the garlic and coriander and fry in the oil, then add this taqliya to the molokhia and cover tightly.

osool-548-i3.name: Coarsely minced meat or poultry pieces

instructions.1: Wash the molokhia, pick off the leaves and dry them well.
instructions.2: Fry the whole molokhia leaves in ghee over medium heat, keeping their green color, then lift out into a colander.
instructions.3: Fry the onion lightly, then add the meat and stir over the heat for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Wash the chickpeas and add them to the meat along with the stock or water; season with salt and pepper, cover the pot and cook over low heat until nearly done.
instructions.5: Add the fried molokhia and boil for 15 to 20 minutes, then take the pot off the heat.
instructions.6: Make the taqliya and add it to the molokhia.
instructions.7: Crushed borani: prepare and fry the molokhia as above, then crush it well; add to the stew, boil for 10 minutes, then add the taqliya.
instructions.8: Mixed borani: fry half the molokhia and chop it coarsely; chop the other half finely while green; cook the stew and add both kinds, boil for 6 to 10 minutes, then add the taqliya.

instructions.1: Wash the molokhia and pick the leaves, then chop finely with a mezzaluna or by hand.
instructions.2: Clean the fish, cut into steaks and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Heat the oil until very hot and fry the onion until golden, then add the garlic and coriander and stir until the garlic is golden.
instructions.4: Add a liter of water and bring to a boil, then add the fish, lower the heat and cook until done.
instructions.5: Lift out the fish and serve it on its own, garnished with parsley; use the broth to make the molokhia.
instructions.6: Add the prepared molokhia to the broth, stirring well, and let it come to the boil twice, uncovered, then take off the heat.

instructions.1: Wash the chard well, pick off the leaves and shred them finely with a knife or mezzaluna.
instructions.2: Make the taqliya with the ghee, garlic and coriander, if using, then add the stock and bring to a boil.
instructions.3: Add the chard and boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Add the dried molokhia, stirring well, let it come to the boil twice, then take off the heat.

osool-551-i1.name: Large loaf of toasted bread, broken up

instructions.1: Add the molokhia to the toasted bread and toss gently; cover and leave until the bread softens.
instructions.2: Layer the fatta and rice alternately, finishing with a layer of rice on top.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee until very hot, fry the garlic in it and drizzle over the top; serve hot.

osool-552.title: Green Peppers: Boiled with French Dressing or Fried with Vinegar

osool-552-i3.name: French dressing (oil and vinegar or lemon, salt and pepper)

instructions.1: Bring the water to a boil, add the salt and boil the washed peppers, then drain.
instructions.2: Peel off the thin outer skin, keeping the peppers' shape, and remove the stems.
instructions.3: Dress with the French dressing, arrange on a plate and garnish with chopped parsley.
instructions.4: Fried peppers: wash and dry the peppers, slit them slightly on the side and salt them; heat the oil until very hot and fry the peppers, then remove the outer skin and stems; fry the garlic in a little oil, add the vinegar and salt and boil for 3 minutes; arrange the peppers on a plate, dress with the garlic vinegar and serve cold.

instructions.1: Trim the leeks and cut the white part into even pieces.
instructions.2: Wash in cold water, then boil in salted boiling water.
instructions.3: Drain, arrange on a plate and cover with the sauce; garnish with parsley and serve.
instructions.4: Or put them in an ovenproof dish, cover with the sauce, sprinkle the top with a few breadcrumbs, dot with small pieces of butter and bake in a hot oven until browned.

instructions.1: Prepare the leeks, cut the white part and boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: Sauté the leeks in the ghee and lift out.
instructions.3: Arrange the leeks and the asag with tomatoes in a small pot or ovenproof dish and add the water.
instructions.4: Bake in a low oven or cook over low heat until done.
instructions.5: Stuffed leek mold: drain the boiled leeks, hollow out part of the center of each piece and fill with asag; arrange in a small pot or ovenproof dish, add cold water and cook over low heat or in the oven until done.
instructions.6: Leeks in tomato sauce: half-boil the cut leeks in salted boiling water; make the tomato sauce, add ¼ kg meat and cook until nearly done, then add the leeks and cook until tender.

osool-555.title: Celery Hearts in White or Cheese Sauce

osool-555-i3.name: White sauce or rumi cheese sauce

instructions.1: Trim the celery and cut the white part into even pieces; keep them in cold water with lemon juice until needed.
instructions.2: Boil in boiling water with lemon juice and salt until tender, then drain.
instructions.3: Serve hot with butter, or with buttered toast.
instructions.4: In white sauce: cut the celery lengthwise into medium pieces, arrange on a plate, cover with white sauce and garnish with parsley; or put in an ovenproof dish, cover with the sauce, sprinkle with breadcrumbs and bake in a hot oven until browned.
instructions.5: In cheese sauce: layer the celery in an ovenproof dish with a little grated cheese between the layers, cover with cheese sauce, sprinkle with breadcrumbs, dot with butter and bake in a hot oven until browned.

instructions.1: Leave the taro whole, wipe it with a damp cloth and bake in a hot oven until tender.
instructions.2: Peel the cooked taro and mash it, then add the butter, milk, salt and pepper and mix well.
instructions.3: Serve with grilled liver and meats, or on its own garnished with fried eggs.

osool-557.title: Taro in Tomato Sauce and Taro Moussaka

instructions.1: Peel the taro and cut into medium-thick slices; do not wash it at all.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee until very hot, fry the taro in it and lift out.
instructions.3: Cut the meat into small pieces, wash, then brown it in the ghee left from frying the taro.
instructions.4: Add the strained tomatoes and cook until done, then add the vinegar, then the taro, and stir briefly.
instructions.5: Add enough water to cover the taro, season with salt and pepper and cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.6: Taro moussaka: peel the taro, cut each lengthwise into quarters and then into ½ cm thick pieces, and fry lightly; layer alternately with an onion base made with minced meat in a pot or tagine, pour over the liquid and cook until tender.

osool-558.title: Purslane: Boiled, with Oil and Lemon, or Stewed

osool-558-i3.name: French dressing (oil, lemon, salt and pepper)

instructions.1: Wash the purslane several times in cold water and pick off the leaves.
instructions.2: Boiled: boil in a little salted boiling water until tender and drain.
instructions.3: With oil and lemon: let the boiled purslane cool, chop it coarsely and add the French dressing just before serving.
instructions.4: In stock: put the coarsely chopped purslane in a pot with 1–1½ cups stock, a whole onion, 1 tablespoon butter, salt and pepper and cook until tender.
instructions.5: Stewed: make the onion base with the meat and tomatoes in the ghee, add the chopped purslane before adding any liquid and stir over low heat; add liquid as needed until nearly done, then add the rice or chickpeas and cook until tender (without dill).

osool-559.title: Okra with Chard and Garlic Paste (Khodra)

instructions.1: Wash the okra and let it dry, then trim the tops into a cone shape.
instructions.2: Half-boil the meat with the onion, skimming off the scum whenever it appears, then add the okra and cook until tender.
instructions.3: Prepare the chard: wash, remove the ribs and shred; peel the garlic and chop it finely.
instructions.4: Fry the chard briefly in the ghee, then add the garlic and stir until golden; then mash the chard very thoroughly until smooth.
instructions.5: Add the green paste to the okra and boil for 5 minutes.

instructions.1: Prepare the okra, fry it lightly in the ghee and lift out.
instructions.2: Make the onion base in the remaining ghee: brown the onion, then add the meat, then the strained tomatoes and seasoning until the ghee separates.
instructions.3: Lift the meat out of the sauce and put a layer of it in the bottom of a small pot; arrange the okra neatly on top, then put the rest of the meat in the center.
instructions.4: Fill the pot with the okra, add the onion base and close the lid tightly.
instructions.5: Cook over low heat until done, and turn out onto a plate when ready to serve.
instructions.6: Okra mold with minced meat: made as above, but with the onion base made with minced meat instead of cubes.
instructions.7: Okra mold, third method: clean the okra, fry lightly and lift out; sauté the chopped onion briefly in the remaining ghee, add the cubed meat and stir, then add a little water and cook for 15 minutes; lift out the meat and arrange it in the bottom of the pot with a layer of onion, then arrange the okra, add the tomato juice and the rest of the water and cook over low heat; a sliced carrot can be added with the meat.

instructions.1: Wash the dried okra well, then boil in boiling water until tender.
instructions.2: Make the onion base (adding the chopped garlic when the onion turns golden) and cook over low heat until nearly done.
instructions.3: Add the boiled okra and cook over low heat until fully done.

instructions.1: Prepare the okra, then slice it thinly, fry in the ghee and lift out.
instructions.2: Fry the onion in the remaining ghee until golden, then add the meat and brown it.
instructions.3: Add the liquid, season and cook until the meat is half done, then add the okra.
instructions.4: Stir well with a spoon so the okra breaks down, and cook until done; adjust the seasoning.
instructions.5: Make the taqliya with the ghee, coriander and garlic and add it to the wika.
instructions.6: Wika with spiced mince: made as above but using asag instead of cubed meat.
instructions.7: Dried okra wika: fry ⅛ kg dried okra well, then pound until fine; add 2 tablespoons ghee, ½ kg asag, 1 cup strained tomatoes, meat or poultry stock, salt, pepper and chili; cook over low heat until done, then season and add the taqliya.

osool-563-i2.name: Water, salt and lemon juice (1 tablespoon per liter)

osool-563-i4.name: French dressing, white sauce or cheese sauce

instructions.1: Wash the asparagus, then scrape the white part, working from the tip toward the stalk; remove any tough pieces, trim the ends even and wash again.
instructions.2: Keep in cold water until needed, then tie with linen string into even bundles (8 to 10 spears per bundle).
instructions.3: Bring the water to a boil with the salt and lemon juice and boil the asparagus in it.
instructions.4: Serve hot with bread and butter, or as you like.
instructions.5: With French dressing: drain the asparagus, cut into 5 cm lengths, dress with French dressing for 10 minutes, arrange on a plate and garnish with parsley.
instructions.6: With white sauce or cheese sauce: drain the asparagus, dry with a towel and cut into 5 cm lengths; arrange in an ovenproof dish, cover with the sauce, sprinkle with breadcrumbs, dot with butter and bake in a hot oven until browned.
instructions.7: Sautéed asparagus: cut the boiled asparagus into suitable pieces; melt the butter and gently toss the asparagus in it for a few minutes; sprinkle with salt, pepper and parsley.

osool-564.title: Fresh Fava Beans with Greens (Chard, Dill and Coriander)

instructions.1: Prepare the fava beans like green beans (wash, remove the strings and cut).
instructions.2: Wash the fresh coriander and dill, then chop.
instructions.3: Cut the meat into medium pieces and sauté in 1 tablespoon ghee.
instructions.4: Add the herbs (dill and coriander), the meat and the onions and sauté over low heat for a quarter of an hour.
instructions.5: Add the water and bring to a boil, then add the prepared beans and cook until nearly tender; add the rice.
instructions.6: Crush the garlic and coriander seed; pick and cut the chard.
instructions.7: Fry the chard in the remaining ghee, then add the garlic and coriander.
instructions.8: Crush the chard until completely smooth, add it to the cooked beans and boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.9: Fresh fava beans boiled, with oil and lemon, or stewed: made in the same ways as green beans.

instructions.1: Wash and dry the tomatoes, cut off the tops, keeping them as lids, and remove the seeds.
instructions.2: Season the tomatoes with salt and pepper and turn upside down to drain their juice.
instructions.3: Fill with the sautéed vegetables.
instructions.4: Make a bed of lettuce on a plate and arrange the tomatoes on it, each filled with a different sautéed vegetable.
instructions.5: Boiled vegetables dressed with French dressing can be used instead of sautéed vegetables.

osool-566-i5.name: Melted ghee for brushing the tomatoes

instructions.1: Wash and dry the tomatoes, cut a small piece off the top of each and remove the seeds.
instructions.2: Season the tomatoes with a little salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Mix the cheese with the breadcrumbs and stuff the tomatoes with it.
instructions.4: Brush the outside of the tomatoes with a little melted ghee and place in a greased tray.
instructions.5: Bake in a moderate oven for 7 minutes.
instructions.6: Butter the toasted bread, arrange it neatly on a plate and set the tomatoes on top; garnish with parsley and serve hot.

osool-567.title: Tomato Stew with Meat and Rice

instructions.1: Make the onion base using half the tomatoes: brown the onion in the ghee, then add the meat, then half the strained tomatoes and the seasoning until the ghee separates.
instructions.2: Add the rest of the strained tomatoes, a little water, salt and pepper and cook until the meat is nearly tender.
instructions.3: Wash the rice and add it to the tomatoes; lower the heat and cook until done.

instructions.1: Wash and dry the tomatoes, then cut each in half crosswise.
instructions.2: Sprinkle with salt and pepper, then with breadcrumbs, and put a small piece of butter on each half.
instructions.3: Arrange in a greased tray and bake in a hot oven for 5 to 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Serve with meat dishes and roast poultry.

osool-569.title: French-Style Lamb and Spring Vegetable Stew (Torly)

instructions.1: Cut the meat into pieces and prepare the vegetables, leaving them whole.
instructions.2: Bring the water to a boil and add the meat, carrots and onions; season everything with salt and pepper.
instructions.3: Cover the pot and cook over low heat for half an hour.
instructions.4: Add the potatoes, peas and mint, cover and cook until everything is tender.
instructions.5: Ladle into a deep dish and serve hot.

osool-570-i1.name: Mixed vegetables (potatoes, carrots, peas and cauliflower)

osool-570-i3.name: For the curry sauce: small onion

osool-570-i5.name: For the curry sauce: curry powder

osool-570-i8.name: For the curry sauce: chopped apple and lemon juice

instructions.1: Prepare the vegetables according to their kind.
instructions.2: Make the curry sauce: fry the onion in the ghee, then add the curry powder, flour and apple, then the stock gradually, stirring until it boils; add the lemon.
instructions.3: Add the meat to the sauce and simmer for half an hour, then add the vegetables.
instructions.4: Cook over low heat until tender.
instructions.5: Spoon onto a plate with the boiled rice around it.

osool-571.title: Boiled Onions in White Sauce and Braised Pearl Onions

osool-571-i5.name: For the braised onions: stock or water

instructions.1: Peel the onions and trim a little off the top and bottom.
instructions.2: Put them in cold water on the heat and boil for 10 minutes.
instructions.3: Discard the water, replace it with fresh water and cook again until tender.
instructions.4: Drain and wrap in a towel while hot, covering them well so they do not discolor.
instructions.5: In white sauce: arrange the onions on the plate if small, or cut each in half; cover with the hot white sauce, garnish with parsley and serve.
instructions.6: Braised pearl onions: peel the small onions without trimming the tops, wash and dry them, and brown in the ghee; add a little liquid, season, cover the pot and cook over low heat until tender; serve with meats.

instructions.1: Add a little salt to the onions and stir over medium heat until they absorb their liquid and turn golden, sprinkling with a very little water whenever they dry out, until fully browned; then add the ghee and stir for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: Add the strained tomatoes and the meat and stir everything over low heat for 10 minutes, then pour in a little liquid and boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Put the onions and meat into a tagine, cover and bake in the oven, removing the lid shortly before it is done so the top browns.
instructions.4: Wrap a paper frill around the tagine and serve on a plate.
instructions.5: Fried onions for garnish: peel the onions and slice into thin rings, or chop finely or coarsely, or leave small ones whole; or coat the rings in flour, dip in egg white and then flour again, or in egg and breadcrumbs; fry in very hot ghee or oil and lift onto paper.
instructions.6: Roasted onions: put the onions in their skins in a tray and roast in the oven until tender, or peel them, wrap in greased paper and cook in the oven until tender.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee or oil and sauté the onion until golden, then lightly toast the flour in it and set aside to cool.
instructions.2: Whisk the eggs seasoned with salt, pepper, mint, and parsley, then add them to the cooled onion and flour mixture and mix well.
instructions.3: Prepare a pan with a little hot oil and pour in the mixture over low heat until the top browns, then carefully flip onto the other side until the surface is golden, and transfer to a plate.

instructions.1: Grate the onion and rub it with salt, pepper, and mint.
instructions.2: Whisk the eggs well, then mix them with the onion and the tablespoon of milk or cream.
instructions.3: Heat the oil in a pan and pour in the egg mixture, shaking the pan to ensure the omelet sets and the surface browns.
instructions.4: Gently flip to the other side until the other surface browns, then serve on a plate.
instructions.5: You can add olives while whisking the eggs, or diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, chopped peppers, or thin fried potatoes for a lovely flavor; alternatively, you can add minced meat (osag) or luncheon meat slices—mix these ingredients thoroughly with the whisked eggs before pouring into the pan.

instructions.1: Heat the oil or ghee, then add the grated onion and sauté until it turns golden.
instructions.2: Add the finely chopped pepper and the chopped or grated tomato, and stir briefly with the onion.
instructions.3: Whisk the eggs and season with salt, pepper, and spices, then add them to the mixture and stir well over medium heat until the eggs are set.
instructions.4: Serve in a dish while hot.

instructions.1: Sauté the garlic in oil or ghee until golden, then add the tomatoes.
instructions.2: Once the tomatoes are cooked, pour in the fava beans and season with salt and cumin over low heat until boiling.
instructions.3: Whisk the eggs well and season with salt.
instructions.4: Prepare a Pyrex dish sized to the amount of beans and eggs, pour in the bean mixture, and pour the eggs over it.
instructions.5: Place in a medium-heat oven until the top is golden brown.

instructions.1: Peel the fava beans and mash them well with a fork.
instructions.2: Sauté the onion in oil or ghee until golden, then remove and let it cool slightly.
instructions.3: Whisk the eggs and season with salt, pepper, and cumin, then mix in the sautéed onions.
instructions.4: Add the mashed fava beans and parsley to the egg and onion mixture and mix well.
instructions.5: Heat a little oil in a non-stick pan, pour in the mixture, and fry it like an omelet, flipping to cook both sides.
instructions.6: Garnish with parsley.

instructions.1: Sauté the onion in oil or ghee until golden, then add the minced garlic and coriander.
instructions.2: Add the cup of tomatoes to the onion over low heat until the tomatoes are cooked through.
instructions.3: Add the fava beans and stir for about 10 minutes, adding water if necessary.
instructions.4: Add the chopped parsley, stir with the beans, and remove from heat.
instructions.5: Add the minced meat mixture (asaag) to the beans according to taste.

sv7-5.name: green pepper, shredded cheese, and olives (for garnish)

instructions.1: Whisk the egg and season with a little salt, pepper, and mint.
instructions.2: Dip the slice of toast into the egg and let it sit for a moment to soak, then carefully flip it to the other side until the egg is fully absorbed.
instructions.3: Place butter in a small non-stick pan and heat it, then carefully place the toast in the pan over low heat.
instructions.4: After a short while, carefully flip it to the other side until both sides turn golden brown, then remove and place on a plate.
instructions.5: Garnish using small slices of green pepper with shredded Romano cheese and sliced olives; alternatively, you can spread the toast with any type of cheese and top with luncheon meat slices, green pepper slices, and olives around it.

instructions.1: Prepare a small bowl and mix the za'atar with the oil.
instructions.2: Season the toast with the za'atar mixture, then carefully coat it in flour or breadcrumbs.
instructions.3: Toast on both sides in butter or oil until golden.
instructions.4: You can place another slice of toast on top, prepared in the same manner.

sv9-5.name: salt, pepper, mixed spices, and thyme

instructions.1: Carefully flatten the slice of toast using a rolling pin.
instructions.2: Sauté the onion in oil, then mix it with a little of the shredded chicken seasoned with salt, pepper, spices, and thyme.
instructions.3: Stuff the toast with a small amount of this mixture.
instructions.4: Roll the toast into a finger shape, then coat it in flour, then egg, and finally breadcrumbs.
instructions.5: Place in the refrigerator until firm, then fry in hot oil.
instructions.6: Repeat this process according to the number of family members.

instructions.1: Cut the toast into circles and spread the surface with mayonnaise or a tahini sauce mixed with vinegar, water, salt, and cumin.
instructions.2: Mix the cooked peas with a small amount of the grated carrots and the cream cheese triangles.
instructions.3: Spread this mixture onto the toast that has been spread with mayonnaise or tahini.
instructions.4: Cover with another slice of toast, then dip in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, pressing with your hand until they stick together, then fry in oil on both sides.

sv11-4.name: osag (savory minced meat; see Bab Al Lahm)

instructions.1: Sauté the minced garlic in oil with the green pepper.
instructions.2: Spread this mixture onto the toast.
instructions.3: Layer the osag on top, followed by the cheese squares and the luncheon meat slices.
instructions.4: Cover with a second slice of toast and garnish with lettuce and tomato rings.

sv12-2.name: flour
sv12-2.standardAmount: as needed for a sticky dough

instructions.1: Dissolve a little salt in the yogurt and stir well, then gradually add the flour while stirring continuously until a medium-soft dough forms.
instructions.2: Cover and leave in a warm place for more than an hour.
instructions.3: Boil just enough broth to match the amount of dough so the kishk does not become too liquid.
instructions.4: Add the yogurt and flour mixture to the broth, stirring continuously with a whisk over medium heat.
instructions.5: Let the mixture boil for 5 minutes, stirring constantly until the consistency thickens.
instructions.6: Fry the onion in ghee or oil, then pour only half of it over the kishk, stir well, and remove from heat.
instructions.7: Serve in bowls and garnish with the remaining fried onions.

quick-01.title: Chicken Shawarma Sandwich with Lebanese Cream

instructions.1: Slice the raw chicken into thin, small pieces and add the minced garlic and ghee or oil; season with thyme, red pepper, and 1 tsp of curry.
instructions.2: Place in a pot over low heat until the liquid evaporates, adding a little water if necessary until cooked through.
instructions.3: Stir the cream with a wooden spoon, pour it over the chicken, and mix well; then leave over low heat for approximately 5 minutes while stirring.
instructions.4: Season with thyme, red pepper, and curry.
instructions.5: Stuff into the serving bread.

instructions.1: Sauté the sliced onion in oil, then add the sliced tomatoes and sliced peppers, and add them to the chicken breast pieces.
instructions.2: Transfer to a pot over low heat and add water until cooked through.
instructions.3: Pour the labneh over the chicken and stir over low heat for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Stuff into serving bread.

instructions.1: Mix the minced chicken with the onion, garlic, egg, salt, pepper, spices, and oil thoroughly, then let it rest in the refrigerator for 2 hours.
instructions.2: Shape the mixture into round patties.
instructions.3: Heat oil in a non-stick pan and place each patty in the pan over low heat, flipping until cooked through.
instructions.4: Prepare the buns by filling them with the chicken patties, adding ketchup, green pepper slices, and cheddar cheese.

qk4-5.name: Salt, pepper, mixed spices, thyme, and dried mint

instructions.1: Prepare the Kaiser rolls by cutting them from the top and removing the bread crumb from the center.
instructions.2: Finely chop the boiled chicken or beef (pastirma can also be used).
instructions.3: Add the shredded cheese and the egg to the meat, season with all the spices, and mix well.
instructions.4: Prepare the rolls and stuff them using a spoon through the top opening.
instructions.5: Arrange them in a greased tray and bake in the oven for 10 minutes.
instructions.6: After removing from the oven, seal the top opening with an olive.

instructions.1: Finely chop the boiled, roasted, or grilled chicken and season it with salt, pepper, and spices.
instructions.2: Mix the yogurt with the vinegar, lemon juice, and finely chopped green pepper; you may also add 1 tsp of mustard, then mix thoroughly with the seasoned chicken.
instructions.3: Prepare the kaizer rolls or Baladi bread by cutting them into 4 parts, separating the top from the bottom, and lightly brushing them with butter.
instructions.4: Place 1 tbsp of the mixture onto the bread and fold it like a croissant, or stuff the mixture into the kaizer rolls.
instructions.5: Wrap the bread or rolls in foil, repeating until the mixture is finished.
instructions.6: Place them on a tray and bake in the oven for 15 minutes.
instructions.7: Serve on plates lined with lettuce leaves.

instructions.1: Mix the yogurt with the cooked minced meat and stir well, then add the finely chopped green pepper, garlic, minced parsley, and mustard to the mixture.
instructions.2: Place the mixture in an ungreased tray, top with tomato slices and plenty of lemon juice, and turn on the broiler until the meat is fully absorbed.
instructions.3: Prepare the kaizer rolls to be stuffed with the mixture.

qk7-1.name: Chicken pane breaded with egg and breadcrumbs (see Bab Al Lahom recipe)

instructions.1: After frying the chicken pane, prepare the Kaiser rolls and spread them with mayonnaise.
instructions.2: Place the chicken pane inside the rolls, then top with ketchup, lettuce leaves, a slice of luncheon meat, green pepper rings, and finally the cheese slices.

quick-08.title: Tuna Sandwich with Mayonnaise or Tahini

instructions.1: Drain the tuna from the oil, then mix it with the mayonnaise (or the tahini mixed with water, vinegar, and lemon juice).
instructions.2: Add the finely chopped pickles, minced garlic, finely chopped green onion, and small tomato pieces, then mix well.
instructions.3: Place the filling inside the kaiser rolls and top with bell pepper rings.

db96-7.name: Milk or yogurt
db96-7.standardAmount: 1 cup or 1 large cup of yogurt

instructions.1: Beat the butter or ghee thoroughly until it turns pale, then gradually add the sugar while continuing to whisk.
instructions.2: Add the eggs one by one, beating well after each addition, then add the vanilla and lemon zest.
instructions.3: Mix the flour with the baking powder and add it gradually, alternating with the milk or yogurt, until the mixture is combined.
instructions.4: Grease a baking pan with ghee and dust it with flour, then pour in the batter and bake in a medium-heat oven until done.
instructions.5: You can color a portion of the batter with cocoa to create a marbled cake.

instructions.1: Combine the baking powder and a pinch of salt with the flour.
instructions.2: Beat the eggs, then gradually add the sugar, followed by a gradual addition of the oil.
instructions.3: Gradually pour in the flour mixture, sprinkle with cinnamon, and finally add the carrots, mixing well by hand.
instructions.4: Grease the baking pan, pour in the mixture, spread it evenly, and shake the pan before placing it in the oven.
instructions.5: Once removed from the oven, do not cover the pan until it has cooled completely.

instructions.1: Combine the baking powder and a pinch of salt with the flour.
instructions.2: Cream the sugar and butter together with a whisk, then add the semolina and coconut, mixing well.
instructions.3: Whisk the egg whites with the vanilla and fold them into the previous mixture.
instructions.4: Add the flour to the dough and knead well until homogeneous.
instructions.5: Cut the dough into eye shapes and arrange them on a lightly greased baking tray.
instructions.6: Bake in a medium-heat oven until cooked through.
instructions.7: Drizzle with cold simple syrup and arrange on a serving plate.

vl40-5.name: minced meat filling (see Bab Al Louhoum)

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes, peel them, and mash them thoroughly.
instructions.2: Prepare a pan, melt the ghee or butter in it, then add the mashed potatoes.
instructions.3: Remove from heat and let it cool, then season with salt, pepper, and shredded cheese.
instructions.4: Place a little oil in a small dish to lightly grease your hands so the potato dough does not stick.
instructions.5: Shape into small balls and make a well in the center to fill with the minced meat.
instructions.6: Dip the balls in the egg, then the breadcrumbs, and fry in generous oil.

bk10-6.name: minced meat mixture (optional, see Bab al-Lahm)
