instructions.12: Before serving, let the ice cream soften for 10 minutes, then serve.

fah-784.title: Ice Cream Cake
fah-784.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-784.culturalNotes: You can use different ice cream flavours as you like. The cake keeps in the freezer for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Make the cake: mix the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the eggs and vanilla and mix until combined.
instructions.3: Pour the cake batter into a greased, floured tray.
instructions.4: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 20 minutes, or until golden.
instructions.5: Take the cake out of the oven and leave it to cool.
instructions.6: Make the vanilla ice cream: mix the vanilla ice cream powder with the chilled milk and whip for 7 minutes.
instructions.7: Make the chocolate ice cream: mix the chocolate ice cream powder with the chilled milk and whip for 7 minutes.
instructions.8: Drizzle a light syrup over the cooled cake.
instructions.9: Spread the chocolate ice cream over the cake evenly.
instructions.10: Spread the vanilla ice cream over the chocolate layer evenly.
instructions.11: Gently shake the tin to level the ice cream.
instructions.12: Freeze the cake for 5–6 hours until set.
instructions.13: Take the cake out and decorate with the ice cream balls and chocolate sauce.

fah-158.title: Artichokes with Béchamel
fah-158.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-158.culturalNotes: Boiled artichokes keep in the freezer for a long time. Serve the dish hot with a green salad.

instructions.1: Wash the artichokes and peel them with a sharp knife, then remove the inner heart with a spoon.
instructions.2: Soak the artichokes in boiling water for 3 minutes, then rinse with cold water if storing.
instructions.3: In a pan over the heat, melt the ghee or oil, add the chopped onion and sauté until golden.
instructions.4: Add the minced meat and stir well, then add the salt, pepper, sugar, cinnamon and seven-spice and stir well.
instructions.5: In a pot over the heat, melt the ghee or butter, add the flour and stir until pale.
instructions.6: Add the warm milk gradually while stirring constantly, then add the salt, pepper, nutmeg, Kiri cheese and cream and stir well — this is the béchamel.
instructions.7: Grease a tagine with ghee or butter, stuff the artichokes with the seasoned meat and arrange them in the tagine.
instructions.8: Pour the béchamel over the artichokes, then top with the eshta and milk mixture.
instructions.9: Place the tagine in a preheated hot oven until the top browns.

fah-159.title: Oil-Free Aubergine & Pepper Salad
fah-159.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-159.culturalNotes: An appetising dish that works on its own or alongside koshari, potatoes and beans. It also makes a good breakfast plate.

instructions.1: Cut the aubergines into medium cubes.
instructions.2: Cut the peppers into large pieces — use hot or sweet peppers as you like.
instructions.3: Prepare a pot of boiling water and add a tablespoon of salt and two tablespoons of vinegar.
instructions.4: Add the aubergine and peppers to the boiling water, cover the pot and leave for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: After 10 minutes, drain the aubergine and peppers in a colander to remove excess water.
instructions.6: Put the aubergine and peppers in a dish, add a little olive oil and chopped fresh coriander.
instructions.7: Toss the ingredients together well.
instructions.8: Add a little vinegar and toss once more.

fah-160.title: Crispy Cauliflower Pané
fah-160.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-160.culturalNotes: Don't press the cauliflower flat when coating it — keep the coating loose so it stays crunchy. The coated cauliflower can be frozen before frying and used later.

instructions.1: Wash the cauliflower well and cut it into small florets.
instructions.2: Bring a pot of water to the boil, then add a tablespoon of salt and a teaspoon of cumin.
instructions.3: Drop the cauliflower into the boiling water and blanch briefly, then drain and transfer to cold water to stop the cooking.
instructions.4: Mix the flour, cornflour and spices (salt, pepper, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, baking powder) in a bowl.
instructions.5: Add the beaten eggs, minced garlic and parsley to half of the dry mixture, then add water gradually while stirring until the consistency is like pancake batter.
instructions.6: Dip the cauliflower florets in the wet batter, then coat them in the dry mixture.
instructions.7: Fry the cauliflower in hot oil over medium heat until golden and crisp.
instructions.8: Serve the cauliflower pané on a bed of chopped parsley.

fah-161.title: Boiled & Pickled Potatoes
fah-161.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-161.culturalNotes: Boiled potatoes keep in the fridge and can be used in different recipes.

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes in salted water until firm-tender.
instructions.2: Peel the potatoes and cut them into cubes.
instructions.3: Mix the duqqa with the oil and turmeric.
instructions.4: Add the duqqa mixture to the cubed potatoes and toss well.
instructions.5: Add the dill and parsley and toss together.
instructions.6: Serve in the serving dish.

fah-162.title: Crispy Potato Cubes
fah-162.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-162.culturalNotes: Serve the fried potatoes as a snack or as part of a main meal. Fresh herbs like parsley or coriander add flavour.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and cut them into small cubes.
instructions.2: Rinse the cubes well in cold water.
instructions.3: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
instructions.4: Add the potato cubes to the hot oil and stir well.
instructions.5: Add the salt, black pepper and sugar and stir together.
instructions.6: Keep frying until the potatoes are golden and crisp.
instructions.7: Drain the fried potatoes on absorbent paper.

fah-163.title: Pickled Cucumber & Carrots
fah-163.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-163.culturalNotes: Always use a clean, dry spoon when serving pickles to avoid scum forming. The pickles keep in the fridge for up to two weeks.

instructions.1: Wash the cucumbers and carrots well and slice them thinly.
instructions.2: Place them in a bowl with the pepper slices and celery.
instructions.3: Make the brine: boil a litre of water and add 4 tablespoons of salt, a tablespoon of sugar, a teaspoon of turmeric and a quarter cup of vinegar. Stir well.
instructions.4: Pour the brine over the cucumbers and carrots in the bowl.
instructions.5: Add the bay leaves, nigella seeds, garlic, hot chilli, coriander and cumin.
instructions.6: Cover the bowl well and leave for at least 6 hours.
instructions.7: After 6 hours the cucumber is ready to eat; leave the carrots for another day or two.
instructions.8: Add a few drops of oil on top of the pickle to preserve it.

fah-164.title: Spinach with Orzo
fah-164.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-164.culturalNotes: Serve the spinach with orzo alongside rice with vermicelli and browned meat. Leftovers keep in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Heat a pot over the heat and add a tablespoon of ghee.
instructions.2: Add the bay leaf, mastic, cardamom pod and black pepper.
instructions.3: Add the carrot, onion and tomatoes and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the beef shank and stir until browned and sealed.
instructions.5: Add the boiling water, salt and sugar, then cover the pot and leave over low heat until the meat is cooked.
instructions.6: In another pot, heat the ghee and oil, add the orzo and stir until golden.
instructions.7: Add the chopped tomatoes, stock cube, salt and sugar, stir together and leave the tomatoes to thicken.
instructions.8: Add the spinach and coriander and stir well until it thickens.
instructions.9: Add the orzo to the spinach, stir together, then cover the pot and leave over low heat for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: In a small pot, heat two tablespoons of oil and a spoonful of ghee, add the vermicelli and stir until golden.
instructions.11: Add the rice and stir with the vermicelli until combined.
instructions.12: Add the boiling water and salt, cover the pot and leave the rice to absorb.
instructions.13: Once absorbed, give the rice a light stir, then cover and leave over low heat until cooked.
instructions.14: In another pot, heat a little oil and ghee, add the meat and stir until browned.
instructions.15: Add the salt, black pepper and parsley, and stir until the meat is cooked.

fah-165.title: Pickled Tomatoes
fah-165.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-165.culturalNotes: Pickled tomatoes go well with koshari or any dish you like.

instructions.1: Wash the tomatoes well.
instructions.2: Cut the tomatoes into thin slices, keeping the base attached.
instructions.3: Stuff the tadbeela between each slice.
instructions.4: Put the tomatoes in a container and cover.
instructions.5: Keep the tomatoes in the fridge for up to 3 months.

fah-166.title: Pickled Peppers
fah-166.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-166.culturalNotes: Pickled peppers keep in the fridge for two weeks. Serve them with beans, ta'ameya, potatoes, msaqqa'a and koshari — they add wonderful flavour.

instructions.1: Cut the peppers into small pieces, 2–3 cm.
instructions.2: Add 4 cups of water to a pot and place it over the heat.
instructions.3: Add 2 tablespoons of salt to the water.
instructions.4: Add the coriander, cumin and minced garlic to the water.
instructions.5: Stir well until the salt dissolves.
instructions.6: Add the pepper pieces to the boiling water and boil for 2–3 minutes.
instructions.7: Add the vinegar to the water and take the pot off the heat.
instructions.8: Leave the peppers to cool.
instructions.9: Pack the peppers into a container and keep in the fridge.
instructions.10: Add a little oil on top if you like.

fah-167.title: Baladi Mixed Pickles
fah-167.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-167.culturalNotes: Make sure the jars are thoroughly clean before use. A spoonful of pickling spice in the brine improves the flavour.

fah-167-i7.name: vinegar
fah-167-i7.standardAmount: ½ cup per litre of water

fah-167-i8.name: Lemon juice
fah-167-i8.standardAmount: ¼ cup per litre of water

instructions.1: Wash the lemons well and soak them in boiling water for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Peel the carrots, cut them into small pieces and soak in boiling water for 10 minutes.
instructions.3: Remove the leaves from the cauliflower, cut it into small florets and soak in boiling water with half a teaspoon of cumin for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Wash the cucumbers, cut into small pieces and soak in boiling water.
instructions.5: Slice the green and jalapeño peppers and soak them in boiling water.
instructions.6: Drain all the vegetables and pack them into clean jars.
instructions.7: Make the brine by mixing the water, salt, vinegar, lemon juice, nigella seeds, garlic, turmeric and harissa.
instructions.8: Pour the brine over the vegetables in the jars until completely covered.
instructions.9: Add two tablespoons of oil on top of each jar to keep the air out.
instructions.10: Seal the jars well and leave for 3 days before using.

fah-168.title: Mixed Vegetable Pickles
fah-168.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-168.culturalNotes: Use clean, sterilised jars and cover the pickles well with brine to prevent spoilage. Leftover duqqa keeps in the freezer for later.

instructions.1: Make the duqqa: put the hot and sweet red peppers, vinegar, lemon juice, salt, cumin and coriander in the food processor and grind well.
instructions.2: Make the brine: mix 4 cups of boiled, cooled water, a quarter cup of lemon juice, a quarter cup of vinegar, a teaspoon of sugar and 4 tablespoons of salt.
instructions.3: For the jalapeños: put a quarter cup of sugar, two tablespoons of salt, a quarter cup of vinegar, citric acid and the garlic cloves in boiling water, add the jalapeños, stir once, then lift out and cover until cool.
instructions.4: For the cauliflower: cut it into small florets, put in boiling water, cover for 10 minutes, then lift into a clean jar and add the grated beetroot, two spoonfuls of duqqa and the brine.
instructions.5: For the aubergines: put a quarter cup of vinegar, two tablespoons of salt and a spoonful of sugar in boiling water, add the aubergines in batches, lift out after 10 minutes and pack into a jar with pepper slices, two spoonfuls of duqqa and the brine.
instructions.6: For the lemons: mix the yellow lemons, nigella seeds, turmeric, duqqa and brine in a clean jar.
instructions.7: For the onions: put the onions in boiling water with a quarter cup of vinegar and a tablespoon of salt, lift out after 5 minutes and pack into a jar with 3 spoonfuls of duqqa and the brine.
instructions.8: For the cabbage: put the cabbage in boiling water, then pack into a clean jar with the grated beetroot, duqqa and brine.
instructions.9: For the carrots: cut them into the desired shape, put in boiling water, lift out and pack into a jar with garlic cloves, fennel seeds, sugar, duqqa and brine.

fah-169.title: Quick Mixed Pickles
fah-169.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-169.culturalNotes: You can add celery and nigella seeds for better flavour. Make sure the jars are sealed tightly for good-quality pickles.

instructions.1: Boil water and pour it over the cauliflower; leave it to soak for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Soak the cauliflower in boiling water for 10 minutes, covered, to keep the heat in.
instructions.3: Put the red peppers, green peppers, cucumbers and carrots in a bowl and toss together.
instructions.4: Add turnips too if you have them.
instructions.5: Make the red duqqa: crush 4 garlic cloves with hot red peppers.
instructions.6: Add the salt to the hot water and stir until dissolved.
instructions.7: Add the dried coriander and cumin to the brine.
instructions.8: Add the celery and nigella seeds if you like.
instructions.9: Pour the hot brine over the vegetables in the jars.
instructions.10: Make sure the vegetables are completely covered by the brine.
instructions.11: Seal the jars tightly and leave for 3 days before opening.

fah-170.title: No-Oil Msaqqa'a (Aubergine Bake)
fah-170.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-170.culturalNotes: Serve the msaqqa'a with white rice or Arabic bread. It keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Heat a frying pan over medium heat and add the hot and sweet peppers cut into thin strips.
instructions.2: Add the chopped onion and stir until golden.
instructions.3: Add the minced garlic and stir until golden.
instructions.4: Add the tomato juice and tomato paste and stir together.
instructions.5: Add the salt, coriander, cumin, sugar and black pepper and stir well.
instructions.6: Add the stock cube and stir until dissolved.
instructions.7: Add the boiling water and leave until it boils and thickens.
instructions.8: Slice the aubergine and potatoes into rounds and arrange them in the baking tray.
instructions.9: Pour the sauce over the aubergine and potatoes.
instructions.10: Cover the tray and put it in the oven on high heat for an hour and a quarter.
instructions.11: After an hour and a quarter, take the tray out, remove the cover and put it under the grill for a few minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Take the msaqqa'a out of the oven and serve hot.

fah-171.title: Quick & Light Msaqqa'a
fah-171.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-171.culturalNotes: Serve the msaqqa'a hot or cold. Add more tomatoes to taste for a saucier dish.

instructions.1: Slice the aubergine lengthways, sprinkle with salt and leave in a colander for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Cut the potatoes into cubes and fry until golden.
instructions.3: Cut the bell peppers into thin strips and prepare the hot chilli to taste.
instructions.4: In a bowl, sauté the onions cut into wedges in two tablespoons of oil until golden.
instructions.5: Add the minced garlic and minced meat and stir until the meat changes colour.
instructions.6: Add the bell peppers and hot chilli and stir for a minute.
instructions.7: Add the tomato juice, cumin, salt, pepper, seven-spice and sugar, and leave the mixture to boil.
instructions.8: In a tagine, lay a layer of the vegetable and meat mixture, then a layer of fried potatoes, then a layer of fried aubergine.
instructions.9: Repeat the layers until the ingredients are used up.
instructions.10: Cover the tagine and bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 30 minutes.

fah-314.title: Baladi Mish (Fermented Cheese)
fah-314.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-314.culturalNotes: You can use fresh milk instead of laban rayeb if you don't have any. Mish keeps in the fridge and is served cold.

instructions.1: Bring a wire sieve and place the laban rayeb (fermented milk) in it.
instructions.2: Add a teaspoon of salt to the laban rayeb and stir well.
instructions.3: Add a teaspoon of red pepper and the ground fenugreek and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the aged peppers and hot dried chilli to taste and stir well.
instructions.5: Cover the mixture and leave it for 24 hours.
instructions.6: After 24 hours, add the whey and qareesh cheese to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.7: Cover the mixture and leave it for two to three weeks.

fah-315.title: Homemade Qareesh Cheese
fah-315.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-315.culturalNotes: Use good, fresh milk for the best result. Qareesh cheese keeps in the fridge for a long time without spoiling.

instructions.1: Prepare the milk: warm 5 kg of milk over low heat for just one minute in winter; in summer it doesn't need warming.
instructions.2: Set the milk: pour the milk into a pot, cover it with a clean cloth and leave it in the (unlit) oven for two days in winter or one day in summer. Do not shake or move the pot.
instructions.3: Take the cream off: after the set time, separate the cream from the cheese — the milk will have turned into a single mass.
instructions.4: Drain the cheese: put the cheese on a mat or in a sieve to drain the liquid. Add salt to taste and stir the cheese well.
instructions.5: Storage: once drained, put the cheese in a container and cover it with its own whey plus two tablespoons of salt per litre of whey. Add the chilli pod too. Keep the cheese in the fridge.
instructions.6: Use the qareesh cheese in different dishes or eat it as it is.

fah-316.title: Cream Cheese from Qareesh Cheese
fah-316.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-316.culturalNotes: Qareesh cheese makes an easy, quick cream cheese. Add your favourite flavours — basturma, olives, thyme, romy cheese or hot pepper. Qareesh is rich in protein and calcium, perfect with toast or in school sandwiches.

instructions.1: Add the qareesh cheese and milk to the blender.
instructions.2: Blend well until the consistency is creamy.
instructions.3: For a richer cheese, add 2 tablespoons of oil.
instructions.4: Add your favourite flavours — basturma, olives, thyme, romy cheese or hot pepper — then blend again.
instructions.5: Blend once more until the mixture is uniform.
instructions.6: For the plain cheese, add a pinch of nigella seeds and 2 teaspoons of olive oil.
instructions.7: Serve the cream cheese with toasted bread or in school sandwiches.

fah-317.title: Goulash Rolls with Kofta
fah-317.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-317.culturalNotes: The rolls work as a light meal or summer sandwiches. They keep in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Mix the Knorr kofta seasoning with the minced meat and grated onion.
instructions.2: Knead the kofta well until combined.
instructions.3: Make the brushing mixture: mix half a cup of melted butter with a tub of yogurt and a teaspoon of baking powder.
instructions.4: Take a phyllo sheet and brush it with the mixture, then lay two more sheets on top, brushing each one.
instructions.5: Take a portion of the kofta, place it at the edge of the phyllo and roll it up evenly.
instructions.6: Repeat until all the phyllo sheets are used.
instructions.7: Place the rolls in a tray greased with ghee or oil.
instructions.8: Brush the tops of the rolls with ghee or oil before baking.
instructions.9: Heat the oven to 180°C and put the tray on the middle rack.
instructions.10: Bake the rolls until golden, about 20 minutes.
instructions.11: Take the rolls out of the oven and serve hot with tahini sauce and fried potato pickles.

fah-318.title: Homemade Peanut Butter
fah-318.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-318.culturalNotes: The butter keeps in a jar in the fridge for up to a month. Serve with bread or in sandwiches.

instructions.1: Heat the oven to 170°C.
instructions.2: Spread the peanuts on a baking tray and roast until golden.
instructions.3: Leave the peanuts to cool slightly, then grind them in the blender until smooth.
instructions.4: Add the honey, oil and salt and blend until combined.
instructions.5: Bake the mixture for 10 minutes at 170°C.
instructions.6: Put the peanut butter in a clean, dry jar.

fah-319.title: Shateeta (Hot Pepper Relish)
fah-319.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-319.culturalNotes: Shateeta goes with breakfast, beans, ta'ameya, potatoes, pasta, koshari, okra and molokhia. It keeps in the fridge for a week.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the hot peppers and stir for a minute until they start to colour.
instructions.3: Add the minced garlic and the spices (salt, cumin, coriander, black pepper) and stir for another minute.
instructions.4: Add the tomato cubes and stir for a minute.
instructions.5: Add the vinegar and leave it to boil for two minutes.
instructions.6: Transfer the mixture to a container and leave it to cool.
instructions.7: Keep the shateeta in an airtight container in the fridge.

fah-320.title: Melty Cheese Sauce
fah-320.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-320.culturalNotes: Serve the sauce with fried potatoes, pizza or pané. It keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Put the milk in a pot over low heat.
instructions.2: Add the cornflour and stir well.
instructions.3: Keep stirring over low heat until the mixture thickens.
instructions.4: Add the cheese and stir until completely melted.
instructions.5: When the mixture boils, add the butter and stir until melted.
instructions.6: Take the pot off the heat and keep stirring until the sauce reaches the right consistency.

fah-321.title: Pasta Sauce with Steak & Onions
fah-321.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-321.culturalNotes: Serve with a green salad or fresh bread. Leftovers keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Heat the oil and butter in a frying pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the steak and stir until golden on all sides.
instructions.3: Add the salt and black pepper and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the crushed garlic and stir until golden.
instructions.5: Add the onions and stir until golden.
instructions.6: Add the sugar and stir well.
instructions.7: Add the demi-glace powder and stir well.
instructions.8: Add boiling water and leave until it boils.
instructions.9: Add the pasta and stir well.
instructions.10: Add some of the pasta cooking water and stir well.
instructions.11: Add the crushed chilli flakes and stir well.
instructions.12: Add cream to taste if you like.

fah-322.title: Melty Cheese Skillets
fah-322.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-322.culturalNotes: Serve the skillets hot with a side green salad. Different cheeses work, as you like.

instructions.1: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the flour and stir for a minute.
instructions.3: Add the milk and stir until the flour dissolves.
instructions.4: Add the cream cheese, cheddar and mozzarella and stir until the cheese melts.
instructions.5: Add a pinch of saffron colouring, the salt and pepper, and stir well.
instructions.6: In another pot, sauté the sausages, mixed peppers, sun-dried tomatoes, olives and pasta, then add the cheese sauce and stir.
instructions.7: Prepare the skillets: add the pasta and sauce mixture, then top with cheese.
instructions.8: Repeat for the potato and hot pepper skillet with sauce and cheese.
instructions.9: Repeat for the sujuk and mixed pepper skillet with sauce and cheese.
instructions.10: Put the skillets in a preheated oven at 180°C for 20 minutes until the cheese melts and browns on top.

fah-323.title: Alexandrian Fatta
fah-323.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-323.culturalNotes: You can add a stock cube to the sauce for a stronger taste. The fatta keeps in the fridge for two days — reheat before serving.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pot over medium heat and add the mastic until it melts.
instructions.2: Add the meat and stir until it changes colour.
instructions.3: Add the carrots, onions, tomatoes, bay leaf and cardamom powder, and stir well.
instructions.4: Add water to cover the meat and leave over low heat until cooked.
instructions.5: Wash and drain the rice, then sauté it in a pot with the ghee, oil and mastic until glossy.
instructions.6: Add the salt and instant stock, and pour in water to cover the rice by about 1 cm.
instructions.7: Cover the rice and leave over low heat until cooked.
instructions.8: Make the sauce by blending the hot chilli and tomatoes, then straining it.
instructions.9: Crush the garlic with the salt, then fry it in a pot with the ghee until golden.
instructions.10: Add the vinegar and chopped tomatoes and leave until thickened.
instructions.11: Cut the baladi bread into small cubes and toast in the oven until golden.
instructions.12: Make the tasha dressing by mixing the remaining garlic with ghee, then adding the vinegar and broth.
instructions.13: Spread the bread in the serving tray and moisten it with broth.
instructions.14: Add the rice tossed in ghee, then moisten with more broth.
instructions.15: Add the meat, then top with the sauce and the tasha dressing.
instructions.16: Serve the fatta hot.

fah-324.title: Hawawshi Fatta
fah-324.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-324.culturalNotes: Any long-grain rice can replace the basmati. Sprinkling grated cheese over the hawawshi before it goes in the oven gives a golden crisp top.

instructions.1: Mix the minced meat with the hawawshi spices, tahini, minced onion, minced green pepper, black pepper and salt.
instructions.2: Knead the mixture well until smooth.
instructions.3: Take a piece of the bread, place some of the mixture on it and spread it out.
instructions.4: Roll the bread into a roll and cut it into slices about a centimetre wide.
instructions.5: Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the hawawshi slices until golden.
instructions.6: Put the hawawshi in a tray and into a preheated oven at 200°C for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Wash and drain the basmati rice, put it in a pot with the ghee and oil and stir.
instructions.8: Add the spices (cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, whole black peppercorns) and stir into the rice.
instructions.9: Add the broth and salt and leave the rice to absorb for 15 minutes over low heat.
instructions.10: Add the ground saffron and stir well, then cover the pot and leave the rice to cook.
instructions.11: Mix the tahini, yogurt, duqqa, lemon juice, vinegar, mayonnaise and water to a medium consistency.
instructions.12: Put the rice in the serving dish and scatter the hawawshi over it.
instructions.13: Pour the tahini sauce over the hawawshi and garnish with parsley or fresh coriander, peanuts and pomegranate molasses.

fah-325.title: Liver Fatta
fah-325.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-325.culturalNotes: Add chilli to taste. The fatta keeps in the fridge for one day.

instructions.1: Cut the liver into small cubes.
instructions.2: Season the liver with the cinnamon, coriander, cumin, salt, pepper, garlic and vinegar. Stir well.
instructions.3: Heat the oil in a pan and add the liver. Stir until cooked through, without over-stirring.
instructions.4: Add the mixed-colour peppers and hot chilli and stir for a minute.
instructions.5: In another pan, heat a little oil and add the garlic. Sauté until golden.
instructions.6: Add the coriander and vinegar and stir. Add half a cup of tomato sauce and leave it to boil.
instructions.7: Add half a cup of water and adjust the salt and pepper. Leave the sauce until thickened.
instructions.8: Cook the white rice in boiling water with the ghee, oil and mastic until done.
instructions.9: Toast the bread in the oven until golden and crisp.
instructions.10: In the serving dish, place the white rice and toasted bread. Pour the sauce over them.
instructions.11: Scatter the liver and coloured peppers over the rice and bread.
instructions.12: Make the tahini sauce by mixing the tahini, mayonnaise, minced garlic, salt, pepper, cumin, coriander and vinegar with half a cup of water. Pour the sauce over the fatta.
instructions.13: Serve the fatta hot.

fah-326.title: Caramel Popcorn
fah-326.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-326.culturalNotes: Keep the heat low when popping so it doesn't burn. Don't increase the baking soda or the caramel will turn bitter.

instructions.1: Put a pot over the heat and add two tablespoons of oil, then lower the heat.
instructions.2: Add the kernels and cover the pot, leaving a small gap for steam.
instructions.3: Leave the kernels over low heat until they start popping.
instructions.4: Prepare a tray and grease it well with oil.
instructions.5: In another pan, put a cup of sugar and a quarter cup of water over the heat until it caramelises.
instructions.6: Don't stir the caramel at first — just gently shake the pan.
instructions.7: Once the caramel is golden, add a quarter teaspoon of baking soda and stir well.
instructions.8: Add the caramel to the popcorn and stir until all the kernels are coated.
instructions.9: Pour the caramel popcorn into the greased tray and leave it to cool and dry.
instructions.10: Once cool, break it up gently and serve.

fah-327.title: Syrian Chickpea Falafel
fah-327.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-327.culturalNotes: The dough keeps in the freezer for a long time if left unseasoned. Make sure the oil is hot but not smoking when frying so the falafel don't absorb grease.

instructions.1: Soak the chickpeas for at least 12 hours, then wash and drain them.
instructions.2: Put the chickpeas in the food processor with the parsley, coriander, onion and garlic, and grind until smooth.
instructions.3: If the dough needs water, add a quarter cup.
instructions.4: Add the salt, cumin, ground coriander and baking soda and knead well.
instructions.5: Shape the dough into small balls and coat them in sesame seeds.
instructions.6: Fry the falafel in hot oil until golden and crisp.
instructions.7: Make the tahini sauce by mixing the tahini, yogurt, duqqa and water.
instructions.8: Serve the falafel with bread, tomatoes, pickled cucumbers, tahini, pomegranate and parsley.

fah-328.title: Kofta Kabsa
fah-328.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-328.culturalNotes: Serve the kabsa with daqqous salad or any salad you like. It keeps in the fridge for two days, or freeze it for longer.

instructions.1: Mix the minced meat with the chopped parsley, minced garlic, breadcrumbs, seven-spice, salt and pepper.
instructions.2: Knead the ingredients well until combined.
instructions.3: Shape the kofta into small, even balls.
instructions.4: Heat the oil and ghee in a pot over the heat.
instructions.5: Add the kofta and sauté until golden on all sides.
instructions.6: Lift the kofta out of the pot and set aside.
instructions.7: In the same pot, add the chopped onion and garlic and sauté until golden.
instructions.8: Add the dried lime, cinnamon, cardamom, salt and pepper, and stir well.
instructions.9: Add the concentrated tomato juice and leave until thickened.
instructions.10: Add the boiling water and leave until it boils.
instructions.11: Return the kofta to the pot with the sauce.
instructions.12: Add the stock cube and leave the mixture to boil.
instructions.13: Add the rice and leave until covered by the water or sauce.
instructions.14: Add the peppers and cover the pot, then leave over low heat until the rice is cooked.
instructions.15: Give the kabsa one gentle stir, then cover again and leave until fully cooked.

fah-329.title: Kuymak (Cornmeal & Cheese) with Tomato
fah-329.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-329.culturalNotes: You can add baladi or Turkish sujuk to the sauce for extra flavour. Serve the kuymak with tomatoes, cucumber and black olives.

instructions.1: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the yellow cornmeal and stir until well toasted.
instructions.3: Add the water and stir until the mixture comes together.
instructions.4: Add the mozzarella and stir until it melts and the mixture is smooth.
instructions.5: In another pot, heat the ghee, add the chopped onion and sauté until golden.
instructions.6: Add the hot chilli and stir briefly.
instructions.7: Add the grated tomatoes, salt and black pepper and leave the mixture to thicken slightly.
instructions.8: Add the eggs and stir gently until cooked.
instructions.9: Serve the kuymak hot with Turkish simit and tea.

fah-138.title: Crispy Fish Strips
fah-138.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-138.culturalNotes: Any kind of fish works here. The strips keep in the fridge for two days. Serve with white rice or salad.

fah-138-i2.name: Fish spices (thyme, cumin, coriander, paprika, dried parsley)

instructions.1: Cut the fish into medium strips.
instructions.2: Mix the fish spices, garlic powder, onion powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.3: Coat the fish strips in the mix and leave for half an hour.
instructions.4: Mix the flour, cornflour, salt, onion powder and fish spices in another bowl.
instructions.5: Dip the fish strips in water, then in the flour mixture, repeating until you have a thick coating.
instructions.6: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
instructions.7: Fry the fish strips until golden and crisp.
instructions.8: Serve the strips with pickled aubergine.

fah-139.title: Fried Shrimp with Bissara
fah-139.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-139.culturalNotes: Add other spices to taste — black pepper or a mixed blend. The shrimp also goes well with salad or rice.

instructions.1: Wash the shrimp well under running water 3 times.
instructions.2: Cut off the heads and remove the vein from the underside.
instructions.3: Wash the shrimp once more and drain well.
instructions.4: Toss the shrimp with the cumin, coriander, salt, crushed garlic, lemon juice and chilli.
instructions.5: Toss the shrimp in the flour.
instructions.6: Drop the shrimp into hot oil and fry until golden.
instructions.7: Skewer the shrimp 4 pieces at a time, in the traditional way.
instructions.8: Serve the shrimp hot with fried bissara.

fah-140.title: Marinade for Grilled Fish
fah-140.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-140.culturalNotes: The marinade keeps in a jar in the fridge for months.

instructions.1: Make the marinade: blend the garlic, hot chilli and green and red peppers.
instructions.2: Add the vinegar, lemon juice, cumin, dried coriander and salt and mix well.
instructions.3: Make the stuffing: mix the grated carrot, parsley, dill, tomatoes and onion with 4 tablespoons of the marinade and salt.
instructions.4: Stuff the fish with the stuffing.
instructions.5: Grill the fish until golden.
instructions.6: Make the basting sauce: mix the rest of the stuffing with water and salt.
instructions.7: Pour the sauce over the grilled fish.

fah-141.title: Homemade Preserved Mackerel (Tuna-Style)
fah-141.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-141.culturalNotes: Serve the homemade tuna with onion salad and lemon juice, adding salt to taste.

instructions.1: Prepare the cooking ingredients: 2 kg mackerel, a bunch of celery, two carrots, 3 lemons, two onions, 10 tomatoes, 2 bay leaves, 2 tablespoons of salt, a teaspoon of cumin and 2 tablespoons of vinegar.
instructions.2: Add two litres of water to a pot and bring to the boil.
instructions.3: Add all the vegetables and spices to the boiling water.
instructions.4: Add the fish pieces to the water and boil for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Lower the heat and leave the fish to cook gently for 90 minutes.
instructions.6: Lift the fish out of the water and remove the skin and bones.
instructions.7: Strain the water of the vegetables and spices and keep it for preserving.
instructions.8: Pack the fish pieces into a clean, dry jar.
instructions.9: Add 2 bay leaves and hot chilli to taste.
instructions.10: Add half a cup of vinegar and half a cup of oil to the jar.
instructions.11: Stir the contents gently and keep the jar in the fridge for 3–4 days before eating.
instructions.12: The jar keeps in the fridge for over a month.

fah-142.title: Homemade Canned Tuna
fah-142.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-142.culturalNotes: Mackerel works instead of tuna with similar results. Add garlic slices during boiling for a stronger flavour.

instructions.1: Buy the tuna and ask the fishmonger to clean it and cut it into steaks.
instructions.2: Put the steaks in a large dish, cover with water and vinegar and leave for an hour.
instructions.3: In a pot, put the water, lemon slices, onion, carrot, celery, black peppercorns, salt and vinegar, and bring to the boil.
instructions.4: Add the tuna steaks to the pot and leave over low heat for an hour.
instructions.5: After an hour, lift the tuna out and put it on a rack to cool.
instructions.6: Once cooled, separate the flesh from the bones and skin.
instructions.7: Keep the poaching liquid and add the sliced garlic to it.
instructions.8: Put the tuna in sterilised jars and add the chilli pods and black peppercorns.
instructions.9: Fill the jars halfway with the liquid, then add half a cup of brine and half a cup of oil.
instructions.10: Seal the jars and keep in the fridge for 3–4 days before eating.

fah-143.title: Battered Shrimp & Potatoes
fah-143.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-143.culturalNotes: Use frying potatoes, hot oil and medium heat for the best result. Serve with ketchup or any sauce you like.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into medium-thick pieces and soak in boiling water with a pinch of salt for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: Drain the potatoes and leave to cool.
instructions.3: Mix the flour with the paprika, turmeric, onion powder, garlic powder, baking powder, salt, black pepper and chilli.
instructions.4: Add water gradually to the flour mixture until it reaches a pancake-batter consistency.
instructions.5: Dip the cooled potatoes in the batter.
instructions.6: Heat the oil over medium heat and fry the potatoes piece by piece until golden.
instructions.7: Toss the shrimp in the same batter and fry in the hot oil until golden.

fah-144.title: Shrimp Spring Rolls
fah-144.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-144.culturalNotes: The spring rolls can be frozen and used when needed. Serve hot with soy sauce and ketchup for a great taste.

instructions.1: Wash and clean the shrimp well, then remove the vein from the underside.
instructions.2: Add the fish marinade and soy sauce to the shrimp and mix well.
instructions.3: Leave the shrimp in the marinade for 30 minutes.
instructions.4: Cut the underside so the shrimp doesn't curl during frying.
instructions.5: Take a spring roll wrapper and place some shrimp in the centre.
instructions.6: Wrap the sheet around the shrimp as shown in the video, using water to seal the edge.
instructions.7: Repeat until all the shrimp are used.
instructions.8: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
instructions.9: Serve the fried spring rolls with soy sauce and ketchup to taste.

fah-145.title: Crispy Fish & Shrimp Strips with Rice
fah-145.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-145.culturalNotes: Other kinds of fish work too. Make sure the oil is properly hot before frying for the perfect crunch.

instructions.1: Wash the fish and shrimp well and cut the fish into medium strips.
instructions.2: Make the marinade from the crispy coating mix, water, garlic and lemon juice. Stir well.
instructions.3: Soak the fish and shrimp in the marinade for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat and fry the fish and shrimp until golden and crisp.
instructions.5: In another pan, sauté the onion until lightly golden, add the minced garlic and stir together.
instructions.6: Add the washed rice to the onion and garlic and stir well. Add the boiling water and salt and stir again.
instructions.7: Cover the pan and leave the rice to cook over low heat until done.
instructions.8: Five minutes before the rice is done, add the sorrel and chopped coriander and stir well.
instructions.9: Serve the crispy fish and shrimp with the herb rice, tomato sauce, pickles, fahana relish and chilli.

fah-146.title: Sardines Preserved in Lemon & Oil
fah-146.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-146.culturalNotes: The preserved sardines are ready two days after storing and keep in the fridge for up to two weeks.

instructions.1: Open the tin of sardines and empty it.
instructions.2: Remove the heads and innards and clean the sardines.
instructions.3: Place the sardines in a dish.
instructions.4: Squeeze the lemons over the sardines.
instructions.5: Cover the sardines in oil.
instructions.6: Seal the container tightly and store in the fridge.

fah-147.title: Salt-Cured Sardines
fah-147.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-147.culturalNotes: Dry the sardines well before seasoning for a good cure. Turn the jar daily so the salt and oil distribute evenly.

instructions.1: Choose fresh sardines and wash them well.
instructions.2: Arrange the sardines in a colander and leave for two hours to dry.
instructions.3: Dry the sardines thoroughly with a towel to make sure no water remains.
instructions.4: Make the curing mix from the salt, chilli, paprika and turmeric and stir well.
instructions.5: Slice the celery and lemon thinly.
instructions.6: Stuff the sardines' gills with the curing mix.
instructions.7: Sprinkle salt on all sides of the sardines.
instructions.8: Lay a layer of celery and lemon at the bottom of the jar.
instructions.9: Pack the sardines in the jar, adding more celery and lemon between layers.
instructions.10: Pour the vegetable oil over the sardines.
instructions.11: Seal the jar tightly and turn it daily until ready after 5 days.
instructions.12: Keep the jar at room temperature or in the fridge.

fah-148.title: Baked Mullet with Potatoes & Vegetables
fah-148.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-148.culturalNotes: Mackerel works instead of mullet with a lovely taste. The marinade keeps in the freezer for other recipes.

instructions.1: Prepare the fish: clean it, trim the fins and make slits in it.
instructions.2: Prepare the vegetables: slice the potatoes, onions, tomatoes, peppers, celery and coriander.
instructions.3: Make the stuffing: mix the marinade with the celery and coriander and stuff the fish inside and out.
instructions.4: Prepare the tray: spread the potatoes, onions, tomatoes and peppers in the baking tray.
instructions.5: Lay the fish over the vegetables and garnish with lemon, tomato and pepper slices.
instructions.6: Season the fish inside and out with the vinegar and oil.
instructions.7: Cover the tray with foil and bake in a preheated 240°C oven for half an hour.
instructions.8: Remove the foil and put the tray under the grill until browned.
instructions.9: Serve the fish hot with white rice or sayadeya rice, as you like.

fah-149.title: Oven-Smoked Fish
fah-149.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-149.culturalNotes: Use fresh, well-washed fish for the best flavour. Any kind of fish works.

instructions.1: Make the marinade: mix the minced garlic, pomegranate molasses, chilli, cumin, mustard, salt, oil, lemon juice and smoked paprika in a bowl.
instructions.2: Spread the marinade over the fish slices evenly.
instructions.3: Arrange the fish slices in a tray and put it in a very hot oven at the highest temperature.
instructions.4: Cover the tray with foil and bake for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Take the fish out of the oven and garnish with chopped parsley.

fah-150.title: Oven-Grilled Fish, Shrimp in Tomato & Marinated Aubergine
fah-150.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-150.culturalNotes: The duqqa keeps in a dry place away from moisture for a month. Serve the meal with a green salad or yogurt.

instructions.1: Make the duqqa: blend the hot and sweet peppers, fresh coriander, chilli, garlic head, vinegar, lemon juice, salt, cumin and dried coriander until smooth.
instructions.2: Prepare the fish: wash it well, then rub it with the duqqa inside and out. Wrap it in foil and bake in a hot oven until golden.
instructions.3: Prepare the shrimp: wash and clean them, then toss with the minced onion, tomatoes, bell pepper, grated carrot, duqqa, celery, lemon juice and oil. Put the mixture in a tray and bake until cooked.
instructions.4: Prepare the marinated aubergine: peel the aubergine, slice it and brown it in a tray with a little oil until golden. Put it in a serving dish and add the duqqa, parsley and tahini.
instructions.5: Prepare the rice: brown the onion in oil, then add the sugar until the onion turns honey-coloured. Add the boiling water, rice, salt, cumin and vegetable stock. Cover the pot and leave the rice until cooked.

fah-151.title: Seafood & Fish Tray Bake with Potatoes
fah-151.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-151.culturalNotes: Any kind of fish works. Leftovers keep in the fridge for two days. Serve the tray with a green salad.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and cut them into thin strips.
instructions.2: Put the potatoes in a deep dish and add the lemon juice, mustard, cumin, salt and garlic. Mix well.
instructions.3: Clean the fish well and open the belly. Spread half the marinade over the fish.
instructions.4: Spread the rest of the marinade over the potatoes and lay them in the tray under the fish.
instructions.5: Add the seafood (mussels, calamari, shrimp) to the tray and spread the remaining marinade over it.
instructions.6: In another pot, melt the butter and add the minced onion. Sauté until golden.
instructions.7: Add the flour and mix until it disappears. Add the milk, salt, black pepper and boiling water, and stir to a light sauce.
instructions.8: Pour the sauce over the fish, seafood and potatoes. Add two tablespoons of cream.
instructions.9: Put the tray in a very hot oven on the middle rack for 30 minutes.
instructions.10: In another pot, heat the oil and add the minced onion. Sauté until golden.
instructions.11: Add the strained tomatoes and tomato paste and stir well.
instructions.12: Add the rice and shrimp-shell broth (made by boiling shrimp shells with water and spices). Stir well and adjust the salt.
instructions.13: Cover the rice and leave over high heat until it absorbs, then stir and lower the heat.
instructions.14: Serve the tray hot with the red rice.

fah-152.title: Amazing Shrimp Tagine
fah-152.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-152.culturalNotes: Make sure the oven is preheated for 15 minutes before the tagine goes in. Serve with white rice or bread.

instructions.1: Wash the shrimp well, open the back and remove the sand vein.
instructions.2: Slice the onions and add them to the tagine.
instructions.3: Add the salt, dried coriander, garlic and cumin and stir.
instructions.4: Add the celery, tomatoes and hot and sweet peppers, squeeze the lemons over everything and leave the peel in the tagine.
instructions.5: Add the shrimp and stir well.
instructions.6: Cover the tagine and put it in a preheated 200°C oven for 30 minutes.
instructions.7: Take the tagine out of the oven and serve hot.

fah-153.title: Oven Shrimp Tagine
fah-153.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-153.culturalNotes: The duqqa keeps in the fridge for a month. Serve the tagine with sayadeya rice or marinated aubergine.

instructions.1: Wash and clean the shrimp well.
instructions.2: Slice the onions thinly.
instructions.3: Slice the tomatoes and bell pepper.
instructions.4: Grate the carrot.
instructions.5: Prepare the duqqa as shown at the start of the video.
instructions.6: Cut the celery into small pieces.
instructions.7: Add the onion, tomatoes, bell pepper and carrot to the duqqa.
instructions.8: Add the shrimp to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.9: Add the oil and boiling water to the mixture.
instructions.10: Put the mixture in a baking tray and cover it.
instructions.11: Bake in a hot oven for 30 minutes until the shrimp is cooked and nicely coloured.
instructions.12: Serve the tagine hot.

fah-154.title: Surprise Seafood Tagine
fah-154.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-154.culturalNotes: Other kinds of fish or shellfish can be added. Serve the tagine with white rice or bread.

instructions.1: Cut the fish, calamari and crab into small cubes.
instructions.2: Cut the celery and mixed peppers into small cubes.
instructions.3: Chop the onion and garlic finely.
instructions.4: Heat the oil in a pot, add the onion and sauté until golden.
instructions.5: Add the garlic and stir until fragrant.
instructions.6: Add the mixed peppers and stir for a minute.
instructions.7: Add the black pepper and salt and stir well.
instructions.8: Add the flour and stir until it disappears.
instructions.9: Add the shrimp, fish and calamari and stir until sealed.
instructions.10: Add the shrimp broth and stir until it boils.
instructions.11: Add the hot milk and stir until it boils and thickens.
instructions.12: Add the chilli, cream and cream cheese and stir well.
instructions.13: Pour the mixture into a baking tray and top with mozzarella.
instructions.14: Bake in a very hot oven until browned.

fah-155.title: Molokhia & Shrimp Tagine
fah-155.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-155.culturalNotes: Clean the shrimp well and remove the sand vein. Don't cover the pot while cooking or the molokhia will darken. You can garnish with two shrimp.

instructions.1: Heat a teaspoon of ghee in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add a third of the minced garlic, half the hot chilli and half the dried coriander. Stir until the garlic is lightly golden.
instructions.3: Add the shrimp and stir with the garlic, chilli and coriander until it changes colour.
instructions.4: Add the stock cube, salt and shrimp broth. Leave the mixture to boil.
instructions.5: Add another third of the garlic and stir until fragrant.
instructions.6: Add the molokhia and stir with a whisk until completely loosened.
instructions.7: Add more shrimp broth or water as needed for the right consistency.
instructions.8: Turn off the heat once the molokhia boils — don't leave it long or it will drop.
instructions.9: Transfer to a tagine and serve.
instructions.10: Make the tasha in a small pot with a teaspoon of ghee.
instructions.11: Add the remaining garlic, chilli and dried coriander and stir until the garlic is golden.
instructions.12: Add the tasha to the tagine and serve.

fah-156.title: Mullet Fesikh (Fermented Fish)
fah-156.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-156.culturalNotes: Use coarse salt for the best result. Keep the tools clean to avoid contamination. Turn the container after a week for an even cure.

instructions.1: Buy the mullet — each at least half a kilo — with pink gills, firm flesh and scales on.
instructions.2: Clean the fish well: reach inside and wash the gills to remove dirt and residue.
instructions.3: Spread the fish in a colander and refrigerate overnight to drain.
instructions.4: After 24 hours, press the fish to release the liquids and squeeze it with a clean towel.
instructions.5: Make the curing mix from the coarse salt, chilli and turmeric and stir together.
instructions.6: Salt the fish inside and out, putting a tablespoon of the mix into each side of the gills and in the head.
instructions.7: Prepare a large container with a layer of salt, lay the fish in, then another layer of salt, and so on until all the fish is packed.
instructions.8: Cover the fish completely with salt, seal the container well and press the air out.
instructions.9: Wrap the container in cling film to keep air out, and store it in a dark place away from sun and air.
instructions.10: After a week, turn the container over and leave for another week.
instructions.11: After 14 days, the fesikh is ready.

fah-157.title: Preparing & Serving Mullet Fesikh
fah-157.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-157.culturalNotes: Remove the excess salt from the fesikh before serving. It keeps in the fridge for up to two weeks.

instructions.1: Open the container of fesikh after 10 days of curing.
instructions.2: Wipe the excess salt off the surface of the fesikh with a towel.
instructions.3: Cut the fesikh into suitable pieces with scissors.
instructions.4: Open the spine and remove the unwanted parts.
instructions.5: Serve the fesikh with lemon, red pepper, green pepper and chopped spring onions.
instructions.6: Drizzle a little oil over the fesikh before serving.

fah-785.title: Three Healthy & Delicious Drinks
fah-785.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-785.culturalNotes: Chocolate sauce can replace the caramel in the Oreo milkshake. Adjust the honey in the spinach-strawberry drink to taste. A personal blender lets you serve the juice anywhere.

instructions.1: Make the Oreo milkshake:
instructions.2: Add ice to the jug.
instructions.3: Add a cup of vanilla ice cream.
instructions.4: Add a cup of milk.
instructions.5: Add 2 packets of chocolate biscuits.
instructions.6: Blend for 30 seconds.
instructions.7: Pour the drink into glasses.
instructions.8: Add caramel sauce to taste.
instructions.9: Make the spinach & strawberry drink:
instructions.10: Add a cup of spinach leaves.
instructions.11: Add a cup of strawberries.
instructions.12: Add a large piece of beetroot or 2 small ones.
instructions.13: Add a cup of orange juice.
instructions.14: Add 2 tablespoons of white honey.
instructions.15: Add a cup of water.
instructions.16: Blend well.
instructions.17: Pour the drink into glasses.

fah-786.title: Four Easy Winter Drinks
fah-786.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-786.culturalNotes: Keep the sahlab and hot-chocolate powders in sealed, clean, dry jars. Sprinkle nuts on the sahlab for crunch.

instructions.1: Make the hot cider: mix the apple juice, cinnamon, star anise and orange slices in a pot. Simmer over the heat until the flavours blend.
instructions.2: Make the sahlab powder: mix the rice flour, icing sugar, milk powder, desiccated coconut, cornflour, toasted sesame, raisins and vanilla powder in a large bowl. Store in a sealed jar.
instructions.3: Make the sahlab: mix a cup of milk with a tablespoon of sahlab powder while cold. Bring to the boil while stirring. Pour into cups and serve.
instructions.4: Make the hot-chocolate powder: mix the icing sugar, cocoa, milk powder, cornflour and chocolate chips in a bowl. Store in a sealed jar.
instructions.5: Make the hot chocolate: mix a cup of milk with a tablespoon of the powder while cold. Bring to the boil while stirring. Pour into cups and serve with marshmallows.
instructions.6: Make the custard: mix a cup of milk with a tablespoon of custard powder, a teaspoon of sugar and two cardamom pods. Bring to the boil while stirring until thick. Pour into cups and garnish with coconut.

fah-787.title: Iced Coffee
fah-787.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-787.culturalNotes: Add a little caramel sauce for a sweeter, stronger taste.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix half a cup of instant coffee with a quarter cup of sugar and a tablespoon of vanilla ice cream powder.
instructions.2: Add two tablespoons of ice water and beat with an electric whisk until thick and foamy.
instructions.3: Add ice to two glasses, then pour the foamed coffee over the ice.
instructions.4: Stir well and serve the iced coffee cold.

fah-788.title: Spanish Latte
fah-788.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-788.culturalNotes: Add a little caramel sugar for a sweeter taste and richer flavour.

instructions.1: Dissolve the instant coffee in hot water.
instructions.2: Add the sweetened condensed milk to the cup.
instructions.3: Add ice as desired.
instructions.4: Pour in the dissolved coffee.
instructions.5: Top up the cup with cold milk.
instructions.6: Stir everything together well.
instructions.7: Serve cold and enjoy.

fah-789.title: Espresso & Flat White
fah-789.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-789.culturalNotes: Serve the espresso and flat white hot or chilled. Dust the top with a little cinnamon or ground cocoa to garnish.

instructions.1: Pull the espresso using a coffee machine.
instructions.2: Pour the coffee into the cup.
instructions.3: Steam the milk until foamy.
instructions.4: Pour the foamy milk over the coffee.
instructions.5: Add sugar to taste.

fah-790.title: Nubian Tea (Shay bil-Laban)
fah-790.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-790.culturalNotes: Adjust the sugar to taste. Serve with cucumber and olives if you like.

instructions.1: Add a cup of water and a cup of milk to a pot.
instructions.2: Add 2 tea bags and a teaspoon of sugar.
instructions.3: Leave the mixture over low heat for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix half a cup of flour with a quarter cup of water and a pinch each of salt and sugar.
instructions.5: Add the egg and a teaspoon of oil and mix until no lumps remain.
instructions.6: Heat a pan and add a small drop of oil, spreading it evenly.
instructions.7: Add a small amount of the batter and swirl it around the pan until spread thin.
instructions.8: Flip the crepe once it takes light colour.
instructions.9: Add the romy cheese and fold the sandwich, heating both sides until the cheese melts.
instructions.10: Serve the sandwich with the cup of milky tea.

fah-791.title: Fresh Pineapple, Apple & Orange Juice
fah-791.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-791.culturalNotes: Add water or sugar to adjust the taste. The juice keeps in the fridge for up to 24 hours.

instructions.1: Prepare the pineapple: remove the skin and eyes and cut it into large chunks.
instructions.2: Put the pineapple pieces in the juicer and juice at the right speed.
instructions.3: Prepare the apple: wash it and cut it into large chunks without peeling.
instructions.4: Put the apple pieces in the juicer and juice them.
instructions.5: Prepare the orange: wash it and cut it in half.
instructions.6: Put the orange halves in the juicer and juice them.
instructions.7: Strain the juice through the filter to remove fibres and seeds.
instructions.8: Pour the juice into glasses and serve cold.

fah-792.title: Carob Juice (Kharoub)
fah-792.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-792.culturalNotes: Taste the juice and add more sugar or water as needed. The boiled carob pieces also make a nice snack for children.

instructions.1: Wash the carob well.
instructions.2: Add a quarter cup of water to the sugar and place it over the heat, stirring gently until it turns dark golden.
instructions.3: Add water gradually to the caramel.
instructions.4: Add about two litres of water to the washed carob and bring to the boil.
instructions.5: Cover the pot, lower the heat and leave for half an hour.
instructions.6: Strain the mixture through a fine sieve.
instructions.7: Add two litres of cold water to the juice.
instructions.8: Leave the juice to cool.
instructions.9: Fill the juice into bags and store in the freezer.

fah-793.title: Ramadan Doum Juice
fah-793.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-793.culturalNotes: Sweeten with honey instead of sugar for a healthier version. The juice keeps in the fridge for up to 24 hours.

instructions.1: Add half a cup of ground doum to a bowl.
instructions.2: Add half a cup of sugar.
instructions.3: Add two cups of milk.
instructions.4: Add two cups of boiling water.
instructions.5: Add a cup of ice.
instructions.6: Add nuts to taste.
instructions.7: Blend everything until combined.
instructions.8: Strain the juice into glasses.
instructions.9: Serve cold.

fah-794.title: Four Juices: Strawberry, Banana, Melon & Mint Lemonade
fah-794.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-794.culturalNotes: Different lemons work — baladi or yellow. Garnish the glasses with fruit slices or fresh herbs.

instructions.1: Wash the strawberries and cut them into small pieces.
instructions.2: Add the strawberries to the blender with the milk, whipping cream, ice cream, ice, and syrup, honey or sugar to taste.
instructions.3: Blend until smooth.
instructions.4: Pour into glasses and garnish with mint.
instructions.5: For the banana juice: cut the bananas into small pieces and add the ice, milk, honey, syrup or sugar, and vanilla.
instructions.6: Blend until smooth.
instructions.7: Pour into glasses and garnish with banana slices.
instructions.8: For the melon juice: cube the melon and add the sugar, milk and ice.
instructions.9: Blend until smooth.
instructions.10: Pour into glasses and garnish with melon pieces.
instructions.11: For the lemonade: squeeze the lemons and remove the seeds.
instructions.12: Add the sugar and water and mix well.
instructions.13: Strain to remove the peels.
instructions.14: Add the mint leaves and ice and blend once more.
instructions.15: Pour into glasses and garnish with lemon slices and mint.

fah-795.title: Iced White Mocha
fah-795.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-795.culturalNotes: Sweeten with sugar, honey or caramel syrup to taste.

instructions.1: Melt the white chocolate in the microwave for 30 seconds.
instructions.2: Mix the melted chocolate with the coffee dissolved in water.
instructions.3: Add the liquid vanilla to the mixture.
instructions.4: Put the mixture in the cup.
instructions.5: Fill the cup with ice.
instructions.6: Pour the milk over the mixture.
instructions.7: Add whipping cream and caramel syrup to taste.

fah-796.title: Cappuccino
fah-796.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-796.culturalNotes: Store the foam in an airtight container in the freezer so it lasts longer.

instructions.1: Mix the Nescafé, sugar and water in a cup.
instructions.2: Beat with an electric whisk for 5 minutes, starting on low speed and increasing gradually.
instructions.3: Keep whipping until you have a thick white foam.
instructions.4: Pour the foam into a clean, dry, airtight container.
instructions.5: Add the foam to a cup of hot milk with a spoonful of sugar if you like.
instructions.6: Garnish the cappuccino with a little grated cocoa on top.

fah-797.title: Foamy Nescafé
fah-797.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-797.culturalNotes: Serve with a small piece of chocolate or a biscuit to garnish.

instructions.1: Add a spoonful of Nescafé, a spoonful of sugar and a spoonful of water to a cup.
instructions.2: Whisk the mixture as shown until well blended.
instructions.3: Add the hot milk gradually to the mixture.
instructions.4: Stir vigorously to make the foam.
instructions.5: Dust a pinch of cocoa on top to garnish.

fah-798.title: Macchiato
fah-798.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-798.culturalNotes: Garnish with cream or chocolate pieces as you like. Macchiato also goes well with biscuits or a small cake.

instructions.1: Bring the milk to room temperature or take it out of the fridge a few minutes ahead.
instructions.2: Use a steam wand to heat the milk and make foam. Without one, use an electric or hand whisk to make the milk foamy.
instructions.3: Put the coarse ground coffee in a small cup.
instructions.4: Pour the milk foam over the coffee in the cup.
instructions.5: Add sugar to taste.
instructions.6: Serve hot.

fah-799.title: Delicious Doum Drink
fah-799.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-799.culturalNotes: Doum drink is cooling and healthy — it helps regulate blood pressure and cleanse the liver, kidneys and spleen. Serve cold on hot days.

instructions.1: Wash the doum well to remove any impurities or dust.
instructions.2: Put the sugar in a pot over the heat and stir it with the doum until it softens slightly, without colouring.
instructions.3: Add 2 litres of water and let the mixture heat without boiling.
instructions.4: Cover the pot, take it off the heat and leave it soaking in the fridge overnight.
instructions.5: Strain the drink well the next day.
instructions.6: You can store the drink in bags in the freezer to use as needed.

fah-800.title: Immunity Lemon, Ginger & Honey Drink
fah-800.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-800.culturalNotes: Take a spoonful of the mixture daily for immunity and glowing skin. It can also be stirred into hot water before drinking.

instructions.1: Peel the ginger as you would peel potatoes.
instructions.2: Wash the ginger and lemons well and dry them.
instructions.3: Slice the ginger and lemons.
instructions.4: Mix the ginger and lemons in a bowl.
instructions.5: Put the mixture in a jar.
instructions.6: Pour the honey over the mixture.
instructions.7: Cover the jar and refrigerate for two hours before using.
instructions.8: The mixture keeps in the fridge for a week.

fah-801.title: Glow Drink (Spinach, Beetroot & Strawberry)
fah-801.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-801.culturalNotes: Rich in vitamins and minerals — good for the skin and hair. Adjust the honey to taste.

instructions.1: Add the spinach leaves to the blender.
instructions.2: Add the strawberries.
instructions.3: Add the beetroot cut into small pieces.
instructions.4: Add the orange juice.
instructions.5: Add the white honey.
instructions.6: Add the water.
instructions.7: Blend everything together until smooth.

fah-802.title: Strawberry Mojito
fah-802.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-802.culturalNotes: Any other fruit works — berries or orange, for example.

instructions.1: Prepare the strawberries and cut them into small pieces.
instructions.2: Add the strawberries to the glass with the sugar and lemon juice.
instructions.3: Add the hot water and stir until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.4: Add ice as desired and stir once more.
instructions.5: Serve the drink cold in glasses.

fah-803.title: Prickly Pear Milkshake
fah-803.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-803.culturalNotes: Fresh or tinned prickly pear both work for the juice. Add a little sugar if you like it sweeter.

instructions.1: Wash the prickly pears well and peel them.
instructions.2: Cut the prickly pears into small pieces and add to the blender with a cup of water.
instructions.3: Blend the prickly pear and water well.
instructions.4: Strain the mixture to remove the seeds.
instructions.5: Keep about a litre and a half of the juice.
instructions.6: In the blender jug, add 3 cups of prickly pear juice, a cup of vanilla ice cream, the packet of whipping cream and a little ice.
instructions.7: Blend well until combined.
instructions.8: Pour the milkshake into glasses and serve cold.

fah-804.title: Coffee Milkshake
fah-804.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-804.culturalNotes: Any plain biscuits work if coffee biscuits aren't available. Add sugar if you like it sweeter.

instructions.1: Add the milk, Nescafé, coffee biscuits, cup of vanilla ice cream and crushed ice to the blender.
instructions.2: Blend everything well until combined.
instructions.3: Pour the mixture into serving glasses.
instructions.4: Garnish with caramel sauce and raw whipping cream or vanilla ice cream.
instructions.5: Top each glass with a coffee biscuit or any plain biscuit.

fah-805.title: Mango Milkshake
fah-805.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-805.culturalNotes: Adjust the consistency with more ice or cold water. Garnish with berries or strawberries if you like.

instructions.1: Add the mango to the blender.
instructions.2: Add the ice cubes.
instructions.3: Add the vanilla ice cream.
instructions.4: Add the whipping cream.
instructions.5: Add the sugar.
instructions.6: Blend everything until smooth.
instructions.7: If it's too thick, add cold water or extra ice to reach the right consistency.
instructions.8: Pour the milkshake into glasses.
instructions.9: Garnish with a scoop of ice cream, mint leaves, mango cubes and a cherry.

fah-806.title: Oreo Milkshake
fah-806.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-806.culturalNotes: No extra sugar needed — the ice cream and Oreos are already sweet. Use chocolate sauce or any favourite sauce for flavour and looks.

instructions.1: Get the blender and add the ice cubes.
instructions.2: Add the vanilla ice cream.
instructions.3: Add the two cups of chilled milk.
instructions.4: Add the contents of the two Oreo packets.
instructions.5: Blend everything until combined.
instructions.6: Top with whipped cream or ice cream scoops as you like.
instructions.7: Garnish the glass with an Oreo biscuit or chocolate sauce.

fah-807.title: Nescafé with Cappuccino Foam
fah-807.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-807.culturalNotes: Keep the foam in a clean, airtight container in the freezer so it stays fresh longer.

instructions.1: Mix the Nescafé, sugar and water in a cup.
instructions.2: Beat with an electric whisk for 5 minutes, starting on low speed and increasing gradually.
instructions.3: Keep whipping until you have a thick white foam.
instructions.4: Store the foam in a clean, airtight container in the freezer.
instructions.5: To serve, add the foam to a cup of hot water or hot milk with sugar to taste.
instructions.6: Garnish with a little ground cocoa on top.

fah-808.title: Hot Chocolate with Marshmallows
fah-808.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-808.culturalNotes: Serve hot or cold as you like. Marshmallows on top make it look inviting.

instructions.1: Heat the kettle and add 2 cups of milk.
instructions.2: Add the two chocolate squares.
instructions.3: Stir until the chocolate melts.
instructions.4: Add 3 teaspoons of sugar to taste.
instructions.5: Leave the mixture until it boils and thickens.
instructions.6: Pour into cups and serve with marshmallows.

fah-242.title: Duqqa (Garlic & Pepper Relish)
fah-242.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-242.culturalNotes: Use the duqqa to marinate fish, stir into foul, or alongside pickles. It keeps for a long time in or out of the fridge.

instructions.1: Wash the peppers and garlic well and cut the peppers into small pieces.
instructions.2: Put the peppers and garlic in the food processor and grind well.
instructions.3: Add the vinegar, lemon juice, salt, dried coriander and cumin.
instructions.4: Blend everything in the processor until combined.
instructions.5: Put the duqqa in a clean, dry jar and keep it in or out of the fridge as you like.

fah-243.title: Pickled Potatoes
fah-243.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-243.culturalNotes: The salad keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days. Serve alongside breakfast, foul, ta'ameya or any other meal.

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes in boiling water for 3–4 minutes until half-cooked.
instructions.2: Drain and leave to cool slightly.
instructions.3: Peel the potatoes and cut them into small cubes.
instructions.4: Mix two tablespoons of the marinade (lemon, cumin, vinegar and garlic) with a tablespoon of oil and a teaspoon of turmeric.
instructions.5: Add the potato cubes to the marinade and mix well.
instructions.6: Add the minced garlic and minced parsley and mix together.
instructions.7: Serve the salad cold alongside any meal.

fah-244.title: Marinade for Fish & Poultry
fah-244.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-244.culturalNotes: Use this marinade to stuff aubergine or season fish and poultry. It keeps for a long time without refrigeration thanks to the salt and vinegar.

instructions.1: Blend the hot, sweet and red peppers with the vinegar, lemon, salt, coriander and cumin until the marinade is smooth.
instructions.2: Add the oil to the marinade and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the minced parsley and grated carrot and stir together.
instructions.4: Store the marinade in clean, dry jars in a cool, dry place.

fah-245.title: Toumeya (Hot Garlic Sauce)
fah-245.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-245.culturalNotes: Store the toumeya in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. Serve it with grilled chicken, fried potatoes or spiced rice.

instructions.1: Mix 2 cups of water with 4 tablespoons of cornflour in a pot, stirring while cold.
instructions.2: Put the mixture over the heat, add the 7 garlic cloves and stir until the starch binds and turns translucent white.
instructions.3: Let the mixture cool slightly, then put it in the blender.
instructions.4: Add a cup of yogurt, half a cup of mayonnaise, a pinch of salt and 2 tablespoons of vinegar. Cover and blend well.
instructions.5: Add half a cup of oil gradually while the blender runs until the mixture is uniform.
instructions.6: Add 3 tablespoons of harissa and blend once more until fully combined.

fah-246.title: Pepper & Vinegar Duqqa
fah-246.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-246.culturalNotes: This mix works in many dishes — shawarma, tahini salad, baba ghanoush, fish marinades and pickled aubergine. It keeps in an airtight container without refrigeration.

instructions.1: Wash the green and red peppers well.
instructions.2: Remove the seeds and cut the peppers into large pieces.
instructions.3: Put the peppers in the food processor.
instructions.4: Add the peeled, prepared onion.
instructions.5: Add the vinegar and lemon juice.
instructions.6: Add the cumin, coriander and salt.
instructions.7: Cover the processor and grind everything well.
instructions.8: Transfer the mix to a suitable storage container.

fah-247.title: Pepper & Coriander Duqqa
fah-247.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-247.culturalNotes: Use this duqqa to marinate fish, shrimp, aubergine and more. It keeps for a month outside the fridge.

instructions.1: Wash the hot and sweet peppers and the red and green peppers well.
instructions.2: Cut the peppers, fresh coriander and garlic into small pieces.
instructions.3: Mix everything in a deep bowl.
instructions.4: Add the vinegar, lemon juice, salt, cumin, dried coriander and chilli.
instructions.5: Blend the mixture well until combined.
instructions.6: Store the duqqa in an airtight container in or out of the fridge for a month.

fah-248.title: Parsley & Onion Salad
fah-248.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-248.culturalNotes: Add olives or fatta croutons for variety. The salad keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Chop the parsley finely.
instructions.2: Slice the onions thinly.
instructions.3: Cut the cucumber into small pieces.
instructions.4: Cut the tomatoes into medium pieces.
instructions.5: Put all the ingredients in a serving dish.
instructions.6: Add the salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, paprika and chilli to taste.
instructions.7: Toss the ingredients well.
instructions.8: Add the lemon juice and water and toss once more.
instructions.9: Serve cold with kofta and fried potatoes.

fah-249.title: Tuna Salad
fah-249.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-249.culturalNotes: Add hot pepper or green bell pepper to taste. Serve the tuna salad on toast or in sandwiches.

instructions.1: Mash the tuna well in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the coloured peppers cut into small cubes.
instructions.3: Add the onion cut into small pieces.
instructions.4: Add 4 tablespoons of sweetcorn (optional).
instructions.5: Add a pinch of salt.
instructions.6: Add the juice of the two lemons.
instructions.7: Mix everything together well.
instructions.8: Add 4 tablespoons of mayonnaise.
instructions.9: Mix once more until well combined.

fah-250.title: Grill-Style Salad (Salatit el-Hati)
fah-250.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-250.culturalNotes: Add ice cubes to make it cooler and more refreshing. Serve with grilled chicken or pasta with tomato sauce.

instructions.1: Cut the red onion into small pieces and put it in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the cumin, black pepper, dried coriander, salt, lemon juice, vinegar and ground pepper. Mix well.
instructions.3: Cut the cucumber, tomatoes, bell pepper and hot chilli into small pieces and add to the bowl.
instructions.4: Grate the carrot and add it to the bowl.
instructions.5: Add the dill, parsley and fresh coriander. Mix everything well.
instructions.6: Serve in a salad dish.

fah-251.title: Renga (Herring) Salad
fah-251.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-251.culturalNotes: Renga salad works as a light meal or part of a holiday spread. The dressing keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the tahini with a quarter cup of water and beat well.
instructions.2: Add the mayonnaise, lemon juice, vinegar, chilli, cumin and salt. Beat together.
instructions.3: Add the white onion cut into thin slices, the green and red peppers and the parsley. Mix well.
instructions.4: Add the cubed renga over the salad and toss together.
instructions.5: Garnish the dish with renga pieces, a renga rose and cherry tomatoes.
instructions.6: Add the boiled or fried potato cubes and cubed renga, and toss together.
instructions.7: Mix the tahini with the mayonnaise, lemon juice, oil and cream. Beat well.
instructions.8: Add the spring onions, pepper and dill. Mix together.
instructions.9: Garnish the dish with boiled potato slices, spring onions, dill and a lemon slice.
instructions.10: Boil water and add the renga for a minute until the skin loosens and the saltiness eases.
instructions.11: Peel the renga and remove the bones and innards.
instructions.12: Toss the renga with the lemon juice, tahini, crushed pepper and oil.

fah-252.title: Yogurt Salad (with Rice & Fall-Apart Chicken)
fah-252.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-252.culturalNotes: Add ground black pepper for more bite. The salad keeps in the fridge for up to 24 hours.

instructions.1: Cut the cucumbers into small cubes.
instructions.2: Crush the garlic well.
instructions.3: Cut the mint leaves into small pieces.
instructions.4: Mix all the ingredients in a deep dish.
instructions.5: Add the yogurt, mayonnaise, salt and lemon juice.
instructions.6: Stir until combined.
instructions.7: Serve the salad alongside the rice and fall-apart chicken.

fah-253.title: Harsha Salad (Spicy Chopped Salad)
fah-253.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-253.culturalNotes: Add grated carrot or chopped cucumber for more flavour and nutrition. The salad keeps in the fridge for up to 24 hours.

instructions.1: Cut the red onions into small cubes.
instructions.2: Cut the tomatoes, red pepper and green pepper into small cubes.
instructions.3: Chop the parsley and coriander into small pieces.
instructions.4: Slice the garlic thinly.
instructions.5: Mix everything in a large bowl.
