instructions.7: Add the 2 saffron-karak sachets and mix well.
instructions.8: Pour into an oiled, floured tray.
instructions.9: Bake in a preheated 180°C oven for 30 minutes or until golden.
instructions.10: Cool slightly, then serve with the condensed-milk sauce.

fah-581.title: Cake Drowned in Chocolate Sauce
fah-581.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-581.culturalNotes: Use 100% raw cocoa for a rich, wholesome taste. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the eggs, vanilla, milk, oil and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the semolina, coconut, raw cocoa, flour and baking powder gradually while stirring.
instructions.3: Stir in one direction until combined.
instructions.4: Pour into a 26 cm tin, oiled and floured.
instructions.5: Bake in a preheated 180°C oven for 45 minutes.
instructions.6: In another pot, mix half a cup of sugar, half a cup of cocoa and 2 cups of water.
instructions.7: Boil for 3–4 minutes, then pour over the cooled cake.
instructions.8: In another bowl, mix a cup of sugar, half a cup of cocoa and a cup of warm milk.
instructions.9: Blend with an electric mixer until smooth.
instructions.10: Add half a cup of oil gradually while mixing until you get a creamy chocolate sauce.
instructions.11: Soak the cake with the syrup, then spread the chocolate sauce on top.
instructions.12: Cool completely before serving.

fah-582.title: Chocolate Mousse Cake
fah-582.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-582.culturalNotes: Serve in cups or as a large tray tart. Decorate with grated chocolate or fresh fruit.

instructions.1: Make the batter: mix the flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: In another bowl, beat the eggs with the vanilla and sugar until white.
instructions.3: Add the oil and milk to the egg mix and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the flour mix gradually and stir until smooth.
instructions.5: Pour into a buttered, floured tray.
instructions.6: Bake in a preheated 180°C oven for 40–45 minutes.
instructions.7: Test with a toothpick for doneness.
instructions.8: Cut off the dry top of the cake and keep it.
instructions.9: Put the cake into cups or a tray.
instructions.10: Soak the cake with the milk-and-Nesquik mix.
instructions.11: Make the mousse: put a kilo of milk in a pot over the heat.
instructions.12: Add the 6 spoons of Nesquik, 6 of chantilly, a quarter cup of sugar, the two cream caramel sachets, the 2 plain chocolates and the 2 spoons of cornflour.
instructions.13: Stir until thick.
instructions.14: Pour the mousse over the cake in the cups or tray.
instructions.15: Cool, then refrigerate for at least two hours.
instructions.16: Serve cold.

fah-583.title: Yogurt Cake
fah-583.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-583.culturalNotes: Serve with a glass of milk. The cake stays fresh a long time in a cool, dry spot.

instructions.1: Blend the yogurt, ghee or oil, sugar, eggs, vanilla and salt.
instructions.2: Add the sifted flour gradually and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the cake-mix sachet and mix until combined.
instructions.4: Butter the tin and dust with flour.
instructions.5: Pour the batter in.
instructions.6: Bake in a preheated 180°C oven for 45 minutes.
instructions.7: Cool before serving.

fah-584.title: No-Oven Chocolate & Coffee Cake
fah-584.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-584.culturalNotes: Cool the cake completely before the syrup so it absorbs better. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Blend the sugar, oil, milk and cocoa until combined.
instructions.2: Add the vanilla and blend again.
instructions.3: Sift the flour, baking powder and salt together.
instructions.4: Add the dry mix to the wet and whisk well.
instructions.5: Oil the cake tin and set it inside a bigger tray of boiling water.
instructions.6: Cover the tin with a towel and a lid; cook over high heat for 5 minutes, then low for 15.
instructions.7: Cool the cake completely.
instructions.8: Make the syrup with the coffee, honey and hot water, then add cold water to cool it.
instructions.9: Soak the fully cooled cake with the syrup.
instructions.10: Cover with the chocolate sauce and cocoa.
instructions.11: Cool completely before serving.

fah-585.title: Russian Honey Cake
fah-585.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-585.culturalNotes: White or black honey both work — black deepens the colour. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the brown sugar, eggs, vanilla and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the butter and honey and mix well.
instructions.3: Warm over medium heat, stirring until the butter and sugar melt.
instructions.4: Add the bicarbonate and mix well.
instructions.5: Add the flour gradually until a cohesive dough forms.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and refrigerate for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Cut the dough into 8 equal pieces.
instructions.8: Roll each piece on baking paper or a silicone mat to 2 mm thick.
instructions.9: Cut with a round cutter and prick with a fork.
instructions.10: Bake the rounds at 175°C for 7 minutes.
instructions.11: Repeat for all pieces.
instructions.12: Whip the dessert cream, sour cream, cream cheese and icing sugar together.
instructions.13: Layer cake then cream, repeating to the last layer.
instructions.14: Decorate with crumbled dough and baked trimmings.
instructions.15: Chill for 30 minutes before serving.

fah-586.title: Coffee Cake
fah-586.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-586.culturalNotes: Any nuts work for garnish. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Sift the flour, cocoa and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: In another bowl, beat the eggs with the sugar and vanilla.
instructions.3: Add the oil gradually, beating well.
instructions.4: Add the Nescafé dissolved in the water and the milk, and mix well.
instructions.5: Add the flour mix gradually and stir until combined.
instructions.6: Heat the oven to 170°C.
instructions.7: Grease the tin with ghee and dust with flour or flour mixed with cocoa.
instructions.8: Pour the batter in and bake for 40–50 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: In a bowl, whip the milk, icing sugar, milk powder, chantilly, Kiri cheese and Nescafé until smooth and creamy.
instructions.10: Cool the cake slightly, then pour the cream over it.
instructions.11: Decorate with grated chocolate and crushed pistachios.

fah-587.title: Giant Cookie Cake
fah-587.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-587.culturalNotes: Serve with ice cream for a great combo. Keeps in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Melt the butter until golden.
instructions.2: Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well.
instructions.3: Add the brown sugar, white sugar and vanilla and mix.
instructions.4: Add the flour with the baking powder, bicarbonate and salt and mix.
instructions.5: Knead the dough by hand for 15 minutes.
instructions.6: Fold in the chocolate chips.
instructions.7: Chill the dough in the freezer for 15 minutes.
instructions.8: Spread it on a baking tray.
instructions.9: Bake in a preheated 250°C (480°F) oven for 10–15 minutes.
instructions.10: Cool slightly before cutting.

fah-588.title: Fluffy Lemon Cake
fah-588.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-588.culturalNotes: Mix the ingredients well for a fluffy, spongy cake. Serve with tea or coffee.

instructions.1: Blend the eggs, oil, sugar, yogurt, lemon juice and vanilla until combined.
instructions.2: Mix the flour, baking powder, bicarbonate and salt in another bowl.
instructions.3: Add the flour mix gradually to the egg mix, stirring one way.
instructions.4: Add the lemon zest and mix well.
instructions.5: Pour into a ghee-greased, floured tray.
instructions.6: Bake in a preheated 170°C oven for 30 minutes or until golden.
instructions.7: Make the sauce by mixing the icing sugar, cream cheese, lemon juice, water and vanilla.
instructions.8: Chill the sauce in the fridge.
instructions.9: Take the cake out and cool slightly before cutting.
instructions.10: Spread the sauce over the cooled cake and decorate with lemon zest and cherries.

fah-589.title: Despacito Cakes
fah-589.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-589.culturalNotes: Bring all ingredients to room temperature before starting. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Beat the eggs with the sugar, vanilla and vinegar until creamy.
instructions.2: Add the oil and milk and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the flour, baking powder, cocoa and salt and stir until combined.
instructions.4: Pour into the despacito moulds and bake in a preheated 170°C oven for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Test with a toothpick for doneness.
instructions.6: Mix the milk and Nesquik and pour over the hot cakes.
instructions.7: Whip the raw cream, cold milk, sugar and cocoa for 7 minutes until stiff.
instructions.8: Add the Nutella and whip again.
instructions.9: Pour the cream over the cakes.
instructions.10: Heat the cream and pour over the grated chocolate, stirring until melted.
instructions.11: Pour the ganache over the cakes.
instructions.12: Decorate with marshmallows, truffles or chocolates as you like.
instructions.13: Refrigerate for 30 minutes before serving.

fah-590.title: Marble Cake
fah-590.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-590.culturalNotes: Serve warm or cold, with chocolate sauce or cream.

instructions.1: Blend the 4 eggs with 1¼ cups of sugar and 1¼ cups of warm milk.
instructions.2: Add a cup of ghee and a quarter cup of oil.
instructions.3: Add a tablespoon of vinegar and a pinch of salt and blend for 4 minutes until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix the 3 cups of flour with the baking-powder sachet and half a teaspoon of bicarbonate.
instructions.5: Add the dry mix gradually to the liquids, stirring one way until lump-free.
instructions.6: Split the batter into two parts: one third and two thirds.
instructions.7: Add a quarter cup of raw cocoa and a quarter cup of warm milk to the third and mix well.
instructions.8: Butter the cake tin and dust with flour.
instructions.9: Layer white batter then chocolate batter alternately until used up.
instructions.10: Tap the tin twice and bake in a 180°C oven for 40 minutes.
instructions.11: Test with a toothpick — clean means done.

fah-591.title: Marble Cake (Tiger Cake)
fah-591.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-591.culturalNotes: Serve with plain tea, milky tea or mint tea. Keeps in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Heat the oven to 180°C (bottom heat only).
instructions.2: Beat the eggs, vanilla, salt and sugar in the blender until creamy.
instructions.3: Add the ghee-and-oil mix gradually, beating well.
instructions.4: Add half a cup of milk and beat well.
instructions.5: Mix the sifted flour and baking powder separately, then add gradually, beating until combined.
instructions.6: Add the rest of the milk and beat well.
instructions.7: In a small bowl, mix a quarter cup of milk with two tablespoons of vinegar and three teaspoons of baking powder. Beat until it foams.
instructions.8: Add the foaming mix to the batter and beat well.
instructions.9: Beat until smooth and pourable.
instructions.10: Move about a third of the batter to a small bowl, add a quarter cup of cocoa and a quarter cup of milk and mix well.
instructions.11: Pour the white batter into the cake tray, then add the chocolate batter alternately.
instructions.12: Bake for 30–35 minutes until golden and cooked through.
instructions.13: Cool before serving.

fah-592.title: Mini Red Velvet Cakes
fah-592.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-592.culturalNotes: Try different flavours like chocolate or vanilla for the cake and cream. Leftover cake makes a cup trifle.

instructions.1: Make the batter: beat the eggs with the sugar, vinegar and vanilla until white.
instructions.2: Add the butter, oil and laban, beating in the same direction.
instructions.3: Mix the cocoa, baking powder and bicarbonate with the flour, then add gradually to the liquids while beating.
instructions.4: Add the red colouring and mix until you reach the shade you want.
instructions.5: Grease the cake tin with ghee and dust with flour, then pour in the batter.
instructions.6: Bake in a 170°C oven for 12–15 minutes and test with a skewer.
instructions.7: Make the cream: beat the cream cheese until smooth, add the melted butter and vanilla and mix well.
instructions.8: Add the icing sugar gradually while beating until creamy and white.
instructions.9: Chill the cream for 10 minutes to firm.
instructions.10: Cut the cake into small pieces, then halve each piece.
instructions.11: On the serving dish, layer cake then cream, repeating until everything is used.
instructions.12: Decorate with leftover cake crumbs, cream and strawberries if you like.
instructions.13: Serve the mini cakes warm or cold.

fah-593.title: Homemade Cream Cheese
fah-593.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-593.culturalNotes: Decorate the cream cheese with thyme, nigella seeds or olive oil to taste.

instructions.1: Once the milk boils, add a tablespoon of vinegar and stir well.
instructions.2: Strain the curdled milk through a fine sieve.
instructions.3: Keep the whey and use it in pastries or drinks.
instructions.4: Put the solid curds in a bowl and drain.
instructions.5: Add half a cup of milk, 2 tablespoons of milk powder and a small pinch of salt.
instructions.6: Mix well.
instructions.7: Add half a cup of oil gradually, kneading until creamy.
instructions.8: Refrigerate the cream cheese to firm up its texture.

fah-594.title: Original Homemade Nutella
fah-594.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-594.culturalNotes: Chill the Nutella before using for a better texture. Add a quarter cup more oil for a lighter spread. Serve it in kids' sandwiches.

instructions.1: Grind the hazelnuts with a little oil in the grinder.
instructions.2: Add the condensed milk to the ground hazelnuts.
instructions.3: Add the Spanish cocoa (or Nesquik) and mix well.
instructions.4: Add the rest of the milk and oil and stir until combined.
instructions.5: Pour into jars and keep in the fridge.

fah-595.title: Energy Bars
fah-595.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-595.culturalNotes: Freeze the cut bars in a freezer-safe box. Serve with tea or coffee, or pack in lunch boxes.

fah-595-i10.name: Dried fruit (figs, prunes, dates, raisins, apricots)

instructions.1: Toast the nuts lightly in the oven, then cool.
instructions.2: Beat the eggs with the vanilla in a bowl until pale.
instructions.3: Add the sugar and beat until combined.
instructions.4: Add the salt, vinegar and oil and beat together.
instructions.5: Mix the flour, baking powder and cinnamon, then add to the batter and mix well.
instructions.6: Fold in the dried fruit and toasted nuts.
instructions.7: Pour into a 30×40 cm tray, greased with ghee and dusted with flour.
instructions.8: Level the mixture in the tray.
instructions.9: Bake in a preheated 170°C oven for 15 minutes or until golden.
instructions.10: Take out, cool slightly, then cut into small pieces.

fah-596.title: Soft Butter Biscuits
fah-596.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-596.culturalNotes: Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week. Serve with tea or coffee.

instructions.1: Beat the butter with the electric mixer until creamy.
instructions.2: Add the sifted sugar and mix until light and fluffy.
instructions.3: Add the vanilla and salt and mix again.
instructions.4: Add the sifted flour gradually and mix until combined.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Take the dough out and shape as you like.
instructions.7: Heat the oven to 170°C.
instructions.8: Bake the biscuits for 15 minutes or until golden.
instructions.9: Cool before serving.

fah-597.title: Melting Happiness Biscuits
fah-597.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-597.culturalNotes: Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week. Serve with tea or coffee.

instructions.1: The butter should be soft — not melted or hard.
instructions.2: Beat the butter with the icing sugar until creamy.
instructions.3: Add the eggs one at a time, mixing until fully absorbed.
instructions.4: Add the vanilla and salt and mix well.
instructions.5: Sift the flour and cornflour into the butter mix and fold gently with fingertips until the dough comes together.
instructions.6: Split the dough in half; add a tablespoon of cocoa to one half and mix.
instructions.7: Roll each half between plastic sheets into rectangles.
instructions.8: Stack the sheets alternately: chocolate, vanilla, chocolate, vanilla, chocolate.
instructions.9: Cut into equal rectangles.
instructions.10: Bake in a preheated 170°C oven for 15 minutes.
instructions.11: Cool on a rack, then serve.

fah-598.title: Cinnabon Biscuits
fah-598.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-598.culturalNotes: Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week. Dust with icing sugar out of the oven for a pretty look.

instructions.1: Beat the butter until smooth.
instructions.2: Add the sifted icing sugar and beat until creamy and pale.
instructions.3: Add the egg and vanilla and mix until combined.
instructions.4: Add the flour and cornflour gradually while mixing until the dough comes together.
instructions.5: Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Roll the dough between two sheets of foil to about 2–3 mm.
instructions.7: Sprinkle cinnamon over the rolled dough.
instructions.8: Roll it up like a cinnamon roll.
instructions.9: Cut the roll into thin slices.
instructions.10: Lay the slices on an oiled tray.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated 180°C oven.
instructions.12: Bake for 15 minutes or until golden.
instructions.13: Cool completely.

fah-599.title: No-Bake Date-Paste Biscuits
fah-599.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-599.culturalNotes: Serve with milk tea or Nescafé. Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week.

instructions.1: Toast the semolina and milk powder in a pot until golden.
instructions.2: Add the butter and cream and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the minced dates and knead until a cohesive dough forms.
instructions.4: Put the dough in a buttered freezer bag and flatten to about 2 mm.
instructions.5: Cut into rectangles and coat all sides with tea biscuits.
instructions.6: Coat the roll in toasted sesame on all sides.
instructions.7: Refrigerate for 3–4 hours until firm.
instructions.8: Cut into small pieces and serve.

fah-600.title: Ten-Minute Biscuits
fah-600.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-600.culturalNotes: Any jam works — grind it well to avoid big chunks. Shape with a cutter or fork.

instructions.1: Mix the egg with the sugar, vanilla, milk, oil and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the flour and baking powder and stir.
instructions.3: Pour the wet mix over the flour and knead by hand until easy to shape.
instructions.4: Cover the dough a few minutes so it doesn't dry.
instructions.5: Shape into equal balls on an oiled tray.
instructions.6: Press a well in the centre of each ball with a wooden spoon or your finger.
instructions.7: Fill the wells with jam.
instructions.8: Bake at 170°C for 10–15 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Mix part of the dough with cocoa, shape into balls and coat in coarse sugar.
instructions.10: Bake those too at 170°C for 10–15 minutes.

fah-601.title: Lancashire Biscuits
fah-601.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-601.culturalNotes: Decorate with crushed hazelnuts, jam, chocolate or other nuts. Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week.

instructions.1: Cream the sugar and ghee with a hand or electric whisk.
instructions.2: Add the eggs and vanilla and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the salt and baking powder and mix.
instructions.4: Sift the cornflour and flour together.
instructions.5: Add the flour mix gradually to the ghee-egg mix and stir well.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
instructions.7: Heat the oven to 160°C.
instructions.8: Line the baking tray with baking paper.
instructions.9: Shape small balls and space them on the tray.
instructions.10: Bake for 15 minutes until golden.
instructions.11: Cool on the tray.
instructions.12: Decorate with crushed hazelnuts, jam, chocolate or other nuts.

fah-602.title: Ammonia & Orange Biscuits
fah-602.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-602.culturalNotes: Store in an airtight tin to keep them crisp. Adjust the quantities as you like.

instructions.1: Cut the butter and ghee into small cubes and beat together until creamy.
instructions.2: Add the sifted icing sugar and beat for 10 minutes until creamy.
instructions.3: Add the eggs one at a time while beating until combined.
instructions.4: Add the vanilla and salt and beat again.
instructions.5: Add the flour gradually on low speed until the dough comes together.
instructions.6: Add the warm milk with the baker's ammonia gradually and stir until combined.
instructions.7: Split the dough in half; add the orange essence and zest to the first half.
instructions.8: Pipe the biscuits onto a lightly oiled tray.
instructions.9: Bake at 160–170°C for 15–20 minutes until golden.
instructions.10: Lift them off the tray at once so they don't stick.

fah-603.title: Soft Butter Biscuits (Nawaem)
fah-603.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-603.culturalNotes: Use kahk/biscuit flour for the best result. The butter should be cold. Cream the sugar and butter well. Bake on the middle shelf of a preheated oven.

instructions.1: The butter should be fridge-cold — firm but pliable.
instructions.2: Cut 400 g of butter into a bowl.
instructions.3: Add the sifted icing sugar and mix until creamy.
instructions.4: Add a teaspoon of vanilla and a pinch of salt and mix again.
instructions.5: Sift in the kilo of kahk and biscuit flour.
instructions.6: Knead until the dough is soft and smooth.
instructions.7: Put the dough in a piping bag and shape the biscuits on an aluminium tray.
instructions.8: Leave space between each biscuit.
instructions.9: Bake in a preheated 170°C oven for 12–15 minutes.
instructions.10: Cool before serving.

fah-604.title: Diet Chocolate Pudding
fah-604.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-604.culturalNotes: Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days. Serve with fresh fruit.

instructions.1: Mix the skimmed milk, ground oats, cornflour, raw cocoa and cinnamon in a cold pot.
instructions.2: Stir until combined.
instructions.3: Set over the heat, stirring constantly until creamy and lump-free.
instructions.4: Add the sweetener and stir until dissolved.
instructions.5: Pour into your dishes and cool.
instructions.6: Decorate with whole oats and dried almonds.

fah-605.title: Biscuit & Chocolate Truffles
fah-605.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-605.culturalNotes: The mixture must be cold before it goes over the biscuits so they don't soften. Freezes for longer storage.

instructions.1: Mix the milk, sugar, milk powder, cornflour and raw cocoa in a pot.
instructions.2: Heat gently, stirring, until thick.
instructions.3: Add the grated chocolate and butter and stir until melted.
instructions.4: Cool the mixture.
instructions.5: Break the biscuits into small pieces.
instructions.6: Fold the cooled mixture into the broken biscuits.
instructions.7: Add two tablespoons of oil to the mixture.
instructions.8: Shape balls with a teaspoon and set on baking paper.
instructions.9: Coat the balls in melted chocolate with a teaspoon of oil mixed in.
instructions.10: Decorate with nuts if you like.
instructions.11: Serve with Arabic coffee.

fah-606.title: Cold No-Bake Torta
fah-606.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-606.culturalNotes: Cocoa or plain milk can replace the Nescafé. Longer in the fridge gives a better result.

instructions.1: Make the chantilly: whip the chantilly cream with the iced water and icing sugar.
instructions.2: Make the caramel at home or use ready-made.
instructions.3: Beat the cream cheese until creamy.
instructions.4: Add the caramel to the cream cheese and beat together.
instructions.5: Fold in the chantilly and beat until combined.
instructions.6: Dissolve the Nescafé in the cup of milk.
instructions.7: Dip the biscuits in the Nescafé milk and layer them in a square or round tin.
instructions.8: Layer biscuits then the caramel cream, repeating until used up.
instructions.9: Cover the torta with a last layer of the cream.
instructions.10: Cover with cling film and refrigerate at least 3 hours.
instructions.11: Dust with cocoa before serving.

fah-607.title: No-Oven Torta
fah-607.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-607.culturalNotes: Keep the heat very low when cooking the cake, and use baking paper to protect the serving surface. Strawberries and grated chocolate decorate it nicely.

instructions.1: Whisk the eggs and vanilla by hand.
instructions.2: Add the sugar and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the oil gradually while mixing.
instructions.4: Add the milk gradually while mixing.
instructions.5: Add the sifted flour, baking powder, salt and cocoa.
instructions.6: Mix until smooth.
instructions.7: Warm a pan over low heat and oil it.
instructions.8: Pour in some batter and cover the pan.
instructions.9: Flip the cake when steam beads appear on the lid.
instructions.10: Repeat until you have 4 cake layers.
instructions.11: Cool the cake for 4–5 hours.
instructions.12: Make the chantilly from the cream, sugar and cold milk.
instructions.13: Add cocoa or melted chocolate to taste.
instructions.14: Lay a cake layer and soak it with the cocoa-milk mix.
instructions.15: Add a layer of chantilly and strawberry pieces.
instructions.16: Repeat to the last layer.
instructions.17: Coat the torta with chantilly.
instructions.18: Decorate with melted chocolate and strawberries.
instructions.19: Refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving.

fah-608.title: Pineapple Jelly Torta
fah-608.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-608.culturalNotes: Any tinned or fresh fruit adds flavour. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Empty the two pineapple-jelly packs into a bowl.
instructions.2: Add 1¼ cups of boiling water and stir until fully dissolved.
instructions.3: Add 1¼ cups of cold water and stir again.
instructions.4: Lightly oil a tray.
instructions.5: Lay the pineapple slices in the base with a cherry on each.
instructions.6: Pour the jelly over the pineapple.
instructions.7: Refrigerate until set.
instructions.8: After about 4–5 hours, take the tray out.
instructions.9: Pour half a cup of hot water over the surface to loosen the torta.
instructions.10: Turn the tray gently onto the serving dish.
instructions.11: Top with the cake slice and drizzle the pineapple compote.
instructions.12: Chill again until fully set.

fah-609.title: Savory Tuna & Vegetable Torta
fah-609.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-609.culturalNotes: Decorate with colourful vegetables for birthdays or gatherings.

instructions.1: Prepare the vegetables: grated carrots, finely chopped onion, finely chopped green pepper and the lemon juice.
instructions.2: Drain the tuna and mix with the vegetables and mayonnaise, adding chili paste and salt to taste.
instructions.3: Lay toast slices in a cheesecake tin, then a layer of the tuna mix.
instructions.4: Repeat toast then tuna layers to the end.
instructions.5: Finish with a last layer of toast.
instructions.6: Spread cream cheese over the top and coat the sides.
instructions.7: Refrigerate at least two hours.
instructions.8: Open the tin and serve.
instructions.9: Decorate with grated carrots, cucumber roses, coloured peppers and black olives.

fah-610.title: No-Bake Gâteau
fah-610.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-610.culturalNotes: Serve at birthdays or family gatherings. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the milk, raw cocoa, milk powder, icing sugar and vanilla in a bowl.
instructions.2: Heat, stirring constantly, until combined and thick.
instructions.3: Add the butter and stir until melted.
instructions.4: Add the grated dark chocolate and stir until melted.
instructions.5: Scatter over the broken biscuits and stir to combine.
instructions.6: Press into cupcake moulds or a large tin.
instructions.7: Cover with cling film and refrigerate at least 6 hours.
instructions.8: Unmould and decorate with white chocolate and cherries or strawberries.

fah-611.title: Qarish Cheese (Farmer's Cheese)
fah-611.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-611.culturalNotes: Fresh milk works instead of laban. Qarish is gentle on the stomach — serve with honey or fruit.

instructions.1: Boil the milk in a pot over low heat.
instructions.2: Cover and leave in the warm oven for 24 hours.
instructions.3: Strain the laban in a sieve and sprinkle a teaspoon of salt over it.
instructions.4: Leave the cheese in the sieve until it drains.
instructions.5: Cut into small pieces and serve.
instructions.6: Use the drained liquid (whey) to make mish.

fah-612.title: Fellahi (Village) Cheese
fah-612.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-612.culturalNotes: Add red and green pepper pieces for a distinct flavour. Keeps in the fridge for a month.

instructions.1: Put the milk in a pot over low heat.
instructions.2: Add the salt and stir well.
instructions.3: Warm until just warm — not boiling.
instructions.4: Take off the heat and add the rennet.
instructions.5: Stir well and cover the pot.
instructions.6: Leave for 4 hours or until completely cool.
instructions.7: Strain the cheese through a sieve lined with white cheesecloth.
instructions.8: Salt the drained whey and stir well.
instructions.9: Submerge the cheese in the salted water and cover.
instructions.10: Store in an airtight container in the fridge.

fah-613.title: Fruit Jelly
fah-613.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-613.culturalNotes: Any fruit at home works. Serve with a little honey or sugar to taste.

instructions.1: Peel the fruit and cut into small pieces.
instructions.2: Put the fruit in the jelly mould.
instructions.3: Dissolve the jelly in hot water until smooth.
instructions.4: Add the iced water to the dissolved jelly and stir well.
instructions.5: Pour the jelly mix over the fruit in the mould.
instructions.6: Refrigerate for 4–5 hours until set.
instructions.7: Turn out of the mould and serve.

fah-614.title: Cola Jelly
fah-614.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-614.culturalNotes: Use colourful shaped moulds to please kids. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Open the crystal-jelly pack.
instructions.2: Add a tablespoon of vegetarian gelatin powder.
instructions.3: Mix well.
instructions.4: Add a cup of boiling water and stir until fully dissolved.
instructions.5: Pour into silicone moulds.
instructions.6: Refrigerate until set.
instructions.7: Unmould and serve.

fah-615.title: Mango Jelly Cake
fah-615.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-615.culturalNotes: Use different fruits in the jelly layer to taste. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Make the cake: beat the eggs with the vanilla, vinegar, sugar and salt until foamy.
instructions.2: Add the flour and baking powder and mix on low until combined.
instructions.3: Pour into a 30×30 cm tray and bake for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.4: Take the cake out and turn it for soaking with syrup.
instructions.5: Make the syrup: mix the warm water with two spoons of honey, pour over the cake and let it absorb.
instructions.6: Make the pudding: mix the milk, sugar, cornflour and vanilla; heat, whisking until boiling and thick.
instructions.7: Add the crushed mastic and butter and mix. Pour the pudding over the soaked cake and cool.
instructions.8: Make the jelly: dissolve the two mango-jelly packs in 1½ cups of hot water.
instructions.9: Add 1½ cups of ice and stir. Cut the mango into medium cubes and add to the jelly.
instructions.10: Pour the jelly over the pudding and refrigerate 3 hours until set.
instructions.11: Serve cold, decorated with fresh mango.

fah-616.title: Halawa Spread
fah-616.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-616.culturalNotes: Keeps in jars in the fridge for over a month. Serve in sandwiches or as a light sweet.

instructions.1: Blend the milk powder and icing sugar.
instructions.2: Add the tahini and vanilla.
instructions.3: Add 1½ cups of boiling water.
instructions.4: Blend until combined.
instructions.5: Pour into clean, dry jars.

fah-617.title: Milk Sweet (Raqaq with Milk & Sugar)
fah-617.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-617.culturalNotes: Add vanilla for flavour. Leftovers keep in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Warm the half kilo of milk with two spoons of ghee and two tablespoons of sugar, stirring well.
instructions.2: Add the raqaq and stir it into the milk, sugar and ghee.
instructions.3: When the mixture is ready, take off the heat and pour into a dish.
instructions.4: Sprinkle sugar and a spoon of ghee on top.
instructions.5: Start folding the raqaq like a handkerchief.
instructions.6: Put the mix back on the heat a few minutes until crisp.
instructions.7: Serve the milk sweet hot.

fah-618.title: Biscuit Dessert with Jelly & Cream Caramel
fah-618.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-618.culturalNotes: Plain tea biscuits or vanilla cake can replace the Eid biscuits. Nice as a summer dessert or for gatherings.

instructions.1: Line the biscuits in a Pyrex dish or regular tray.
instructions.2: Make the cream caramel: heat the 2 packs with a litre of milk until boiling, then take off.
instructions.3: Pour half the hot caramel over the biscuit layer.
instructions.4: Cool slightly, then pour the rest over the biscuits.
instructions.5: Make the jelly: heat the 2 strawberry-jelly packs with a litre of water until boiling, then take off.
instructions.6: Add two cups of cold water to the boiled jelly and stir.
instructions.7: Cool the jelly to room temperature.
instructions.8: Pour the jelly over the cream caramel in the dish.
instructions.9: Refrigerate for an hour or until fully cold.

fah-619.title: Happiness Dessert Cups
fah-619.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-619.culturalNotes: The jelly must be fully set before the mahalabia goes on. Serve cold with fruit or chocolate.

instructions.1: Pour the cup of boiling water over the jelly pack and stir well.
instructions.2: Add the cup of cold water and stir.
instructions.3: Cut the bananas and divide among the cups.
instructions.4: Pour the slightly cooled jelly over the bananas, then chill the cups briefly until set.
instructions.5: Mix half a cup of milk with 2 tablespoons of cornflour.
instructions.6: Add the two cups of milk, 3 tablespoons of sugar and the vanilla to the cornflour mix, heat and stir until thick.
instructions.7: Crumble the Eid biscuits in a thin layer over the set jelly.
instructions.8: Pour the mahalabia over the biscuit layer.
instructions.9: Refrigerate the cups until fully cold.

fah-620.title: Multi-Layer Jelly Dessert
fah-620.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-620.culturalNotes: Let each layer set fully before the next for clean stripes. Serve cold with cream or fresh fruit.

instructions.1: Grind the plain biscuits into the tin for the base layer.
instructions.2: Heat the half kilo of milk, add the banana-pudding sachet and stir until boiling, then take off.
instructions.3: Cut the bananas over the biscuit layer.
instructions.4: Pour the pudding over the bananas and cool.
instructions.5: Dissolve the strawberry jelly in a cup of boiling water, add a cup of cold water and chill until set.
instructions.6: Dissolve the green-apple jelly the same way and pour over the set strawberry layer.
instructions.7: Dissolve the mango jelly the same way and pour over the set apple layer.
instructions.8: Chill until all layers are set.

fah-621.title: Homemade Condensed Milk
fah-621.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-621.culturalNotes: Use in desserts like cinnabon and kunafa. Keeps a long time in an airtight container in the fridge.

instructions.1: Get the blender or processor.
instructions.2: Add everything: a cup of milk powder, a cup of icing sugar, a quarter cup of warm water and a tablespoon of butter.
instructions.3: Blend until combined.
instructions.4: Add an extra spoon of water if too thick.
instructions.5: The texture should be smooth and even.

fah-622.title: Danette-Style Chocolate Pudding
fah-622.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-622.culturalNotes: Pack it for kids' school or club snacks — light and wholesome. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Pour the milk into a pot over the heat.
instructions.2: Add the cornflour and chantilly while stirring.
instructions.3: Add the sugar and sweetened cocoa and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the grated chocolate and stir until melted.
instructions.5: Add the vanilla and stir again.
instructions.6: Pour into cups or small bowls.
instructions.7: Cool slightly before serving.

fah-623.title: Caramel Danette
fah-623.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-623.culturalNotes: Cut the sugar to half or a quarter cup to taste. Keeps in the fridge for up to a week.

instructions.1: Put the cup of sugar and quarter cup of water in a pot over the heat.
instructions.2: Let the sugar melt into caramel without stirring.
instructions.3: When it turns golden, swirl the pot gently for even heat.
instructions.4: Add half a cup of milk to the caramel and stir gently.
instructions.5: Separately, dissolve the cornflour in the rest of the cold milk.
instructions.6: Add the cornflour mix to the pot, stirring constantly.
instructions.7: Add the butter, the optional cream and the vanilla and stir until combined.
instructions.8: Keep over the heat until boiling and thick.
instructions.9: Pour into the danette moulds and cool.
instructions.10: Unmould when cold and serve.

fah-624.title: Rice Pudding with Apricot Jelly
fah-624.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-624.culturalNotes: Berries or strawberries can replace the apricots. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Put the kilo of full-fat milk on the heat.
instructions.2: Add the well-washed rice and simmer together a few minutes.
instructions.3: Turn off the heat, cover and leave for an hour to cook the rice.
instructions.4: Back on the heat, add the half cup of sugar and the vanilla.
instructions.5: When the rice is done, dissolve a tablespoon of cornflour in half a cup of cold milk.
instructions.6: Add the cornflour mix to the rice and stir until it binds.
instructions.7: Fill the serving cups half-full with rice pudding.
instructions.8: Chill the cups.
instructions.9: Dissolve the apricot-jelly pack in ¾ cup of boiling water.
instructions.10: Add ¾ cup of cold iced water to cool the mix.
instructions.11: Wash, dry and chop the apricots.
instructions.12: Arrange the apricots in the cups.
instructions.13: Pour the jelly over the apricots.
instructions.14: Chill until the jelly sets.
instructions.15: Serve cold.

fah-625.title: Fruit Yogurt
fah-625.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-625.culturalNotes: Use mango, peach, apricot, carrot or orange. Jam can replace the fresh fruit.

instructions.1: Cut the strawberries into small pieces.
instructions.2: Put them in a pan with the sugar.
instructions.3: Heat until the strawberries thicken and the water evaporates.
instructions.4: Add the juice of half a lemon and boil for 3 minutes.
instructions.5: Take off the heat and cool.
instructions.6: Boil the milk and cool to warm.
instructions.7: Take a cup of the warm milk, stir in the cup of yogurt.
instructions.8: Return the mix to the rest of the warm milk and stir well.
instructions.9: Put a spoon of strawberries in the base of each cup.
instructions.10: Fill the cups with the yogurt milk.
instructions.11: Set the cups in a tray with hot water around them.
instructions.12: Put in a warm (switched-off) oven for 4 hours.
instructions.13: Cover the cups and refrigerate at least 4 hours.

fah-626.title: Homemade Yogurt
fah-626.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-626.culturalNotes: Use good-quality milk and boil it well. Serve with fruit or honey.

instructions.1: Boil 2 kilos of milk, stirring constantly to stop a skin.
instructions.2: Turn off, cover and cool to warm.
instructions.3: Stir the 2 tubs of yogurt into the warm milk until blended.
instructions.4: Ladle into bowls or cups and cover.
instructions.5: Set the dishes on a hot tray (about 100°) into the warmed oven for 4 hours.
instructions.6: After 4 hours, refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight to stop the bacteria.

fah-627.title: Lotus Biscuit Butter
fah-627.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-627.culturalNotes: Keeps in a jar in the fridge for over a month. Serve in sandwiches or as a dip.

instructions.1: Blend the biscuits.
instructions.2: Add the cinnamon.
instructions.3: Add the caramel sauce.
instructions.4: Blend until smooth.
instructions.5: Transfer to a clean, dry jar.

fah-628.title: Butter from Cream & Miracle Bread
fah-628.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-628.culturalNotes: Freeze the bread in bags and use as needed. Serve with cheese, honey and cream.

instructions.1: Take the cream out of the freezer and let it reach room temperature.
instructions.2: Blitz the cream until it turns to butter and the buttermilk separates.
instructions.3: Strain the buttermilk and keep the butter in a bowl.
instructions.4: Mix the flour, salt, sugar and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.5: Add the leftover buttermilk to the flour and knead until cohesive.
instructions.6: Rest the dough for a minute.
instructions.7: Heat a basbousa tray over high heat.
instructions.8: Cook the dough on the hot tray, flipping once.
instructions.9: Cover the bread out of the pan to keep it soft.

fah-629.title: Sablé Biscuits
fah-629.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-629.culturalNotes: Shape however you like — add cocoa to half the dough for chocolate sablés. Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week.

instructions.1: Sift the flour once or twice.
instructions.2: Beat the butter and icing sugar until white and creamy.
instructions.3: Add the egg and vanilla and mix well.
instructions.4: Add the salt and mix.
instructions.5: Add the flour gradually until combined.
instructions.6: Knead briefly without overworking.
instructions.7: Cover the dough and refrigerate 30 minutes to an hour.
instructions.8: Roll between two plastic sheets to under half a centimetre.
instructions.9: Cut with shaped cutters.
instructions.10: Lay on an oiled tray or one lined with baking paper.
instructions.11: Bake at 170°C for 12–15 minutes.
instructions.12: Take out and cool.
instructions.13: Decorate with caramel, jam or chocolate to taste.

fah-630.title: Melted Chocolate (Bag Method)
fah-630.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-630.culturalNotes: The water should be warm, not hot, so the chocolate doesn't seize. Works for any chocolate — easy and quick.

instructions.1: Chop or grate the white and milk chocolate.
instructions.2: Put the 100 g of white chocolate in a plastic bag with a tablespoon of oil.
instructions.3: Work the oil through the chocolate inside the bag.
instructions.4: Press the air out and tie the bag well.
instructions.5: Do the same with the milk chocolate in a second bag.
instructions.6: Work the oil through.
instructions.7: Press the air out and tie.
instructions.8: Submerge both bags in warm water for 5 minutes.
instructions.9: Check the chocolate is fully liquid.
instructions.10: Snip the bag at the side so no water gets in.
instructions.11: Pour into a dish and use for decorating.

fah-631.title: Toffee Sauce
fah-631.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-631.culturalNotes: Use it on cakes, cinnabon and donuts. Keeps a long time in the fridge.

instructions.1: Put a cup of sugar and a quarter cup of water in a pan over the heat.
instructions.2: Swirl gently until the sugar dissolves and turns golden.
instructions.3: Add the tin of cream and stir until combined.
instructions.4: Add half a cup of milk gradually to your preferred thickness.
instructions.5: Leave on the heat until it reaches the right consistency.
instructions.6: Cool, then cover and refrigerate.

fah-632.title: Azizia (Baked Pasta Milk Pudding)
fah-632.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-632.culturalNotes: Top with nuts, cream or caramel sauce. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Boil the pasta in hot water without oil or salt until cooked.
instructions.2: Blend the milk and sugar.
instructions.3: Mix the cornflour and chantilly into a cup of milk.
instructions.4: Add the boiled pasta to the milk-sugar mix in the blender.
instructions.5: Heat the mixture, adding the egg yolks, vanilla, chantilly and cornflour mix, stirring until boiling and thick.
instructions.6: Pour into a buttered tray and level.
instructions.7: Cool for two hours.
instructions.8: Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes or until the top browns.
instructions.9: Cool completely before cutting.
instructions.10: Top with nuts, cream or caramel sauce to taste.

fah-633.title: Labneh from Milk & Yogurt
fah-633.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-633.culturalNotes: Keeps in an airtight container in the fridge for 3–4 days. Use the drained whey in pastry, cinnabon and pizza dough.

instructions.1: Heat the milk, stirring constantly, until it boils.
instructions.2: Take off and cool to warm.
instructions.3: Stir the yogurt into the warm milk until blended.
instructions.4: Leave in the warm, switched-off oven for 4 hours.
instructions.5: Refrigerate for another 4 hours.
instructions.6: Strain through clean cheesecloth — weight it with a heavy plate to drain faster.
instructions.7: Add the salt to the labneh and mix well.
instructions.8: Serve with thyme, or tomato and olives.

fah-634.title: French-Toast Bread Pudding
fah-634.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-634.culturalNotes: Brown sugar works instead of white; add a spoon of black honey for depth. The dish keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Dot half the butter (¼ cup) in the dish and sprinkle half a cup of sugar in the base.
instructions.2: Layer the toast, croissants or fino bread.
instructions.3: Blend the eggs with the milk, remaining sugar (¼ cup), remaining butter, vanilla and salt.
instructions.4: Pour over the bread in the dish.
instructions.5: Bake at 220°C on the middle shelf until set and coloured, about 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Decorate with vanilla ice cream, strawberries, crushed nuts and caramel sauce.

fah-635.title: Ashta (Clotted Cream)
fah-635.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-635.culturalNotes: Fresh milk gives similar results to laban. The ashta keeps for two weeks refrigerated.

instructions.1: Simmer the milk in a pot over low heat until boiling.
instructions.2: Cover and leave in the warm oven for 24 hours.
instructions.3: Strain the laban in a sieve and sprinkle a teaspoon of salt over it.
instructions.4: Leave the qarish cheese in the sieve to dry for 24 hours.
instructions.5: Blend the red peppers and ground fenugreek with the laban.
instructions.6: Add the qarish cheese to the mish mixture.
instructions.7: Serve the ashta with honey to taste.

fah-636.title: Raisin & Nut Cupcakes
fah-636.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-636.culturalNotes: Plain milk can replace the laban. When whipping chantilly, don't add extra liquid so it stays firm.

instructions.1: Beat the sugar, eggs and vanilla in a large bowl until white and creamy.
instructions.2: Add the butter and oil and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the laban and mix again.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix the flour with the salt and baking powder.
instructions.5: Add the flour mix gradually to the egg mix on low speed.
instructions.6: Toss the raisins and nuts with a teaspoon of flour and fold into the batter.
instructions.7: Fill the cupcake moulds two-thirds full.
instructions.8: Bake at 180°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Drop to 160°C and bake 10 more minutes.
instructions.10: Cool the cupcakes.
instructions.11: Decorate with chantilly cream to taste.

fah-637.title: Oat & Raisin Cookies
fah-637.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-637.culturalNotes: Cut the sugar to taste. Any nuts you have work. Great for kids and adults.

instructions.1: Cream the sugar and butter.
instructions.2: Add the eggs and vanilla and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the black honey and mix again.
instructions.4: Add the cinnamon, baking powder and salt and mix well.
instructions.5: Add the sifted flour and mix until combined.
instructions.6: Fold in the oats.
instructions.7: Add the raisins and nuts and mix until combined.
instructions.8: Heat the oven to 160°C.
instructions.9: Shape the cookies on an oiled tray or baking paper.
instructions.10: Bake 12–15 minutes until golden.
instructions.11: Cool slightly before serving.

fah-638.title: Coconut Cookies
fah-638.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-638.culturalNotes: Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week. Serve with tea or coffee.

instructions.1: Beat the butter and icing sugar until light and white.
instructions.2: Add the eggs and vanilla and mix until combined.
instructions.3: In another bowl, mix the flour, baking powder and coconut.
instructions.4: Add the dry mix to the butter mix until a dough forms.
instructions.5: Roll on a floured surface to about half a centimetre.
instructions.6: Cut with cookie cutters.
instructions.7: Arrange on an oiled tray or baking paper.
instructions.8: Sprinkle coarse sugar on top.
instructions.9: Bake at 180°C for 25–30 minutes until golden.
instructions.10: Cool slightly before serving.

fah-639.title: Fruit Jelly Cake
fah-639.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-639.culturalNotes: The chantilly must be well-whipped so the jelly doesn't sink. Any fruit works.

instructions.1: Heat the oven to 180°C.
instructions.2: Mix the flour, salt and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.3: In another bowl, beat the eggs with the vanilla and sugar until white.
instructions.4: Add the oil and milk and mix well.
instructions.5: Add the flour mix gradually until combined.
instructions.6: Pour into a ghee-greased, floured tray.
instructions.7: Bake for 30 minutes or until golden.
instructions.8: Boil 2 cups of water, add the two jelly sachets and stir until dissolved.
instructions.9: Add a cup of cold water and cool the mix.
instructions.10: Whip the chantilly and spread over the cake.
instructions.11: Add the chopped fruit over the cream.
instructions.12: Pour the cooled jelly over the fruit.
instructions.13: Refrigerate 4–5 hours until set.

fah-640.title: Hot-Milk Cake
fah-640.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-640.culturalNotes: Add dried fruit to taste. Serve hot or cold.

instructions.1: Mix the flour and baking powder well.
instructions.2: In another bowl, mix the oil and butter with the sugar for two minutes.
instructions.3: Add the eggs one at a time, beating after each.
instructions.4: Add the vanilla, salt and vinegar and mix well.
instructions.5: Add the flour mix gradually while mixing.
instructions.6: Add the hot milk and mix until combined.
instructions.7: Heat the oven to 170°C.
instructions.8: Butter and flour a 26 cm tin.
instructions.9: Pour in the batter, keeping it under half the tin's height.
instructions.10: Bake on the middle shelf for 45 minutes.
instructions.11: Test with a wooden skewer — clean means done.

fah-641.title: Quick Microwave Chocolate Cake
fah-641.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-641.culturalNotes: Serve with a cup of milk or tea.

instructions.1: Mix the flour and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the milk and oil and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the baking powder and cocoa and mix again.
instructions.4: Pour into a microwave-safe bowl.
instructions.5: Drop a tablespoon of chocolate spread into the middle.
instructions.6: Microwave for two minutes.
instructions.7: Serve with a spoon of chocolate.

fah-642.title: Ten-Minute Cake
fah-642.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-642.culturalNotes: Serve with tea or Nescafé. Cool fully before cutting or it crumbles.

instructions.1: Bring all ingredients to room temperature.
instructions.2: Blend the eggs, yogurt, oil, vanilla and salt.
instructions.3: Add the sugar and blend for a minute or two.
instructions.4: Sift the flour with the baking powder over the liquids and whisk one way.
instructions.5: Heat the oven to 170°C and line a 26 cm tin.
instructions.6: Pour in the batter, holding back two tablespoons.
instructions.7: Mix the reserved batter with a tablespoon of raw cocoa, adding two spoons of milk if thick.
instructions.8: Pipe it in a bag to draw a grid pattern over the cake.
instructions.9: Bake on the middle shelf for 45 minutes.
instructions.10: Test with a toothpick after 35 minutes — clean means done.
instructions.11: Cool before cutting.

fah-643.title: Cold Cream-Caramel Cake
fah-643.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-643.culturalNotes: Any favourite biscuits work. Add a little vanilla for flavour.

instructions.1: Break the biscuits into large pieces.
instructions.2: Pour the caramel pack into a kilo of cold milk.
instructions.3: Add two tablespoons each of instant coffee, raw cocoa, cornflour and sugar.
instructions.4: Stir well in the cold milk.
instructions.5: Heat until boiling, then lower and keep stirring until thick.
instructions.6: Pour over the broken biscuits in a Pyrex dish.
instructions.7: Cover and refrigerate until cold.
instructions.8: Turn out onto a serving plate and dust with raw cocoa.
instructions.9: Serve cold.

fah-644.title: No-Oven Cake
fah-644.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-644.culturalNotes: Serve plain or with chocolate or any other sauce. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the eggs with the vanilla and sugar.
instructions.2: Add the oil and mix.
instructions.3: Add the milk and mix until combined.
instructions.4: Add the flour, baking powder, cocoa and salt and mix until smooth.
instructions.5: Grease the tin lightly — or with ghee and flour if aluminium.
instructions.6: Pour in the batter, keeping it under half the tin.
instructions.7: Set the tin in a pot of boiling water reaching a third of its height.
instructions.8: Cover the pot with a towel then a lid and cook over medium heat for 40 minutes.
instructions.9: After 40 minutes, test the cake by inserting a wooden skewer in the center; if it comes out clean, the cake is done.
instructions.10: Lift the cake out, cool slightly, then turn onto a flat surface.
instructions.11: Serve hot or cold with chocolate or any sauce.

fah-645.title: No-Bake Marble Mousse Cake
fah-645.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-645.culturalNotes: Any biscuits work. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the milk, sugar, raw cocoa, cornflour, cream caramel, dark chocolate and instant coffee in a pot.
instructions.2: Stir until combined.
instructions.3: Heat, stirring constantly, until boiling.
instructions.4: Pour into moulds, tucking in pieces of tea biscuits.
instructions.5: Cover and refrigerate 5–6 hours until set.
instructions.6: Unmould with a quick dip in hot water.
instructions.7: Serve cold.

fah-646.title: Diet Chocolate Mug Cakes
fah-646.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-646.culturalNotes: Regular vegetable oil can replace the coconut oil. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the cocoa with the oat flour, bicarbonate, baking powder and sweetener.
instructions.2: Add the laban, vinegar and coconut oil to the dry mix and stir well.
instructions.3: Fill the mugs half-full.
instructions.4: Set the mugs in a pot of boiling water over medium heat, water reaching a third of their height.
instructions.5: Cover the pot with a clean towel then a lid.
instructions.6: Steam-bake for 3 hours.
instructions.7: After 3 hours, test the cake with a wooden skewer to check it is done.
instructions.8: Make the sauce by mixing a cup of dark chocolate with half a cup of hot skimmed milk.
instructions.9: Pour the sauce over the cakes.
instructions.10: Decorate with strawberry and kiwi pieces.

fah-647.title: Quick No-Oven Biscuit Cake
fah-647.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-647.culturalNotes: Add chocolate pieces or dried fruit for flavour.

instructions.1: Crush the biscuits finely.
instructions.2: Get the milk.
instructions.3: Add the flour to the crushed biscuits.
instructions.4: Add the cocoa, sugar and baking powder.
instructions.5: Mix until combined.
instructions.6: Pour into a microwave-safe bowl.
instructions.7: Microwave for exactly one minute.
instructions.8: Serve hot.

fah-648.title: Mango Jelly Cake
fah-648.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-648.culturalNotes: Serve with fresh mango or other fruit. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Beat the eggs with the vanilla and sugar until creamy.
instructions.2: Add the flour, baking powder and salt and stir until the flour disappears.
instructions.3: Pour into the prepared tin and bake at 170°C for 30 minutes.
instructions.4: Meanwhile whip the chantilly with the icing sugar, milk and mango-jelly pack until creamy.
instructions.5: Prepare the mango jelly in a bowl and cool.
instructions.6: Pour the syrup or honeyed water over the baked cake.
instructions.7: Spread the chantilly layer over the cake.
instructions.8: Add the mango pieces over the cream.
instructions.9: Pour the cooled jelly layer on top.
instructions.10: Refrigerate at least two hours.

fah-649.title: Ten-Minute No-Oven Cakes
fah-649.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-649.culturalNotes: Don't let the water boil hard or it will get into the moulds. Serve hot or cold.

instructions.1: Mix the egg with the vanilla and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the sugar and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the oil and milk and stir until combined.
instructions.4: Sift the flour and cocoa over the mix and stir until smooth.
instructions.5: Fill the cake moulds (small cups) halfway.
instructions.6: Tuck chocolate pieces into the centre of each mould.
instructions.7: Set the moulds in a tray with hot water halfway up.
instructions.8: Cover the tray with a towel then a lid over medium heat.
instructions.9: Cook for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: Uncover and cool slightly.
instructions.11: Decorate with icing sugar and cherries if you like.

fah-650.title: Fluffy Cornflour Cake
fah-650.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-650.culturalNotes: Preheat the oven to 170°C before starting. Serve with tea or milky tea.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, cornflour and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Blend the sugar, eggs, oil, vanilla, hot milk, vinegar and salt until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.3: Add the liquid mix gradually to the dry and stir until combined.
instructions.4: Pour into a 26 cm tin, greased with ghee or butter and floured.
instructions.5: Bake in a preheated 170°C oven.
instructions.6: Bake for 40–50 minutes until cooked.
instructions.7: Cool before cutting.

fah-651.title: Quick Nectarine Cake
fah-651.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-651.culturalNotes: Apples or oranges can replace the nectarines. Add a little cinnamon for flavour.

instructions.1: Pit the nectarine and slice thinly.
instructions.2: Lay it in an 18 cm non-stick tray.
instructions.3: Scatter 2 tablespoons of sugar over the fruit.
instructions.4: Mix 2 tablespoons of sugar, 2 of oil, ¾ cup of flour and ⅓ cup of milk in a bowl.
instructions.5: Pour the mixture over the nectarines.
instructions.6: Top with the nuts.
instructions.7: Set the tray over medium heat on the stove.
instructions.8: Cover until golden.
instructions.9: Serve hot or cold.

fah-652.title: Cold Summer Cake — No Oven, No Eggs
fah-652.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-652.culturalNotes: Leftover cake can replace the biscuit base. Serve cold with fresh fruit.

instructions.1: Pour the litre of milk into a pot.
instructions.2: Add half a cup of sugar, 3 tablespoons of raw cocoa and 3 of cornflour.
instructions.3: Stir well in the cold milk until dissolved.
instructions.4: Heat, stirring constantly, until boiling and thick.
instructions.5: Add the tin of ashta, the butter and the vanilla.
instructions.6: Keep stirring until the chocolate and butter melt.
instructions.7: Layer biscuits in a cheesecake tin.
instructions.8: Add a layer of the hot mousse.
instructions.9: Repeat to the last layer, finishing with mousse.
instructions.10: Cover and refrigerate at least 5 hours or overnight.
instructions.11: Decorate with grated dark chocolate and strawberries or cherries.

fah-653.title: One-Egg Cake
fah-653.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-653.culturalNotes: Add a quarter cup of extra sugar if you skip the cream caramel. Keeps in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Blend the egg.
instructions.2: Add the oil, vanilla, yogurt, sugar and vinegar and blend for 3–4 minutes.
instructions.3: Separately mix the flour, cornflour, cake-chef sachet, cream caramel (optional) and salt.
instructions.4: Add the liquids to the dry mix and stir until a batter forms.
instructions.5: Grease the tin with ghee and dust with flour.
instructions.6: Pour in the batter and level.
instructions.7: Bake in a preheated 170°C oven for 40 minutes.
instructions.8: Take the cake out of the oven after 40 minutes and test for doneness.
instructions.9: Cool before serving.

fah-654.title: Fluffy Moist Cake
fah-654.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-654.culturalNotes: Serve with mint tea or Nescafé. Keeps in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Heat the oven to 170°C.
instructions.2: Line a 30×40 cm tray with baking paper.
instructions.3: Blend the eggs, oil, vanilla, laban or yogurt, sugar and salt.
instructions.4: Add the flour, baking powder and coconut and mix until combined.
instructions.5: Pour into the prepared tray.
instructions.6: Bake for 20–25 minutes.
instructions.7: Soak the baked cake with the cold milk.
instructions.8: Cool, then cut into cubes.

fah-655.title: Laban Rayeb (Fermented Milk)
fah-655.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-655.culturalNotes: Use in doughs and pastries, or eat as a light snack with honey. Keep refrigerated once made.

instructions.1: Simmer the milk in a pot over low heat.
instructions.2: Once boiled, pour into a clean dish and cover.
instructions.3: Leave in the warm oven for 24 hours undisturbed.
instructions.4: After 24 hours, take the tagine out of the oven and leave it to cool.
instructions.5: Strain the laban in a wire sieve and sprinkle a teaspoon of salt on it.
instructions.6: Leave the laban in the sieve another day to drain.
instructions.7: Eat as is with honey, or use in doughs and pastries.

fah-656.title: Homemade Marshmallows
fah-656.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-656.culturalNotes: Cut into circles, stars or hearts. Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week.

instructions.1: Mix half a cup of water with 2 cups of fine sugar and the glucose syrup.
instructions.2: Add a drop of lemon juice and stir well.
instructions.3: Bring to the boil over medium heat and leave for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Separately, mix the gelatin with half a cup of boiling water, whisking fast.
instructions.5: Add the gelatin mix to the sugar mix and stir well.
instructions.6: Pour into a plastic-lined, oiled square tray.
instructions.7: Level and cool for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Set half aside and colour the rest as you like.
instructions.9: Chill fully for 30 minutes.
instructions.10: Dust a tray generously with cornflour and cut the marshmallow into small cubes.
instructions.11: Coat each cube in cornflour and sieve off the excess.

fah-657.title: Green-Apple Jam
fah-657.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-657.culturalNotes: Slice thinly or cube the apples. The gelatin helps the jam set in the fridge.

instructions.1: Slice or cube the green apples.
instructions.2: Put them in a pot with half a kilo of the sugar, half a cup of water and the lemon juice.
instructions.3: Stir, cover and bring to the boil over medium heat.
instructions.4: Keep simmering until it thickens and releases syrup.
instructions.5: Dissolve the gelatin in half a cup of water and set aside.
instructions.6: Halfway through, add the raisins and cinnamon and stir.
instructions.7: Simmer until fully thickened.
instructions.8: Add the dissolved gelatin and stir once on the heat.
instructions.9: Take off when ready.
instructions.10: Store in sterilised, sealed jars in the fridge.

fah-658.title: Carrot Jam with Apricots & Orange
fah-658.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-658.culturalNotes: Keeps a long time in a cool, dry spot. Always use a clean, dry spoon.

instructions.1: Wash and halve the oranges.
instructions.2: Juice and strain them in the food processor, removing seeds and peel.
instructions.3: Wash the carrots and slice thinly.
instructions.4: Grate the carrots in the processor.
instructions.5: Add the grated carrot and orange juice to a pot.
instructions.6: Add the sugar, cloves and apricots.
instructions.7: Bring to the boil, then lower and stir occasionally until thickened.
instructions.8: Take off the heat.
instructions.9: Store in clean, dry jars in a cool, dry spot.

fah-659.title: Strawberry Jam
fah-659.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-659.culturalNotes: Use ripe strawberries with no green parts for the best taste and colour. Keeps a long time in sterilised jars or freezer bags.

instructions.1: Wash the strawberries and chop small — some can be blended.
instructions.2: Add the sugar, stir, cover and refrigerate overnight.
instructions.3: Next day they'll have released lots of juice.
instructions.4: Put in a heavy-based pot over high heat and boil.
instructions.5: After a while, skim the foam that forms.
instructions.6: Keep boiling until the strawberries thicken.
instructions.7: Add the lemon juice and stir.
instructions.8: Drop a spoon on a plate, cool, and run a line through it — if it doesn't merge back, it's done.
instructions.9: Cool fully, then jar in sterilised, dry jars.
instructions.10: Seal and store somewhere cool and dry or in the fridge.

fah-660.title: Mahalabia with Filo
fah-660.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-660.culturalNotes: Any nuts at home work — peanuts or almonds. Syrup can replace the honey.

instructions.1: Cut the filo into small pieces on a tray.
instructions.2: Melt the ghee or butter and drizzle over the filo.
instructions.3: Bake on the middle shelf at 180°C until browned.
instructions.4: Put a kilo of milk on the heat.
instructions.5: Crush the mastic and add it to the milk.
instructions.6: Add the half cup of sugar and stir.
instructions.7: Separately, mix the cornflour with half a cup of milk.
instructions.8: Add the cornflour mix to the hot milk, stirring until thick.
instructions.9: Add the vanilla and ashta and stir.
instructions.10: Take the filo out and crush slightly.
instructions.11: Mix in the toasted nuts and a little honey or syrup.
instructions.12: In the serving dishes, layer toasted filo, mahalabia, then more filo.
instructions.13: Add more nuts on top if you like.
instructions.14: Chill before serving.

fah-661.title: Molto Croissants with Chocolate Sauce
fah-661.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-661.culturalNotes: Serve hot or cold. Keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg, vinegar and warm water gradually, kneading until combined.
instructions.3: Add the melted butter and knead for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover with a cloth and prove in a warm spot for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Oil the worktop and roll the dough into a circle.
instructions.6: Cut into small squares.
instructions.7: Shape each square into a croissant as shown in the video.
instructions.8: Set on an oiled tray and prove for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Brush with the egg-and-milk mix and bake at 220°C for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: Stir the milk, sugar and cornflour over low heat until thick.
instructions.11: Add the crushed chocolate and butter and stir until melted.
instructions.12: Cool the sauce, then chill briefly.
instructions.13: Dip the croissants in the sauce or fill them with chocolate using a piping bag.

fah-662.title: Milkshake
fah-662.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-662.culturalNotes: Fresh banana works but frozen gives a thicker, colder shake.

instructions.1: Blend the frozen bananas.
instructions.2: Add the milk, vanilla and sugar.
instructions.3: Add the ice cream.
instructions.4: Blend until combined.
instructions.5: Pour into glasses.
instructions.6: Drizzle caramel sauce to taste.

fah-663.title: Naiti (Jam Layer Cake Bites)
fah-663.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-663.culturalNotes: Any jam works. Serve with tea or coffee.

instructions.1: Beat the eggs with the vanilla and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil gradually while beating.
instructions.3: Add the milk and keep beating until blended.
instructions.4: Add the flour, baking powder and salt and mix well.
instructions.5: Pour into a buttered tray or one lined with baking paper.
instructions.6: Bake in a preheated 170°C oven for 15 minutes.
instructions.7: Cool slightly.
instructions.8: Cut the cake in half and spread the jam on the bottom half.
instructions.9: Cover with the top half and press lightly.
instructions.10: Cut into small pieces.
instructions.11: Decorate with melted chocolate.

fah-664.title: Homemade Nutella
fah-664.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-664.culturalNotes: Keeps in a jar in the fridge for over a month. Use in sandwiches or as a dessert sauce.

instructions.1: Toast the hazelnuts at 170°C for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.2: Grind them in the blender until smooth.
instructions.3: Add the chopped chocolate to the blender.
instructions.4: Add the icing sugar, milk powder and raw cocoa.
instructions.5: Pour in the boiling water gradually.
instructions.6: Blend until smooth and pourable.
instructions.7: Pour into a clean, dry jar.

fah-665.title: Warbat with Cream
fah-665.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-665.culturalNotes: Add crushed hazelnuts or peanuts to the cream for extra flavour. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

fah-665-i4.name: Dessert cream or 2 tbsp milk-skin cream

instructions.1: Put 2 cups of cold milk in a pot over the heat.
instructions.2: Add 2 tablespoons of cornflour and stir until combined.
instructions.3: Keep stirring until boiling and thick.
instructions.4: Add the cream and stir until it melts in.
instructions.5: Take off and cool the cream.
instructions.6: Oil a baking tray and lay the puff pastry evenly.
instructions.7: Brush the tops with a little milk.
instructions.8: Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Cool slightly, then split in half.
instructions.10: Fill with the cream using a piping bag or spoon.
instructions.11: Serve hot or cold.

fah-234.title: Winter Vegetable & Vermicelli Soup
fah-234.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-234.culturalNotes: Serve with toasted bread for a warmer, heartier bowl.

instructions.1: Heat the butter or oil in a pot.
instructions.2: Add the onion and garlic and stir until golden.
instructions.3: Add the diced carrots, ground cardamom, bay leaves and peas.
instructions.4: Cover and leave over low heat until they soften.
instructions.5: Add the courgette cubes, boiling water and the vegetable stock cube and stir well.
instructions.6: Leave on the heat until cooked.
instructions.7: In another pot, brown the vermicelli in a spoon of butter or oil.
instructions.8: Add the vermicelli to the pot with the vegetables and adjust the salt and pepper.
instructions.9: Add the chopped celery, cover and leave for 10 minutes off the heat.
instructions.10: Serve the soup hot with lemon juice.

fah-235.title: Chicken, Mushroom & Cream Soup
fah-235.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-235.culturalNotes: Tinned mushrooms can replace fresh. Instant stock instead of water gives a stronger flavour. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pot.
instructions.2: Add the chopped onion and stir until golden.
instructions.3: Add the chicken pieces and sear with the onion until they start cooking.
instructions.4: Add the pepper, sugar, salt and ground cardamom and stir well.
instructions.5: Add the mushrooms and sear with the chicken and onion for a minute.
instructions.6: Add the flour and stir well.
instructions.7: Add a litre of water and boil for two minutes.
instructions.8: Add the cream, boil for a minute, then turn off the heat.
instructions.9: Skim the cream off the top of the milk if you'd rather use it as a cream substitute.

fah-236.title: Freekeh & Carrot Soup
fah-236.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-236.culturalNotes: Serve with toasted bread or sweet biscuits for a full meal. Keeps in the fridge for two days or freeze for longer.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken breasts into small cubes.
instructions.2: Wash the freekeh, soak for half an hour, then drain.
instructions.3: Grate the carrot and chop the celery and onion small.
instructions.4: Heat the butter and oil in a pot.
instructions.5: Add two mastic tears and sear the chicken until it starts cooking.
instructions.6: Add a pinch of sugar and stir the chicken well.
instructions.7: Add the onion and stir for a minute.
instructions.8: Add the celery and carrot and stir for a minute.
instructions.9: Add the salt, pepper, ground cardamom and freekeh.
instructions.10: Add the boiling water or instant stock.
instructions.11: Bring to the boil, then lower the heat and simmer for 15 minutes until cooked.
instructions.12: Serve hot.

fah-237.title: Mushroom & Cream Soup
fah-237.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-237.culturalNotes: A stock cube strengthens the flavour. Serve with lemon juice for a distinct taste.

instructions.1: Cut the rabbit into small cubes.
instructions.2: Open and drain the tin of mushrooms.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee in a pot.
instructions.4: Add the rabbit pieces and sear until they change colour.
instructions.5: Add the chopped onion and sear with the rabbit.
instructions.6: Add the chopped garlic and stir in.
instructions.7: Add the celery and sear.
instructions.8: Add the mushrooms and stir in.
instructions.9: Add the flour and stir well.
instructions.10: Add the salt and black pepper.
instructions.11: Add the boiling water and let it boil.
instructions.12: Add the milk and stir well.
instructions.13: Leave on low heat until it boils and thickens.
instructions.14: Serve hot with toasted bread and chopped parsley.

fah-238.title: Pasta Soup
fah-238.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-238.culturalNotes: A complete, nutrient-rich meal served hot. Keeps in the fridge for two days or freeze for longer.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee and oil in a pot.
instructions.2: Add the chicken pieces and stir until golden.
instructions.3: Add the chopped onion and garlic and stir until golden.
instructions.4: Add the carrots, peas and sweetcorn and stir together.
instructions.5: Add boiling water (about 2 litres), the stock cube, salt, pepper and sugar and bring to the boil.
instructions.6: Cover and simmer over low heat until the vegetables cook.
instructions.7: In another pan, warm a teaspoon of ghee and a spoon of oil, add the pasta and stir until golden.
instructions.8: Add the browned pasta to the pot.
instructions.9: Add the celery, sweetcorn and tomato paste and stir.
instructions.10: Cover and simmer for 2 minutes until boiling.
instructions.11: Turn off the heat and rest the soup for 5–10 minutes before serving.

fah-239.title: Orzo Soup with Vegetables & Chicken
fah-239.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-239.culturalNotes: Serve hot with bread or as a main meal.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the chicken cubes and sear with the pepper, mastic and ground cardamom.
instructions.3: Add the chopped onion and stir until it wilts.
instructions.4: Add the peas and carrots and stir together.
instructions.5: Cover the pot and leave the vegetables for 2–3 minutes.
instructions.6: Add the courgette and potatoes and stir.
instructions.7: Add the water or broth and the stock cube and cover.
instructions.8: Cook the vegetables until done but not mushy.
instructions.9: Add the salt and the orzo and cover.
instructions.10: When the soup boils, turn off the heat.
instructions.11: Add the celery and cover for a minute.

fah-240.title: Homemade Cooking Cream
fah-240.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-240.culturalNotes: Keeps in the fridge for a week to ten days. Use it in sauces, soups and pasta.

instructions.1: Blend the milk, flour, ashta and sugar until smooth.
instructions.2: Pour into a pot over the heat, stirring constantly until boiling.
instructions.3: Strain through a fine sieve to remove lumps.
instructions.4: Pour into a container and refrigerate.

fah-241.title: Homemade Instant Stock Mix
fah-241.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-241.culturalNotes: Keep in an airtight jar in a dark spot away from heat to preserve the aroma and flavour.

instructions.1: Mix everything in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Warm over low heat, stirring for 5 minutes to drive off moisture.
instructions.3: Cool completely.
instructions.4: Grind in the spice mill until fine.
instructions.5: Store in an airtight jar in a dark spot away from heat.
instructions.6: Freeze extra in sealed bags.
instructions.7: Use a teaspoon at a time as needed.
instructions.8: Use it in soups, molokhia, sauces and other dishes.

fah-460.title: Easy Quick Bagasha
fah-460.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-460.culturalNotes: Serve bagasha with caramel sauce, chocolate or icing sugar. Keeps in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Make the syrup: mix the sugar and water in a pot and set over the heat.
instructions.2: Leave to boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Add the juice of half a lemon, a teaspoon of vanilla and 2 tablespoons of white honey.
instructions.4: Boil once more, then turn off and cool the syrup.
instructions.5: Make the dough: mix the flour, cornflour and salt in a bowl.
instructions.6: Add the oil and vanilla and mix well.
instructions.7: Add the egg and water gradually until a smooth, cohesive dough forms.
instructions.8: Knead for at least 5 minutes.
instructions.9: Cut into 3 balls and rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Roll out with cornflour to about 3 mm thick.
instructions.11: Cut into small squares.
instructions.12: Fry the squares in hot oil over medium heat until golden.
